episodes.title: The Defeated
episodes.overview: Having defeated Fushi, Hayase makes a surprising proposal to the people of the island of Jananda.

episodes.title: The Children's Dreams
episodes.overview: Fushi just barely manages to take down the Nokkers. He opens up to the others, and they discuss their dreams and pasts.

episodes.title: A Girl Named Tonari
episodes.overview: Fushi transforms into Parona of Ninannah in the middle of the tournament. He is shocked when he realizes what this implies. Meanwhile, Tonari, desperate to have Fushi join her and her friends, offers to help rescue Pioran.

episodes.title: Jananda, Island of Freedom
episodes.overview: Fushi and Pioran are separated on the prison island of Jananda. He enters a tournament where, if he survives until the end, he will be granted the right to do anything he wants – including leaving the island with Pioran.

episodes.title: Aspiring to Go Higher
episodes.overview: Fushi leaves Booze Man's home and sets out to wander aimlessly around Takunaha. He has many questions for the Observer, but can't seem to get any straight answers.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.overview: Just as Gugu and Rean come to understand each other, the Nokkers emerge, causing panic in the party hall. Fushi and Gugu are forced to fight.

episodes.title: Gift From the Past
episodes.overview: Four years after their encounter with the Nokkers, Fushi and Gugu have grown into fine young men. They're invited to Rean's birthday party after a brief reunion with Gugu's brother.

episodes.title: New Family
episodes.overview: Fushi and Gugu fight against the Nokkers that they encountered in the forest. Though the situation is grim, Gugu has a trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Deep Memories
episodes.overview: Fushi tells Gugu about the wolf, Joaan, and the boy he took on the form of. Gugu explains death to Fushi, recalling his own past, working for a wealthy family with his brother.

episodes.title: The Two Monsters
episodes.overview: Fushi explains to Gugu how his form as the wolf, Joaan, and March, came to be. Gugu explains death to Fushi. Together, they come to understand the meaning of family.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Wants To Change
episodes.overview: Fushi and Pioran arrive at Takunaha, where they meet Booze Man and a boy named Gugu. Gugu, who had been living with Booze Man for several months following an accident, warms up to Fushi.

episodes.title: Our Goals
episodes.overview: Having gained a semblance of humanity, Fushi sets off on his own. He encounters Pioran again, who teachers him words and writing, helping him live as a human being.

episodes.title: Those Who Follow
episodes.overview: Fushi, March and Parona continue their escape from Yanome and back to Ninanna. Hayase chases after them, especially in order to capture Fushi.

episodes.title: A Large Vessel
episodes.overview: Hayase, interested in Fushi's inability to die, brings him along with March, Parona and Pioran to the nation of Yanome. They are shown around town and treated well, but things are not as they seem.

episodes.title: A Minor Evolution
episodes.overview: March is escorted to the altar to be sacrificed to Oniguma. Along the way, she tends to Fushi, who, despite having the body of a young man, doesn't seem to have the mind of one.

episodes.title: A Rambunctious Girl
episodes.overview: The orb, having morphed into a boy, finds its way to Ninanna, where he is attacked. He is discovered by a girl, March, who may not achieve her goal of becoming a grown-up.

episodes.title: The Last One
episodes.overview: An orb is tossed upon the earth. It transforms to match its surrounding environment: first a rock, then moss, then a dying wolf. The wolf returns to its last remaining family, a boy living alone in a small home in the snow.

title: The Witcher
overview: Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster-hunter for hire, journeys toward his destiny in a turbulent world where people often prove more wicked than beasts.

episodes.title: Baptism of Fire
episodes.overview: As the Continent sinks deeper into war, Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri each meet their fate on the roads they took to avoid it.

episodes.title: What I Love I Do Not Carry
episodes.overview: A trek through treacherous swamplands confronts Geralt with troubling visions. Emhyr discovers what he must do in order to claim absolute power.

episodes.title: Twilight of the Wolf
episodes.overview: Out of options, Yennefer rallies her novices in a deadly battle against the army of Vilgefortz. A dangerous foe catches Ciri's scent.

episodes.title: The Joy of Cooking
episodes.overview: Catching their breath before attempting a river crossing, Geralt and his party regale each other with stories and song, revealing a shocking truth.

episodes.title: A Sermon of Survival
episodes.overview: Yennefer's conviction starts to waver. Ciri opens up to Mistle about her true identity. Geralt finds himself at the mercy of Dijkstra.

episodes.title: Trial by Ordeal
episodes.overview: A witch trial pulls Geralt away from his quest. Ciri taps further into the darkness of her new life. Yennefer brings more recruits to her cause.

episodes.title: Dream of a Wish Fulfilled
episodes.overview: Ciri gets a chance to prove herself during a robbery. Geralt gains an unlikely ally, as does Yennefer when she visits Montecalvo to look for sanctuary.

episodes.title: What Doesn't Kill You Makes You Stronger
episodes.overview: Geralt sets out to save Ciri from the claws of Emhyr, unaware of her true fate. Beset by Vilgefortz, Yennefer attempts to uncover his plan.

episodes.title: The Cost of Chaos
episodes.overview: After the fateful events at Aretuza, Geralt and Yennefer struggle to pick up the pieces and reunite their family as war comes to the Continent.

episodes.title: Out of the Fire, Into the Frying Pan
episodes.overview: Haunted by faces from the past, Ciri endures the ultimate test of survival on a desperate journey under the harshest of conditions.

episodes.title: Everybody Has a Plan 'til They Get Punched in the Face
episodes.overview: Betrayal and bloodshed rock the conclave when the hunt for Ciri comes to a head. As sides are chosen and enemies unmasked, nothing will ever be the same.

episodes.title: The Art of Illusion
episodes.overview: Yennefer and Geralt step out arm in arm and dressed to kill at a lavish ball, but all is not as it seems during a night of revelry and revelations.

episodes.title: The Invitation
episodes.overview: Yennefer pitches a bold idea to the Brotherhood, Geralt strikes a dangerous deal with a ferryman, and Triss digs into the mystery of the missing novices.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: Geralt seeks magical help from a family friend as Ciri and Yennefer clash over plans for the future. Philippa and Dijkstra scheme to get Vizimir in line.

episodes.title: Unbound
episodes.overview: A shocking discovery awaits Geralt after he obtains information on Rience. Ciri's sense of justice causes problems. Jaskier performs for a royal fan.

episodes.title: Shaerrawedd
episodes.overview: Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri journey to the far reaches of the Continent in search of a safe haven. King Vizimir puts his charming younger brother to use.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.overview: Geralt faces off with a demon targeting his nearest and dearest while the most powerful players on the Continent ramp up their pursuit of Ciri.

episodes.title: Voleth Meir
episodes.overview: Geralt turns to a humble bard for help, Yennefer realizes just how special Ciri is, and tensions rise on the eve of Emperor Emhyr's visit to Cintra.

episodes.title: Dear Friend...
episodes.overview: A close friend is lost — and another found — as Geralt helps Ciri learn more about her power. Cahir warns Fringilla to focus on their primary mission.

episodes.title: Turn Your Back
episodes.overview: As a powerful mage joins the hunt for Ciri, she cuts a deal with Vesemir over his extraordinary discovery. Geralt explores the mystery of the monoliths.

episodes.title: Redanian Intelligence
episodes.overview: A guest at Kaer Morhen extends a guiding hand to Ciri — and an invitation to Geralt. On the run in Redania, Yennefer seeks safety below ground.

episodes.title: What Is Lost
episodes.overview: Impatient with Geralt's methods, Ciri braves major obstacles to prove her mettle. Scheming and suspicion among the Brotherhood make Yennefer a target.

episodes.title: Kaer Morhen
episodes.overview: Seeking a safe place for Ciri, Geralt heads for home, but danger lurks everywhere — even Kaer Morhen. Yennefer's dreams could be the key to her freedom.

episodes.title: A Grain of Truth
episodes.overview: Geralt sets off with Ciri on a journey that leads him to an old friend. After the Battle of Sodden, Tissaia shows no mercy in her search for information.

episodes.title: Much More
episodes.overview: A terrifying pack of foes lays Geralt low. Yennefer and her fellow mages prepare to fight back. A shaken Ciri depends on the kindness of a stranger.

episodes.title: Before a Fall
episodes.overview: With the Continent at risk from Nilfgaard's rising power, Yennefer revisits her past, while Geralt reconsiders his obligation to the Law of Surprise.

episodes.title: Rare Species
episodes.overview: A mysterious man tries to entice Geralt to join a hunt for a rampaging dragon, a quest that attracts a familiar face. Ciri questions who she can trust.

episodes.title: Bottled Appetites
episodes.overview: Heedless of warnings, Yennefer looks for a cure to restore what she's lost. Geralt inadvertently puts Jaskier in peril. The search for Ciri intensifies.

episodes.title: Of Banquets, Bastards and Burials
episodes.overview: Against his better judgment, Geralt accompanies Jaskier to a royal ball. Ciri wanders into an enchanted forest. Yennefer tries to protect her charges.

episodes.title: Betrayer Moon
episodes.overview: Geralt takes on another Witcher's unfinished business in a kingdom stalked by a ferocious beast. At a brutal cost, Yennefer forges a magical new future.

episodes.title: Four Marks
episodes.overview: Bullied and neglected, Yennefer accidentally finds a means of escape. Geralt's hunt for a so-called devil goes to hell. Ciri seeks safety in numbers.

episodes.title: The End's Beginning
episodes.overview: Hostile townsfolk and a cunning mage greet Geralt in the town of Blaviken. Ciri finds her royal world upended when Nilfgaard sets its sights on Cintra.

title: The 100
overview: 100 years in the future, when the Earth has been abandoned due to radioactivity, the last surviving humans live on an ark orbiting the planet — but the ark won't last forever. So the repressive regime picks 100 expendable juvenile delinquents to send down to Earth to see if the planet is still habitable.

episodes.title: The Last War
episodes.overview: After all the fighting and loss, Clarke and her friends have reached the final battle. But is humanity worthy of something greater?

episodes.title: The Dying of the Light
episodes.overview: Clarke and Octavia mount a desperate rescue mission as the Disciples close in on what they want.

episodes.title: A Sort of Homecoming
episodes.overview: Clarke and her friends reckon with all that has happened only to find an unexpected threat looming.

episodes.title: Blood Giant
episodes.overview: The red sun derails Clarke's plans.

episodes.title: The Stranger
episodes.overview: It's a new day in Sanctum. Clarke, Octavia, Raven and Echo struggle with a new foe.

episodes.title: Etherea
episodes.overview: Where in the universe is Bellamy Blake?

episodes.title: A Little Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Sheidheda makes his move. Meanwhile, a Disciple goes rogue.

episodes.title: The Flock
episodes.overview: Murphy and Indra must defuse a tense situation. Meanwhile, old friends make new allegiances.

episodes.title: Anaconda
episodes.overview: Clarke confronts a new adversary. A surprising connection takes us back to the past and the nuclear apocalypse that destroyed the Earth.

episodes.title: The Queen's Gambit
episodes.overview: Emori tries to heal Sanctum's old familial wounds while Echo, Octavia and Diyoza struggle with new ones.

episodes.title: Nakara
episodes.overview: Clarke and her friends find themselves on a planet that is not what it seems.

episodes.title: Welcome to Bardo
episodes.overview: Octavia gets to know a whole new world. Meanwhile, Murphy and Emori play make believe.

episodes.title: Hesperides
episodes.overview: Mysterious outsiders arrive with news of Clarke's missing people.

episodes.title: False Gods
episodes.overview: As Raven faces an unexpected threat, Clarke must keep the peace among opposing factions in Sanctum.

episodes.title: The Garden
episodes.overview: Echo and Gabriel learn more about Hope and her mysterious past.

episodes.title: From the Ashes
episodes.overview: Clarke and her friends attempt to rebuild Sanctum as a new threat rises in the woods.

episodes.title: The Blood of Sanctum
episodes.overview: Sanctum becomes a battleground between the devout and the non-believers. The mystery of the anomaly deepens.

episodes.title: Adjustment Protocol
episodes.overview: A special Naming Day changes everything in Sanctum. Gabriel comes face to face with an old friend.

episodes.title: Ashes to Ashes
episodes.overview: Bellamy and Octavia must work together to save their friends. Echo is forced to face her past.

episodes.title: Matryoshka
episodes.overview: Russell seeks justice. Meanwhile, Gabriel must make a difficult choice. Lastly, the Blake siblings reunite.

episodes.title: What You Take With You
episodes.overview: Bellamy must venture into enemy territory with an unlikely companion. Meanwhile, Octavia is forced to confront her past.

episodes.title: The Old Man and the Anomaly
episodes.overview: Octavia and Diyoza make their way to the mysterious anomaly in search of the Old Man. Meanwhile, Murphy has an offer for Emori.

episodes.title: Nevermind
episodes.overview: Clarke's past catches up to her.

episodes.title: Memento Mori
episodes.overview: Diyoza learns more about the mysterious Children of Gabriel while Abby continues searching for a way to save Kane.

episodes.title: The Gospel of Josephine
episodes.overview: Jordan investigates Sanctum. Meanwhile, Octavia and Diyoza discover the threats of the new planet firsthand. Lastly, Bellamy and Clarke butt heads.

episodes.title: The Face Behind the Glass
episodes.overview: Clarke embraces the traditions of Sanctum and tries to make amends for her past actions.

episodes.title: The Children of Gabriel
episodes.overview: Clarke tries to win over the leaders of Sanctum in order to let her people stay. Meanwhile, Bellamy, Echo and Octavia discover a new threat while on a mission to retrieve the transport ship.

episodes.title: Red Sun Rising
episodes.overview: The team on the ground flights to survive the threat they face on the new planet. Meanwhile, Raven must join forces with an unlikely ally to save everyone on board the Mothership.

episodes.title: Sanctum
episodes.overview: Still reeling after receiving Monty's message, a small group goes down to explore the mysterious new planet. Back on the Mothership, several members of Wonkru face the consequences of their decisions.

episodes.title: Damocles - Part Two
episodes.overview: Clarke and her friends must risk everything to fight one last battle for survival, only to glimpse an even darker threat to the last living valley on Earth.

episodes.title: Damocles - Part One
episodes.overview: Octavia leads her people into war. While behind enemy lines, our heroes must overcome their differences to save Wonkru from extinction.

episodes.title: The Dark Year
episodes.overview: As Clarke races to save Abby, she learns more about the trials and tribulations Wonkru faced in the bunker, and the impossible decisions they were forced to make in the dark year.

episodes.title: The Warriors Will
episodes.overview: Monty strives to show Wonkru an alternative to war, and to the valley itself. Meanwhile, Abby's health continues to deteriorate, along with McCreary's patience.

episodes.title: Sic Semper Tyrannis
episodes.overview: The growing fractures in Wonkru threaten to explode once and for all. Meanwhile, in Shadow Valley, Murphy starts a fire, unleashing catastrophic results.

episodes.title: How We Get to Peace
episodes.overview: Clarke's determination to protect Madi puts Bellamy in an impossible position.

episodes.title: Acceptable Losses
episodes.overview: Clarke and Bellamy make a startling discovery about Wonkru's battle plans as Echo risks her friendship with Raven to complete her mission.

episodes.title: Exit Wounds
episodes.overview: Kane's attempt to prove himself useful tests Wonkru's allegiance to Octavia. Madi faces an unexpected threat inside Wonkru, forcing Clarke to make an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: Shifting Sands
episodes.overview: Octavia leads her people towards Shallow Valley against the advice of Clarke and Bellamy. Meanwhile, Kane and Abby adjust to a new set of challenges.

episodes.title: Pandora's Box
episodes.overview: Our heroes are forced to rely on the help of Shallow Valley's dangerous new inhabitants in order to save some of their own, with surprising results.

episodes.title: Sleeping Giants
episodes.overview: Bellamy leads the charge investigating a potential way home. Meanwhile, Clarke and Madi deal with the new, uncertain threat to their home.

episodes.title: Red Queen
episodes.overview: Octavia is forced to take guidance from an unlikely ally when the future of the bunker and all those inside it is jeopardized.

episodes.title: Eden
episodes.overview: Clarke struggles to survive on a desolate, scorched earth while her friends in space come across a long-awaited beacon of hope.

episodes.title: Praimfaya
episodes.overview: It's a race against the end of the world as Praimfaya arrives forcing our heroes to make impossible decisions to ensure their survival.

episodes.title: The Chosen
episodes.overview: Jaha and Kane disagree over how to handle their grim reality. Meanwhile, Clarke leads a group to save a friend.

episodes.title: The Other Side
episodes.overview: Clarke faces the consequences of her fateful choice.

episodes.title: Die All, Die Merrily
episodes.overview: Octavia fights in the final battle for her people's survival, but not everyone is willing to play fair.

episodes.title: DNR
episodes.overview: Jasper and Bellamy go on a quest. Meanwhile, Clarke struggles to keep the peace after word of Jaha's discovery spreads.

episodes.title: God Complex
episodes.overview: After a disappointing discovery, Clarke and Abby question how far they're willing to go. Meanwhile, Jaha finds a lead to the mysterious Second Dawn.

episodes.title: Gimme Shelter
episodes.overview: Clarke's arrival on the island quickly takes a turn for the worse. Meanwhile, Bellamy tries to avoid further tragedy in Arkadia.

episodes.title: We Will Rise
episodes.overview: Clarke and Roan must work together in hostile territory in order to deliver an invaluable asset to Abby and her team.

episodes.title: The Tinder Box
episodes.overview: Clarke makes a desperate plea with a former allied force in an attempt to avoid a war and ensure the survival of her people.

episodes.title: A Lie Guarded
episodes.overview: Continued struggles with leadership and trust in Arkadia and Polis take violent turns while Abby leads a team to a distant location hoping to find answers.

episodes.title: The Four Horsemen
episodes.overview: Jaha leads Clarke and Bellamy down a road to possible salvation while tension rise in Arcadia and Polis.

episodes.title: Heavy Lies the Crown
episodes.overview: The burden of leading weights heavily upon Clarke and Bellamy when different challenges force them to determine who will live and die.

episodes.title: Echoes
episodes.overview: Clarke and her friends struggle with how to proceed after the fate of the world is revealed.

episodes.title: Perverse Instantiation - Part Two
episodes.overview: In the season's epic and mind-bending conclusion, our heroes begin to face the reality of their tragic situation. Everyone prepares for a final showdown.

episodes.title: Perverse Instantiation - Part One
episodes.overview: Clarke finds hope in the most unlikely place. Meanwhile, Alie's master plan comes together.

episodes.title: Red Sky at Morning
episodes.overview: Clarke, Bellamy, Octavia and Jasper hit a tragic roadblock. Meanwhile, Raven and Monty make an important discovery.

episodes.title: Join or Die
episodes.overview: Clarke is on a mission that could change everything. Meanwhile, Murphy gains insight that might prove useful in ensuring his survival. Lastly, Kane reaches a breaking point.

episodes.title: Demons
episodes.overview: Jaha returns to Polis, and Murphy has a surprise encounter. Meanwhile, Octavia uncovers a clue.

episodes.title: Nevermore
episodes.overview: Alie forces Raven's dark side to come out, and Jasper's anger continues to grow. Meanwhile, Octavia wrestles with her place in the world, and Monty is forced to make a split second decision.

episodes.title: Fallen
episodes.overview: Jaha employs a terrifying new method to convince Abby to join his cause, Kane is on a mission, and Bellamy is hit with a hard truth. Meanwhile, Monty finds himself in a precarious situation, and Jasper rushes to save one of his own.

episodes.title: Stealing Fire
episodes.overview: Clarke discovers a shocking truth, and Octavia is forced to make a decision that could have devastating consequences. Meanwhile, Kane and Abby share a moment.

episodes.title: Terms and Conditions
episodes.overview: Kane is searching for a peaceful way to handle things but soon realizes he may be forced to resort to drastic measures. Meanwhile, Pike suspects that there may be a leak within the walls of Arkadia. Lastly, Raven has a plan and reaches out to Jasper for help.

episodes.title: Thirteen
episodes.overview: Lexa tries to maintain peace within the clans; Clarke discovers an unusual and game-changing truth; flashbacks reveal a dark chapter of humanity's past.

episodes.title: Bitter Harvest
episodes.overview: Clarke is torn between vengeance and mercy. Meanwhile, Kane and Octavia work together to avert a disaster, and Abby continues to worry about Raven.

episodes.title: Hakeldama
episodes.overview: Clarke's hope for peace are dashed by a new threat. Raven becomes a target. Meanwhile, Murphy is running a dangerous con.

episodes.title: Watch the Thrones
episodes.overview: Clarke discovers the mastermind behind a devious plan. Kane struggles to keep the peace. Meanwhile, Jasper's grief drives him to reckless behavior.

episodes.title: Ye Who Enter Here
episodes.overview: Clarke wrestles with a decision. Bellamy learns that something isn't what it seems.

episodes.title: Wanheda: Part Two
episodes.overview: Bellamy and Kane risk life and limb to rescue Clarke. In an attempt to avoid worrying about her daughter, Abby focuses on whether to open Mount Weather as a medical facility. Meanwhile, Murphy plots to betray his former Chancellor.

episodes.title: Wanheda: Part One
episodes.overview: Three months have passed since the tragedy at Mount Weather and our heroes learn that a bounty has been put on Clarke's head. Unbeknownst to Clarke, a team led by Bellamy and Kane journeys deep into Grounder territory to save her. Meanwhile, Murphy finds his way to the mansion and discovers a very different Jaha on a very different mission.

episodes.title: Blood Must Have Blood, Part Two
episodes.overview: The journey to the City of Light continues, and Jaha makes a move that shocks Murphy. Clarke receives help from an unexpected source, a visitor surprises Octavia, and Lincoln gets his revenge. Meanwhile, at Mount Weather, Cage moves forward with his mission and Bellamy and the group struggle to break free.

episodes.title: Blood Must Have Blood, Part One
episodes.overview: Clarke and Lexa prepare for battle, while Raven and Wick experience a major setback. Meanwhile, Octavia and Lincoln are each forced to make a difficult decision. At Mount Weather, Jasper and Maya witness a horrible act, Bellamy follows through on a promise and Cage goes public with powerful information.

episodes.title: Bodyguard of Lies
episodes.overview: While preparing for battle, Clarke and Lexa have a heated discussion. Desperate for help, Raven has Wick summoned to the engineering room. Jaha and Murphy encounter a perilous roadblock. Meanwhile, at Mount Weather, Bellamy is in a race against time.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Clarke begins to question Lexa's leadership decisions. Abby struggles to help an injured Kane. Indra continues to push Octavia. Meanwhile, at Mount Weather, Jasper steps up into the role of leader, and Cage throws Maya into a life threatening situation.

episodes.title: Rubicon
episodes.overview: Tensions between Clarke and Abby come to a head after Clarke crosses the line. Raven helps Bellamy navigate Mount Weather. Jaha and Murphy encounter a stranger who may not be what she seems. Octavia is prepared to fight for someone she loves. Meanwhile, things reach a breaking point at Mount Weather.

episodes.title: Coup de Grâce
episodes.overview: Bellamy and Lincoln's attempt to sneak into Mount Weather has brutal consequences. Abby fights to stay in control as Clarke steps up in her new leadership role. Meanwhile, with Monty and Harper still missing, a desperate Jasper confronts President Wallace and demands answers.

episodes.title: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.overview: Lives are at risk as Clarke and Lexa encounter a new enemy. Bellamy and Lincoln agree to work together to break into Mount Weather. Murphy helps Jaha confront his past. Meanwhile, Indra makes Octavia an offer she can't refuse.

episodes.title: Remember Me
episodes.overview: Clarke strikes a deal with Lexa and Indra. Abby and Kane begin to realize that decision making powers are out of their hands. A seething Raven is unable to control her emotions. A bold move threatens to destroy the newly formed alliance between the sky people and the Grounders, and a familiar face haunts Clarke. Meanwhile, back at Mount Weather, Monty comes up with a risky plan.

episodes.title: Spacewalker
episodes.overview: Clarke returns to Camp Jaha with devastating news. Finn struggles with the aftermath of his actions. Abby gathers information from an unlikely source and prepares for a fight. Meanwhile, flashbacks reveal Finn and Raven's relationship on the Ark. I

episodes.title: Long Into an Abyss
episodes.overview: Abby is determined to find a way to protect her people from a coming attack by the Grounders, even if it means heading into unknown territory and leaving some captives behind. A worried Bellamy convinces Clarke to go with him to the drop ship, where he and Octavia reveal a dangerous secret. Clarke comes up with a bold new plan to stop the Grounders' attack, leading Abby to a desperate decision. Meanwhile, at Mount Weather, Jasper and Monty begin to question the motives of their new friends, while Dr. Tsing conducts a deadly experiment to determine how to make use of the captives.

episodes.title: Fog of War
episodes.overview: Tensions run high between Clarke and Finn, while Raven discovers that Mount Weather is interfering with their communication systems. Meanwhile, Jasper and Monty discover the truth about what's going on at Mount Weather and Octavia comes face-to-face with her worst nightmare. Finally, President Dante Wallace is about to be betrayed by those closest to him.

episodes.title: Human Trials
episodes.overview: Kane leads a mission to make peace with the Grounders. Meanwhile, Jasper agrees to participate in a risky experiment, Lincoln enters a world of pain and President Dante Wallace issues a warning. Finally, Finn's search for Clarke takes a violent turn.

episodes.title: Many Happy Returns
episodes.overview: After being betrayed by someone she thought she could trust, Clarke takes matters into her own hands and proves she's not going down without a flight. Bellamy, Finn and Murphy race against time to save a stranger. Meanwhile, tensions rise between Raven and Wick while working together, and an unexpected reunion occurs.

episodes.title: Reapercussions
episodes.overview: When Clarke discovers a horrifying project being carried out in Mount Weather's medical ward, she joins forces with an unlikely ally. After Abby confesses to committing a crime, Kane issues an order to have her brutally punished. Meanwhile, Monty warns a distracted Jasper that Clarke could be in trouble, and Octavia continues to fight for Lincoln.

episodes.title: Inclement Weather
episodes.overview: Suspicious Clarke confronts President Dante Wallace and demands answers. Kane interrogates one of The 100, and Abby performs emergency surgery. Meanwhile, Octavia resorts to violence to find Lincoln. Thomas McDonell, Bob Morley, Devon Bostick, Lindsey Morgan, Chris Larkin and Isaiah Washington also star.

episodes.title: The 48
episodes.overview: Picking up where the season one finale ended, Clarke is still alone in the white room, frantically trying to make sense of her bizarre surroundings, while the fate of Bellamy, Finn and Raven is still unknown. Lincoln and Octavia's daring plan is thwarted and an enemy returns. Meanwhile, Abby, Kane and the survivors of the Ark must face physical and moral dilemmas in their dangerous and beautiful new world. Finally, Jaha makes a heroic decision.

episodes.title: We Are Grounders - Part II
episodes.overview: Clarke pleads with Bellamy to do the right thing as conflict on the ground comes to a head. Bellamy forces Octavia to make a difficult decision. Raven and Jasper work against time and Finn makes a bold move. Meanwhile, the situation on the Ark comes to a stunning conclusion.

episodes.title: We Are Grounders - Part I
episodes.overview: Clarke and Finn escape one dangerous situation only to find themselves faced with a new enemy. Bellamy makes a heroic move to save Jasper. Raven faces a new danger, and Murphy finally gets his revenge. Meanwhile, those remaining on the Ark are coming to terms with the inevitable.

episodes.title: The Calm
episodes.overview: With a low food supply at camp, Clarke and Finn lead a group out to hunt for food and wind up in a compromising position. With Finn's life in danger, Clarke makes a game-changing decision. Meanwhile, Raven makes Bellamy an offer he can't refuse. On the Ark - Kane risks his life and is reunited with Chancellor Jaha and Abby.

episodes.title: I Am Become Death
episodes.overview: Murphy returns to camp claiming to have been held captive and tortured by the Grounders, and Clarke and Bellamy have very different opinions on how to handle his return. Octavia sneaks away to find Lincoln and returns with a serious warning for the 100. Meanwhile, a mysterious virus strikes camp forcing many to be quarantined, and Jasper pulls off a heroic move.

episodes.title: Unity Day
episodes.overview: Clarke and Finn attempt to broker peace with the Grounders but all hell breaks loose when Bellamy, Jasper and Raven show up armed and ready for battle. Octavia and Lincoln grow closer. Meanwhile, tragedy strikes during the Unity Day celebration on the Ark.

episodes.title: Day Trip
episodes.overview: Clarke and Bellamy go on a mission to find supplies for approaching winter. Some of the 100 accidentally eat nuts with powerfully hallucinogenic properties and lose their grasp on reality. Meanwhile, Octavia seizes the opportunity to help a friend escape, and a terrifying event brings Clarke and Bellamy closer. On the Ark, Commander Shumway secretly assigns one of the 100 to kill one of his own, and the treacherous actions of Diane Sydney are revealed.

episodes.title: Contents Under Pressure
episodes.overview: Clarke and Raven make contact with the Ark, and Abby guides Clarke through a dangerous procedure in a desperate move to save one of their own. Meanwhile, on the Ark, Abby is removed from the council, and former Chancellor Diana Sydney takes her place. Jaha reveals to Abby that there are not enough drop ships for everyone on the Ark to go down to Earth, and Kane begins to deal with his guilt over his recent decision.

episodes.title: His Sister's Keeper
episodes.overview: Bellamy leads his crew into Grounder territory as they search for Octavia. Raven can't help but notice the deep connection between Finn and Clarke. Meanwhile, flashbacks reveal Bellamy's and Octavia's childhood on the Ark.

episodes.title: Twilight's Last Gleaming
episodes.overview: Clarke's newfound romance with Finn is threatened. Octavia suffers a blow to the head and wakes up to find a Grounder watching her. On the Ark, Abby exposes Kane's plan to reduce the population of the Ark. Jaha and Abby notice a signal and realize at least some of the 100 must still be alive on Earth.

episodes.title: Murphy's Law
episodes.overview: After the shocking death of one of their own, Clarke and Finn grow closer as they try to figure out a way to communicate with the Ark. Bellamy must keep the group from turning on one another as life on Earth takes a desperate turn. Meanwhile, Abby risks having herself floated in order to give Raven the chance to stow-away in the escape pod bound for Earth.

episodes.title: Earth Kills
episodes.overview: In a desperate attempt to treat Jasper's festering wounds, Clarke, Finn and Wells set out in search of a seaweed antibiotic. Bellamy and his crew go hunting for food, and are joined by Charlotte, a lovable 13-year-old, who feels safe under Bellamy's protection. A thick, acidic fog appears, forcing Clarke, Finn and Wells to seek shelter inside an ancient van. While they are trapped, Clarke confronts Wells on his betrayal that resulted in her father's death.

episodes.title: Earth Skills
episodes.overview: Having discovered that Jasper may still be alive, Clarke, Bellamy, Octavia, Finn and Monty set out on a mission to locate their friend and are shocked at what they find. Meanwhile, on the Ark, Abby is determined to get to Earth, and enlists Raven to craft an escape pod.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: Ninety-seven years ago, nuclear Armageddon decimated planet Earth, destroying civilization. The only survivors were the 400 inhabitants of 12 international space stations that were in orbit at the time. Three generations have been born in space, the survivors now number 4,000, and resources are running out on their dying "Ark." Among the 100 young exiles are Clarke, the bright teenage daughter of the Ark's chief medical officer; the daredevil Finn ; the brother/sister duo of Bellamy and Octavia, whose illegal sibling status has always led them to flaunt the rules, the lighthearted Jasper and the resourceful Monty. Technologically blind to what's happening on the planet below them, the Ark's leaders - Clarke's widowed mother, Abby ; Chancellor Jaha ; and his shadowy second in command, Kane - are faced with difficult decisions about life, death and the continued existence of the human race.

title: 13 Reasons Why
overview: High school student Clay Jensen lands in the center of a series of heartbreaking mysteries set in motion by a friend's tragic suicide.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.overview: Strengthened by the struggles they've endured, the friends say goodbye to high school and look toward the future in an emotional series finale.

episodes.title: Prom
episodes.overview: When the dean begins a new investigation and threatens to cancel prom, the friends decide to confide in their parents ... but not about everything.

episodes.title: Acceptance/Rejection
episodes.overview: In the wake of the lockdown, the school is on edge — and a troubling abuse of power pushes the students to take action.

episodes.title: College Interview
episodes.overview: Clay's mental health continues to decline as the friends wrestle with difficult emotions during their college admissions interviews.

episodes.title: Thursday
episodes.overview: The school goes into lockdown, and Clay, Tony and Justin worry about Tyler's whereabouts.

episodes.title: House Party
episodes.overview: The Jensens make the boys take a drug test. When the Liberty parents learn about an upcoming party, Clay suspects that they're tracking the students.

episodes.title: Senior Camping Trip
episodes.overview: Clay is forced to confront his anxiety on the senior camping trip as a suspicious email threatens to turn the friends against each other.

episodes.title: Valentine's Day
episodes.overview: As the school gears up for the Love Is Love dance on Valentine's Day, disturbing phone calls keep Clay from getting in the spirit.

episodes.title: College Tour
episodes.overview: After an incident at school, Clay thinks someone's trying to set him up. Zach and Clay land in hot water during a college tour.

episodes.title: Winter Break
episodes.overview: The police question Tyler about the guns, leaving the friends rattled. Winston transfers to Liberty High after getting expelled from Hillcrest.

episodes.title: Let the Dead Bury the Dead
episodes.overview: Clay is released on bail, Ani puts a plan to exonerate him into action, and the truth about Bryce's murder finally comes to light.

episodes.title: And Then the Hurricane Hit
episodes.overview: The pressure of Clay's arrest leads his friends to make risky decisions, and the full story of the brawl that erupted at homecoming emerges.

episodes.title: There Are a Few Things I Haven't Told You
episodes.overview: As the cops close in on Clay -- their main suspect -- violent confrontations at the homecoming game expose that everyone had a reason to kill Bryce.

episodes.title: The World Closing In
episodes.overview: Hannah's mother returns to town. Urging Clay to protect himself, she reveals that there was more to Tony and Bryce's relationship than Clay knew.

episodes.title: Always Waiting for the Next Bad News
episodes.overview: The cops name Clay as a person of interest in the murder. Ani catches Justin in a lie after learning Bryce bailed him out of a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: In High School, Even on a Good Day, It's Hard to Tell Who's on Your Side
episodes.overview: Mr. Porter interviews students about Clay, who pleads his innocence to Mrs. Walker. Learning Porter counseled Bryce, Clay and Ani question his motives.

episodes.title: There Are a Number of Problems with Clay Jensen
episodes.overview: The police interrogate Justin and Clay about the night Clay pulled a gun on Bryce. Clay discovers that Ani and Bryce's bond ran deeper than he realized.

episodes.title: You Can Tell the Heart of a Man by How He Grieves
episodes.overview: The police bring in Tony for questioning. At Bryce's funeral, Ani uncovers two damning secrets.

episodes.title: Nobody's Clean
episodes.overview: The police search the school after finding steroids in Bryce's car. Alex remembers how Bryce supported Alex after Jessica dumped him.

episodes.title: Angry, Young and Man
episodes.overview: After Tyler admits he still has a gun, the group keeps tabs on him at school. But their worry deepens when they learn he had a motive to kill Bryce.

episodes.title: The Good Person Is Indistinguishable from the Bad
episodes.overview: As the police investigation sets the school on edge, Ani remembers that Jessica confronted Bryce. Growing suspicious of Jess, Ani and Clay follow her.

episodes.title: If You're Breathing, You're a Liar
episodes.overview: After learning about Chloe's pregnancy, Clay and Ani pay her a visit. Chloe recalls how she leaned on Zach for support -- and that Bryce never knew.

episodes.title: Yeah. I'm the New Girl
episodes.overview: The cops question Clay about Bryce's disappearance. Clay remembers the aftermath of Spring Fling, when he raced to cover Tyler's tracks and met Ani.

episodes.title: Bye
episodes.overview: One month later, Hannah's loved ones celebrate her life and find comfort in each other. Meanwhile, a brutal assault pushes one student over the edge.

episodes.title: The Box of Polaroids
episodes.overview: Threats against Clay and the others escalate. Tyler faces disciplinary action. Justin testifies about Bryce, putting his own future at risk.

episodes.title: Bryce and Chloe
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts at school in the aftermath of Bryce's testimony. Jessica tells Chloe about the clubhouse. Alex's memories come rushing back.

episodes.title: Smile, Bitches!
episodes.overview: Tony opens up about his past. Sheri devises a plan to get into the clubhouse. Mr. Porter tries to help Justin. Zach and Bryce butt heads.

episodes.title: The Missing Page
episodes.overview: Tyler goes out with Cyrus's sister. Chloe confronts Bryce about the tapes. Jess wonders if she's ready to date again. Mr. Porter wrestles with regret.

episodes.title: The Little Girl
episodes.overview: When Hannah's parents come under scrutiny, Jessica reaches out to Mrs. Baker. Justin struggles to stay clean. Clay reconnects with Skye.

episodes.title: The Third Polaroid
episodes.overview: Alex blows up at Bryce. Someone blackmails Marcus. Clay testifies about a night he and Hannah spent together. Jessica experiences a flashback.

episodes.title: The Smile at the End of the Dock
episodes.overview: Clay tries to figure out where the Polaroids were taken. Justin shows up at school. Zach's revelation about Hannah takes everyone by surprise.

episodes.title: The Chalk Machine
episodes.overview: Tyler and Cyrus embrace their outsider status. Alex fights to recover his lost memories. Ryan and Mrs. Baker look to Hannah's poems for clues.

episodes.title: The Second Polaroid
episodes.overview: Clay hides a secret from his parents. Concerned about his reputation, Marcus lies in court. Jessica and Alex skip school together.

episodes.title: The Drunk Slut
episodes.overview: Worried about threats against them, Alex and Clay urge Jessica to testify about Bryce. Clay enlists Tony's help to find a potential witness.

episodes.title: Two Girls Kissing
episodes.overview: Courtney makes a brave decision. Clay's memories of Hannah drive a wedge between him and Skye. Someone trashes the yearbook office.

episodes.title: The First Polaroid
episodes.overview: Five months after Hannah's death, the case against Liberty goes to trial, with Tyler as the first witness. Clay finds a troubling photo in his locker.

episodes.title: Tape 7, Side A
episodes.overview: Hannah seeks help from Mr. Porter, the school counselor. Clay plays the new tape for Tony and weighs what to do next.

episodes.title: Tape 6, Side B
episodes.overview: Hannah winds up at a party after an argument with her parents. The students are served with subpoenas, and Justin wrestles with conflicting loyalties.

episodes.title: Tape 6, Side A
episodes.overview: Clay and Hannah grow closer. While Clay spends a heartbreaking night listening to his tape with Tony, tensions boil over at Bryce's house.

episodes.title: Tape 5, Side B
episodes.overview: A distraught Hannah gets a ride home from the party. Jessica's behavior grows increasingly erratic, and Clay learns the truth behind a tragedy.

episodes.title: Tape 5, Side A
episodes.overview: Hannah witnesses a traumatic event at a summertime party. Clay tries to reason with Justin, and Marcus warns him that the worst is yet to come.

episodes.title: Tape 4, Side B
episodes.overview: Inspired by a friend's poetry reading, Hannah pours her heart out. Tony confides in Clay about the night of Hannah's death.

episodes.title: Tape 4, Side A
episodes.overview: Another student sabotages Hannah during a class project. Clay's nightmares about Hannah spill over into the daytime.

episodes.title: Tape 3, Side B
episodes.overview: Hannah's date on Valentine's Day doesn't go as planned. Alex gets in a big fight at school and has to face the honor board.

episodes.title: Tape 3, Side A
episodes.overview: Hannah and Clay connect at the school dance, but a crass rumor ruins the mood. Clay takes Courtney to visit Hannah's grave.

episodes.title: Tape 2, Side B
episodes.overview: Hannah thinks someone is stalking her and sets a trap. Hannah's mother confronts the principal, and Clay strikes back at someone who wronged Hannah.

episodes.title: Tape 2, Side A
episodes.overview: Jealousy and gossip take a toll on Hannah's relationships. As Alex struggles with feelings of regret, the guys pressure Clay into getting drunk.

episodes.title: Tape 1, Side B
episodes.overview: Hannah makes friends with Jessica and Alex, two other new students. Justin doesn't show up at school, and Hannah's mother finds something troubling.

episodes.title: Tape 1, Side A
episodes.overview: As the school mourns the death of Hannah Baker, her friend Clay receives a box of tapes with messages she recorded before she committed suicide.

overview: When mysterious events change the course of an immigrant ship headed for New York in 1899, a mind-bending riddle unfolds for its bewildered passengers.

episodes.title: The Key
episodes.overview: Maura tells the passengers an unbelievable truth. Then, their memories shift and Daniel changes a code. Maura faces an unexpected reality.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.overview: Daniel asks Maura for something she doesn't understand. Olek and Ling Yi steer the ship before a tragedy occurs. Elliot's identity comes to light.

episodes.title: The Pyramid
episodes.overview: Tove has scary flashbacks and wants to kill the boy. Daniel follows Maura and the captain into a strange place. Maura's father appears with a message.

episodes.title: The Calling
episodes.overview: Maura has terrible flashbacks and makes a shocking move. A sound leads some passengers to jump overboard. Maura makes a discovery about her father.

episodes.title: The Fight
episodes.overview: Several crew members and passengers search the ship for the boy after locking up the captain, Olek, Jérôme and Ramiro. Krester's secret is revealed.

episodes.title: The Fog
episodes.overview: A girl and other passengers suffer a terrible fate. Olek frees Ling Yi from a box. The captain makes a discovery that challenges his trust in Maura.

episodes.title: The Boy
episodes.overview: The captain experiences unexplainable flashbacks. A strange man follows Maura to her cabin where a boy is hiding. A bug leads to a tragedy on deck.

episodes.title: The Ship
episodes.overview: Maura helps a pregnant woman. The captain makes a brave decision after receiving a message from a lost ship — and discovers something mind-bending.

title: 3 Body Problem
overview: Across continents and decades, five brilliant friends make earth-shattering discoveries as the laws of science unravel and an existential threat emerges.

episodes.title: Wallfacer
episodes.overview: A high-level operation upends Saul's life. With emotions and expectations high, the probe launches into space as humanity enters a daunting new era.

episodes.title: Only Advance
episodes.overview: A bold proposition for the Staircase Project puts the group at odds. Will weighs his options. Ye returns to a familiar place.

episodes.title: The Stars Our Destination
episodes.overview: With the world in a state of panic following a momentous declaration, Wade gathers the world's greatest minds to prepare a defense plan.

episodes.title: Judgment Day
episodes.overview: As threat levels rise, a secret mission to retrieve enemy intel ventures into dangerous territory. An ominous message reaches Earth.

episodes.title: Our Lord
episodes.overview: Jin seeks justice after a death rattles the group. Investigators learn of an extremist group devoted to an otherworldly entity ahead of a major summit.

episodes.title: Destroyer of Worlds
episodes.overview: Obsessed with their virtual reality quest, Jin and Jack race to solve a complex riddle — but advancing to the next level brings harrowing consequences.

episodes.title: Red Coast
episodes.overview: Auggie's countdown jeopardizes her nanotech work. Jin becomes engrossed in an otherworldly VR game. Ye Wenjie follows through on a radical idea.

episodes.title: Countdown
episodes.overview: Unsettling events put a group of brilliant friends on edge as a mystery unravels with origins tracing back to China during the Cultural Revolution.

title: Ahsoka
overview: Former Jedi Knight Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

episodes.title: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord
episodes.overview: The heroes race to prevent Grand Admiral Thrawn's escape.

episodes.title: Part Seven: Dreams and Madness
episodes.overview: Hera must answer to the New Republic, while far, far away, a reunion takes place.

episodes.title: Part Six: Far, Far Away
episodes.overview: The search for Grand Admiral Thrawn reaches beyond the limits of the galaxy.

episodes.title: Part Five: Shadow Warrior
episodes.overview: Ahsoka confronts her past, while Hera and her allies undertake a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Part Four: Fallen Jedi
episodes.overview: Hera risks her career to help her friends while Ahsoka and Sabine confront enemies.

episodes.title: Part Three: Time to Fly
episodes.overview: Hera tangles with New Republic politics while Ahsoka and Sabine Wren voyage to a distant planet.

episodes.title: Part Two: Toil and Trouble
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and General Hera Syndulla travel to New Republic shipyards and make an unexpected discovery.

episodes.title: Part One: Master and Apprentice
episodes.overview: A valuable prisoner escapes New Republic custody; a search for answers reunites two old friends.

title: All of Us Are Dead
overview: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The students make it to the quarantine camp, each of them weighed down by tragic loss. Months later, they hang on to hope for a survivor.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Though a surprise protector provides the group safe passage to their next stop, Yoon Gwi-nam is not far behind. The military makes a grave decision.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: A disturbance at the camp shifts the military's understanding of the virus. A thunderstorm provides cover as the group agrees to keep on moving.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

title: Angel Beats!
overview: Angel Beats takes place in the afterlife and focuses on Otonashi, a boy who lost his memories of his life after dying. He is enrolled into the afterlife school and meets a girl named Yuri who invites him to join the Afterlife Battlefront — an organization she leads which fights against God. The Battlefront fight against the student council president Angel, a girl with supernatural powers.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.overview: When she awakens from her dangerous solo mission, Yuri finds her surviving friends in Battlefront seem to have found peace. In an impromptu "graduation" ceremony, they all take steps to move on to the next level of existence. But this transition seems most difficult for Otonashi, as it means losing his newly formed bond with Angel.

episodes.title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
episodes.overview: The Shadow monsters show no signs of stopping as more Battlefront members and NPCs fall victim to their strange, marauding power. Yuri takes a dangerous trip into the darkened Guild. In her search to find out just who—or what—is behind these new events, she discovers even darker secrets about herself.

episodes.title: Change the World
episodes.overview: As Hinata and Otonashi talk with Naoi, something strange happens: his shadow takes an enormous, evil form and engulf him. Weapons are powerless to stop the creature. Making matters worse, the Shadow monsters are multiplying and taking control of the members of Battlefront and the NPCs.

episodes.title: Goodbye Days
episodes.overview: Otonashi decides that the high-strung singer, Yui, needs to be pushed into finding peace and "moving on." To do so, he enlists Angel who shows him her new weapon: the dark and evil-looking Hand Sonic 5. But Yui has other plans—namely to beat the boys of Battlefront in a violent game on the soccer field.

episodes.title: In Your Memory
episodes.overview: With the Angel clone situation becoming uncontrollable, Naoi proposes that they once again call upon the genius hacker, Christ. Meanwhile, Otonashi begins to remember his past.

episodes.title: Dancer in the Dark
episodes.overview: With Otonashi's and Angel's newly formed alliance, dark and powerful clones of Angel have begun attacking the Battlefront with greater aggression. They must return to the trap-rigged Guild once more and risk heartbreaking, violent losses.

episodes.title: Alive
episodes.overview: Now that Naoi has seemingly joined Battlefront, Yui persuades Otonashi to let his powers of hypnosis help him recover his memories. But Otonashi may not be ready to remember such a tragic, painful past. But there are other issues at hand for the group—such as banding together to capture the mysterious creature from a nearby river known only as the Monster Stream.

episodes.title: Family Affair
episodes.overview: When Angel is believed to be breaking scholastic code, Naoi uses this infringement to exert his growing power and places both Angel and Otonashi in a prison within the school. They discover that Naoi is using his power in violently, and Angel and Otonashi must escape or risk heavy casualties.

episodes.title: Favorite Flavor
episodes.overview: To strip Angel of her scholastic power, Yui devises a plan for the Battlefront to replace Angel's test results with bogus ones. She will be shamed, stripped of her title of Student Body President, and be out of their way for good. But they never realize the one who replaces her may be even more sinister than Angel could ever be.

episodes.title: Day Game
episodes.overview: With the lead singer of Gldemo now obliterated, a replacement must be found. The manic, high-strung Yui tries desperately to assume the role. Hinata, meanwhile, seeks to avenge a mistake made long ago on the baseball field by assembling the strongest team possible to defeat the other teams in the school. Otonashi worries the game could strike Hinata out in more ways than one.

episodes.title: My Song
episodes.overview: With the aid of a new member, the genius hacker, "Christ", Yuri and the Battlefront decide to break into Angel's lair and steal secrets from her hard drive. To distract the NPCs, they use the girl group Gldemo. But when the teachers interfere, the lead singer suffers a shocking fate.

episodes.title: Guild
episodes.overview: Realizing they need more weapons in their battle against Angel, the group descends into the Guild. But once there, they realize that all of the hallways, staircases, and passageways have been rigged with deadly traps. It's a race against time to see if they can get through the violent maze before Angel catches up with them.

episodes.title: Departure
episodes.overview: After a mysterious accident, a young high school student wakes up to discover he is caught in some kind of violent afterlife where a strange and avenging Angel is pursuing him. Confused and afraid, he joins a band of gun-toting teens intent on destroying the Angel and taking their destinies into their own hands.

title: Arcane
overview: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

episodes.title: The Dirt Under Your Nails
episodes.overview: Magic. Science. Power. Revenge. Destinies clash in an epic final chapter, igniting an all-out war.

episodes.title: Killing Is a Cycle
episodes.overview: A brewing storm fuels a series of startling transformations. Elsewhere, the spark of rebellion still burns.

episodes.title: Pretend Like It's the First Time
episodes.overview: A moment of darkness, a moment of light — and a vision of What Could Have Been.

episodes.title: The Message Hidden Within the Pattern
episodes.overview: Healing comes from a familiar face — in an unfamiliar place. A stunning betrayal threatens to change countless lives.

episodes.title: Blisters and Bedrock
episodes.overview: Vi awakens to surprising news. An unsettling reunion isn't what it seems. Caitlyn uncovers the origins of Shimmer.

episodes.title: Paint the Town Blue
episodes.overview: As rumors of Jinx's return swirl, Ambessa pursues her target with renewed enthusiasm. Jinx and Sevika go undercover and into the belly of the beast.

episodes.title: Finally Got the Name Right
episodes.overview: Caitlyn doubles down on her hunt for Jinx. Ambessa accepts a fateful meeting. Changes in Zaun lead to a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Watch It All Burn
episodes.overview: With Piltover ready for war, the Undercity weighs its options. Jinx lies low and plots her next move. A pivotal conversation takes place.

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Crown
episodes.overview: Vi and Caitlyn wrestle with how best to respond in the wake of a terrible tragedy that claims lives — and escalates tensions between the twin cities.

episodes.title: The Monster You Created
episodes.overview: Perilously close to war, the leaders of Piltover and Zaun reach an ultimatum. But a fateful standoff changes both cities forever.

episodes.title: Oil and Water
episodes.overview: Disowned heir Mel and her visiting mother trade combat tactics. Caitlyn and Vi forge an unlikely alliance. Jinx undergoes a startling change.

episodes.title: The Boy Savior
episodes.overview: Caitlyn and Vi meet an ally in Zaun's streets and head into a frenzied battle with a common foe. Viktor makes a dire decision.

episodes.title: When These Walls Come Tumbling Down
episodes.overview: An eager protégé undermines his mentor on the council as a magical tech rapidly evolves. With authorities in pursuit, Jinx must face her past.

episodes.title: Everybody Wants to Be My Enemy
episodes.overview: Rogue enforcer Caitlyn tours the undercity to track down Silco. Jayce puts a target on his back trying to root out Piltover corruption.

episodes.title: Happy Progress Day!
episodes.overview: With Piltover prospering from their tech, Jayce and Viktor weigh their next move. A familiar face re-emerges from Zaun to wreak havoc.

episodes.title: The Base Violence Necessary for Change
episodes.overview: An epic showdown between old rivals results in a fateful moment for Zaun. Jayce and Viktor risk it all for their research.

episodes.title: Some Mysteries Are Better Left Unsolved
episodes.overview: Idealistic inventor Jayce attempts to harness magic through science — despite his mentor's warnings. Criminal kingpin Silco tests a powerful substance.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Playground
episodes.overview: Orphaned sisters Vi and Powder bring trouble to Zaun's underground streets in the wake of a heist in posh Piltover.

title: Archer
overview: Smart-mouthed superspy Sterling Archer and his dysfunctional team of secret agents turn dangerous missions into messy misadventures around the globe.

episodes.title: Into the Cold
episodes.overview: With the UN voting to outlaw independent spy agencies, Archer and the gang have to work outside the law to save the world from an unlikely duo.

episodes.title: Breaking Fabian
episodes.overview: A former adversary lends a hand as Archer and the gang bond together to try and stop a fleet of killer drones.

episodes.title: Mission Out of Control Room
episodes.overview: Lana monitors simultaneous missions in her state-of-the-art control room, but Archer and the gang experience technical difficulties.

episodes.title: Face Off
episodes.overview: Archer tries to find an elusive villain at an exclusive resort, while Lana learns some explosive truths about running a spy agency.

episodes.title: Keys Open Doors
episodes.overview: An unplanned vacation forces Lana to accompany Archer, Pam and Cyril on a mission that quickly goes off the rails. Will Lana blow the mission when she crosses the line?

episodes.title: Chill Barry
episodes.overview: Barry's back, but will he give the gang the cold shoulder in their quest to put Other Barry on ice?

episodes.title: Plaque Removal
episodes.overview: Archer, Lana and Zara travel to England to stop a thief who is stealing possibly-cursed artifacts. Can Archer break the curse before it breaks him?

episodes.title: 30 for 30
episodes.overview: Zara Khan thinks she's a real knockout, but Archer wants to prove he is just as stunning. Pam and Gillette sit back and keep score.

episodes.title: The Anglerfish Stratagem
episodes.overview: The Agency teams up with Interpol to take down a highly organized ring of jewel thieves. Archer's skeptical as their Interpol contact seems to be treating the mission as more of an audition.. but for which side?

episodes.title: Dough, Ray and Me
episodes.overview: Archer and the gang knead proof in order to temper expectations and ice the mission.

episodes.title: Distraction Action

title: Arrow
overview: Spoiled billionaire playboy Oliver Queen is missing and presumed dead when his yacht is lost at sea. He returns five years later a changed man, determined to clean up the city as a hooded vigilante armed with a bow.

episodes.title: Fadeout
episodes.overview: After eight seasons, and the launch of countless superheroes, the series wraps up the story of the Green Arrow.

episodes.title: Green Arrow & The Canaries
episodes.overview: It's the year 2040 in Star City and Mia Queen has everything she could have ever wanted. However, when Laurel and Dinah suddenly show up in her life again, things take a shocking turn and her perfect world is upended. Laurel and Dinah are tracking a kidnapping victim with direct ties to Mia and they need her help. Knowing it will change everything, Mia can't help but be a hero and she, Laurel and Dinah suit up once again to save the city.

episodes.title: Crisis on Infinite Earths: Part Four
episodes.overview: Stuck in the Vanishing Point, the Paragons search for a way to escape. The futility of the situation is compounded by The Flash's disappearance. However, hope appears in the form of Oliver, who reveals that he has become something else. Meanwhile, the origin stories for The Monitor and Anti-Monitor are revealed.

episodes.title: Purgatory
episodes.overview: Oliver, his team, and his children, travel to Lian Yu for one last mission. They face ghosts from Oliver's past, including an old friend, and Diggle questions Lyla's decisions.

episodes.title: Reset
episodes.overview: Oliver and Laurel find themselves in a time loop from the past where Quentin is still alive... and each time the loop resets with his death. The two heroes try to find a way to break the loop and determine what's going on.

episodes.title: Prochnost
episodes.overview: Oliver, Laurel, Mia, and William travel to Russia to get the plans for a weapon capable of stopping the monitor, and Oliver faces reminders of his past with the Bratva. Meanwhile, Diggle recruits an ally to help him steal the plutonium for the weapon.

episodes.title: Present Tense
episodes.overview: Present and future become one as Mia, William, and Connor meet the original Team Arrow. The two teams join forces to stop the newest Deathstroke from terrorizing Star City.

episodes.title: Leap of Faith
episodes.overview: Oliver joins his sister Thea to find answers about Mar Novu's true goals. Diggle and Lyla go on a rescue mission, and in 2040, Mia and her team go up against the Deathstrokes.

episodes.title: Welcome to Hong Kong
episodes.overview: In the present, Oliver and Diggle scour Hong Kong for a scientist the Monitor wants, and are joined by Tatsu, Laurel, and Lyla. In 2040, Zoe leads Connor and Mia to a bar where they believe JJ is going.

episodes.title: Starling City
episodes.overview: While helping the Monitor, Oliver finds himself in a twisted version of his own Earth where Tommy and Moira are alive, Moira is married to Malcolm... and Thea is dead. In 2040, the new vigilantes take on the Deathstrokes.

episodes.title: You Have Saved This City
episodes.overview: Oliver tries to save Star City and redeem Emiko. In the future, Mia and William set out to bring down Galaxy One with some help from their friends.

episodes.title: Living Proof
episodes.overview: Emiko's plans for Star City continue: Oliver is trapped, the team is wanted by the police, and Felicity is on the run.

episodes.title: Confessions
episodes.overview: Two transit guards are murdered at the scene of a Team Arrow operation, and Dinah tries to determine the truth about who killed them.

episodes.title: Spartan
episodes.overview: After the Ninth Circle steals valuable data, Diggle is forced to turn to his stepfather for help... and he blames the man for the death of his biological father. In the future, Felicity, Mia and Connor learn the extent of Galaxy One's plans.

episodes.title: Lost Canary
episodes.overview: Laurel reverts to her Black Siren ways and teams up with a new partner, Shadow Thief. Dinah puts out an arrest warrant on Laurel, but Felicity isn't convinced her friend is beyond redemption and calls in another friend to help. Meanwhile, Oliver and Spartan set out to learn who had Emiko's mother killed.

episodes.title: Inheritance
episodes.overview: Oliver learns that Emiko is concealing things from him, and tries to redeem her. The team faces a new threat--the Ninth Circle--while Laurel tries to get testimony from a reluctant witness.

episodes.title: Star City 2040
episodes.overview: In 2040, the team discover that Galaxy One is a cover for Eden Corps and that the company plans to blow up Star City. William and Mia find Felicity, and Rene decides which side that he's on.

episodes.title: Training Day
episodes.overview: Oliver and the team attempt to work for the SCPD following their procedure, but find them overly restrictive compared to what they're accustomed to. In the future, William and Mia work together to find a way to listen to the audio cassette.

episodes.title: Brothers & Sisters
episodes.overview: Diggle, Lyla, and the Ghost Initiative close in on Dante, but they soon discover that there are traitors among them. Oliver reaches out to Emiko, and in the future William reaches out to Mia.

episodes.title: Star City Slayer
episodes.overview: The Star City Slayer claims another victim, and Dinah reaches out to Captain Singh in Central City for information. William calls his grandparents, and Curtis comes to a decision about his future career.

episodes.title: Emerald Archer
episodes.overview: Oliver gives a documentary team access to him and his family as part of his new transparency, and they probe into every corner of his life--and the lives of other vigilantes in Star City--as a vigilante mask-killer shows up.

episodes.title: Past Sins
episodes.overview: Oliver and Laurel go on TV for an interview and end up making themselves targets of two separate individuals. At ARGUS, Curtis has objections to the Ghost Initiative program when Diggle and Lyla order him to monitor the bombs in the members' heads.

episodes.title: My Name is Emiko Queen
episodes.overview: Emiko goes hunting for the man who killed her mother, and gets a new partner. Meanwhile, Oliver learns about the half-sister he never knew he had, and Diggle makes Diaz a deal in return for Dante's whereabouts.

episodes.title: Elseworlds, Part 2
episodes.overview: Barry, Oliver, and Kara travel to Gotham City to try to find Deagan, and meet the city's new protector while discovering that Bruce Wayne has vanished. Meanwhile, a Flash from another world arrives to warn the heroes of what they face and who is responsible.

episodes.title: Unmasked
episodes.overview: Oliver reaccustoms himself to life out of prison, while a killer posing as the new Green Arrow kills two men. Meanwhile, Diggle and Lyle discover a secret terrorist backer and turned to an unexpected ally.

episodes.title: The Slabside Redemption
episodes.overview: Diaz enters Slabside and takes control of the place, releasing the inmates. Oliver must team up with an old enemy to stop him.

episodes.title: Due Process
episodes.overview: While Laurel tries to get Oliver released from prison, Felicity and the others join forces to capture Diaz... with help from the new Green Arrow. In the future, William and the others get a glimpse of Felicity's plans for Star City.

episodes.title: The Demon
episodes.overview: Felicity discovers that Oliver's visitation rights have been revoked, while Oliver meets an old friend on Level Two and forms an alliance. Meanwhile, Curtis has second thoughts about going out into the field as an ARGUS undercover operative, and Laurel and Dinah join forces to help Felicity.

episodes.title: Level Two
episodes.overview: A prison psychiatrist pays Oliver a visit. Meanwhile, Rene convinces Dinah to let him help her investigate a series of fires in the Glades, and Laurel warns Felicity about embrainc the darkness. In the future, William and Roy learn more about what's happening in Star City and meet a member of the Vigilante Resistance.

episodes.title: Crossing Lines
episodes.overview: Brick promises Oliver that an informer named the Demon has the information that Oliver wants... if Oliver can get to him. In Star City Felicity goes to Watson and demands her help bringing Diaz to justice, while Diaz and the Longbow Hunters invade the CDC.

episodes.title: The Longbow Hunters
episodes.overview: Diaz hires the Longbow Hunters to help him steal an ARGUS weapon. Felicity and Diggle fight over how to deal with the thieves, while in prison, Oliver finds that he has to pay a price to get the information he needs from Brick.

episodes.title: Inmate 4587
episodes.overview: In prison, Oliver tries to keep his head down and serve out his time so he can be reunited with his family. Felicity and William are in witness protection, Laurel is the city's new mayor, Rene is teaching boxing, Diggle and Curtis are working at ARGUS, and Dinah is the new police chief. While Dragon tracks down Oliver's loved one, a new vigilante calling himself Green Arrow fights the criminals of Star City.

episodes.title: Life Sentence
episodes.overview: Oliver makes a deal with the FBI to get their help taking down Diaz.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.overview: When Diaz fails to send Oliver to prison, he sends gunmen after their family. But a traitor within his ranks gives the team the edge they need to escape and go after the crime lord.

episodes.title: Docket No. 11-19-41-73
episodes.overview: Oliver goes on trial for the murders that Arrow committed as well as violating the anti-vigilante act, and only the arrival of an old friend can save him.

episodes.title: Shifting Allegiances
episodes.overview: Oliver negotiates a deal with the Bratva for Anatoly's return to Moscow, but Anatoly isn't interested. Meanwhile, Rene realizes that he can't function as part of the team after his near-death experience, and Laurel must choose between Quentin and Diaz.

episodes.title: The Dragon
episodes.overview: Diaz and Laurel travel to Bludhaven to arrange a meeting with the Quadrant--the largest criminal organization in the country. Things don't go as expect, but Diaz has a backup plan. Meanwhile, Felicity deals with not being there for Oliver as he takes a lone-wolf approach to battling Diaz.

episodes.title: Fundamentals
episodes.overview: Oliver returns to his roots after the city council threatens him with impeachment... and a figure from his past pays him a visit.

episodes.title: Brothers in Arms
episodes.overview: Oliver realizes that Diaz has subverted Hill and Armand, and faces a challenge from within what remains of the team. Meanwhile, Curtis discovers that his new boyfriend dislikes vigilantes.

episodes.title: The Thanatos Guild
episodes.overview: The Thanatos Guild, a group of assassins formed by Malcolm before he died, come to Star City in search of a map. Nyssa comes to the city to ask Thea to help her stop Malcolm's legacy.

episodes.title: Doppelganger
episodes.overview: Oliver learns that the DA has another witness against him--Roy Harper. Team Arrow set out to find Roy and learn if someone is coercing him to testify. Meanwhile, Black Siren passes herself off as Laurel and claims that she's been in captivity for two years.

episodes.title: Collision Course
episodes.overview: Thea discovers that Quentin has been hiding Black Siren, and Team Arrow comes to get her and find out where the missing money is. However, the Outsiders follow them and the two teams come to blows.

episodes.title: The Devil's Greatest Trick
episodes.overview: Felicity and Alena find the proof showing that Oliver didn't kill Cayden's son... and Cayden demands that the heroes turn over his three former allies, believing one of them is responsible.

episodes.title: All for Nothing
episodes.overview: Vince undertakes a risky mission to obtain the location of the thermobaric bomb for Team Arrow. Meanwhile, Dinah remembers how she met Vince and how they gained their powers.

episodes.title: We Fall
episodes.overview: Cayden begins a campaign of terror against Star City, using his hack of the city's Internet to take over its electronic systems. The two teams try to stop him, while William learns that Oliver is still Green Arrow.

episodes.title: Divided
episodes.overview: Arrow discovers who Cayden's allies are, and realizes that he's badly outnumbered. However, Curtis, Rene, and Dinah have their own plans. Meanwhile, Quentin worries about getting through to Black Siren while Cayden worries about Vigilante's loyalties.

episodes.title: Irreconcilable Differences
episodes.overview: Cayden has Black Siren abduct Quentin to force Arrow to recover and hand over an amplifier. Meanwhile, Oliver discovers that someone on the team has betrayed him to the FBI.

episodes.title: Crisis on Earth-X, Part 2
episodes.overview: Barry and Iris's wedding brings the gang together, but things go awry when villains from Earth-X attack the ceremony. Oliver and the others square off against their counterparts from Earth-X and discover that they're counterparts of Oliver and Kara... and Reverse-Flash, from before his death.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: Samanda arrests Oliver for being Green Arrow, and Cayden and Black Siren launch an attack on Thanksgiving. Meanwhile, Curtis' treatment of Diggle backfires, and Oliver wishes that Thea would wake up.

episodes.title: Promises Kept
episodes.overview: While Oliver questions Slade's loyalty, Team Arrow goes after a new drug dealer named Dragon... and only Diggle knows that Dragon manufactures the steroid that he's using.

episodes.title: Deathstroke Returns
episodes.overview: Slade asks for Oliver's help rescuing Slade's son Joe from a Kasnian prison. Meanwhile, Dinah discovers Vigilante's secret identity and vows to Diggle she will bring him in no matter what.

episodes.title: Reversal
episodes.overview: Black Siren kills three seemingly unrelated Star City residents, and the team tries to figure out why. Meanwhile, Alena comes to Felicity asking for help with Cayden James, and Oliver deals with having retired as Green Arrow.

episodes.title: Next of Kin
episodes.overview: Diggle has trouble making the tough calls as the new Green Arrow, and his hesitancy may put hundreds of lives in danger when an ex-CIA agent leads a team of former agents on a raid to steal nerve gas. Meanwhile, Oliver asks Felicity to tutor William in math.

episodes.title: Tribute
episodes.overview: After the photo of Oliver as Green Arrow is released, the FBI launch an investigation. Meanwhile, a former friend abducts Markovian businessmen in Star City to invest in the future.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.overview: Five months later, Oliver adapts to a new role while Black Siren launches an attack on the police and the team.

episodes.title: Lian Yu
episodes.overview: Oliver frees Slade and Digger from the supermax to help him defeat Adrian, but things soon go wrong. Meanwhile, Adrian claims that William is dead to get Oliver to reveal that he's the killer that Adrian has always claimed.

episodes.title: Missing
episodes.overview: To force Oliver to get him out of prison, Adrian has his allies capture Curtis, Quentin, Thea, Felicity, and Diggle. Oliver has no choice but to gather new allies to stop Adrian and his team.

episodes.title: Honor Thy Fathers
episodes.overview: Oliver receives a bizarre delivery to his office, which ultimately leads to a secret about Robert that Oliver and Thea soon wish that they'd never learned. Meanwhile, Rene faces a custody hearing for his daughter Zoe.

episodes.title: Underneath
episodes.overview: Oliver and Felicity are trapped in the bunker after Adrian seals the doors and sets off an EMP bomb. While they try to get to the surface after Oliver is badly injured, their teammates try to find a way to help them.

episodes.title: Dangerous Liaisons
episodes.overview: To get a device that will let the team locate Adrian, Felicity goes in deep with Helix. Meanwhile, Diggle discovers that Lyla is going down the same dark path that Amanda Waller did.

episodes.title: Disbanded
episodes.overview: Oliver disbands the team and makes a deal with the Bratva to eliminate Adrian. However, Diggle refuses to accept his friend's decision and Oliver soon finds himself caught between the two sides. Meanwhile, Curtis makes contact with Helix to find Felicity and expose Adrian's true identity to the world.

episodes.title: Kapiushon
episodes.overview: Adrian tortures Oliver and demands that he confess his darkest secret. In the past, Oliver and Anatoly make their move against Kovar as he plots a coup against the Russian government.

episodes.title: Checkmate
episodes.overview: Oliver learns who he's up against, and that Prometheus isn't his only enemy. Meanwhile, Felicity is forced to turn to Helix to get the information she needs to find Susan.

episodes.title: Fighting Fire with Fire
episodes.overview: While Oliver faces mayoral impeachment, Vigilante comes after him and Diggle, Wild Dog, and Mr. Terrific go after him.
