episodes.overview: The Secret of the Nyoi-BōGoku learns that there may be a way to revive his lost friends - a face-to-face meeting with the creator of the Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Final Showdown
episodes.overview: King Piccolo gains the advantage as he dissects Goku limb by limb. Will he surrender to King Piccolo or decide to fight and risk his own life?

episodes.title: The Biggest Crisis
episodes.overview: Goku is not ready to give up power to King Piccolo without a fight. It's a fierce battle, but even Goku has his limits. How much can he take?

episodes.title: Goku Strikes Back
episodes.overview: Only Goku stands between King Piccolo and the destruction of Western City. It's more than just a rematch, it's the fight to save the world!

episodes.title: Battle Cry
episodes.overview: Tien must go through Drum before he can fight King Piccolo. The problem is that Drum moves faster than all three of Tien's eyes!

episodes.title: Prelude to Vengeance
episodes.overview: King Piccolo has declared the destruction of the world, one sector at a time. First up is the Western City, home to Bulma's parents. Tien prepares to fight King Piccolo, but a new threat looms over everyone.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Goku and Yajirobe return to Korin's tower, where Goku discovers his new powers and receives another Nimbus cloud. Meanwhile, Tien has mastered the Evil Containment Wave and decides to use it against King Piccolo.

episodes.title: A Taste of Destiny
episodes.overview: Goku finally finds Darkness, the keeper of the Ultra Divine Water. After Goku proves himself worthy, Darkness allows him to drink the dangerous potion. But will it make him stronger or will he die?

episodes.title: Awaken Darkness
episodes.overview: Goku embarks on a dangerous quest to find Ultra Divine Water. One sip could mean incredible power - or a painful death!

episodes.title: Conquest and Power
episodes.overview: Goku's reunion with Master Korin is tinged with hope and disappointment as the hero learns shocking news! Meanwhile, King Piccolo tries to force King Furry's obedience by displaying a cruel brutality towards his kingdom.

episodes.title: Siege on Chow Castle
episodes.overview: King Piccolo sets out to conquer the world and he begins with the peaceful inhabitants of King Furry's realm. Meanwhile, Goku hopes to regain his strength by visiting Master Korin's Tower.

episodes.title: King Piccolo's Wish
episodes.overview: Having summoned the Eternal Dragon and with no one to oppose him, King Piccolo prepares to make a wish that, if granted, could become the world's greatest nightmare!

episodes.title: Roshi's Gambit
episodes.overview: Master Roshi answers the call for a hero by placing himself between King Piccolo and the remaining Dragon Balls. However, in his attempt to save the world, he may have to pay the ultimate price.

episodes.title: Piccolo Closes In
episodes.overview: Goku makes a final stand against the seemingly indestructable King Piccolo. As Master Roshi and others continue their pursuit of the Dragon Balls, it becomes clear that the trail leads to the dark forces of King Piccolo.

episodes.title: Goku vs. King Piccolo
episodes.overview: Goku fights for his life as King Piccolo seeks revenge for the deaths of Cymbal and Tambourine.

episodes.title: Goku's Revenge
episodes.overview: While Goku fights Tambourine to avenge Krillin's death, Master Roshi, Tien, and Chiaotzu continue their race against King Piccolo for the Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: Tien's Atonement
episodes.overview: Tambourine closes in on Goku and Yajirobe. To obtain one of the Dragon Balls, Tien must atone for the brutality of his past.

episodes.title: Terrible Tambourine
episodes.overview: Tambourine continues his campaign to slaughter the martial artists and sets his sight on Yamcha! Master Roshi embarks on a race for the Dragon Balls to stay ahead of the competition, King Piccolo and his dastardly horde.

episodes.title: Here Comes Yajirobe
episodes.overview: Goku fights for his honor after a mountain boy accuses him of stealing his fish. Meanwhile, Goku's friends desperately search for a way to stop King Piccolo's evil plan.

episodes.title: Mark of the Demon
episodes.overview: King Piccolo has sent Tambourine to kill all the warriors that could foil his plan. Goku meets a mountain man - but is he friend or foe?

episodes.title: Tambourine Attacks!
episodes.overview: King Piccolo has begun his sinister plan to conquer the world. All he needs are the seven Dragon Balls and the death of all the members of the Martial Arts Society.

episodes.title: Enter King Piccolo
episodes.overview: While Goku sets out on a quest for revenge, his friends try to discover the identity of Krillin's killer. All the clues lead to Master Roshi's past and a demon named King Piccolo!

episodes.title: The Fallen
episodes.overview: The Spirit Cannon has left both fighters weary and exhausted. With the stage destroyed, Tien and Goku plummet towards the Earth, with the one who lands first losing the fight!

episodes.title: The Spirit Cannon
episodes.overview: Tien prepares to unleash the destructive power of the Spirit Cannon!

episodes.title: Tien's Insurrection
episodes.overview: A dramatic turn of events infuriates Tien and brings him to renewed focus and determination. There is only one outcome that satisfies the proud Tien, as he unveils a sinister new attack!

episodes.title: Victory's Edge
episodes.overview: Bruised and on the brink of destruction, Goku finds himself at the mercy of Tien, as the final match in the World Martial Arts Tournament continues.  Who will win the ultimate battle?

episodes.title: Final Match: Goku vs. Tien Shinhan
episodes.overview: The final match in the 22nd World Martial Arts Tournament is about to begin! Goku faces Tien in a thrilling battle to see who will become the next Master of Martial Arts!

episodes.title: Tail's Tale
episodes.overview: The battle between Goku and Krillin comes to a head. What started as a friendly fight turns into an all-out war after Krillin pulls a sneaky stunt behind Goku's back.

episodes.title: Goku vs. Krillin
episodes.overview: In the sixth fight of the World Martial Arts Tournament, friends become enemies as Goku and Krillin go head-to-head.

episodes.title: Stepping Down
episodes.overview: The fight between Jackie Chun and Tien takes on epic proportions as they continue their struggle, using every trick and technique in the book!

episodes.title: Tien Shinhan vs. Jackie Chun
episodes.overview: The semifinal round begins with an extraordinary fight between the young Tien and the experienced champion Jackie Chun.

episodes.title: Goku Enters the Ring
episodes.overview: In the fourth fight of the quarterfinals of the tournament Goku meets Panput, the world-famous fighter and action star.

episodes.title: Counting Controversy!!
episodes.overview: Krillin has his hands full as he continues his battle against Chiaotzu, who unleashes an even deadlier attack than the Dodon Wave!

episodes.title: The Dodon Wave
episodes.overview: In the third fight of the quarterfinals Krillin faces Chiaotzu, who controls the Dodon Wave.

episodes.title: Full-Moon Vengeance
episodes.overview: Man-Wolf and Jackie Chun face each other in the second match of the quarterfinals. For Man-Wolf this fight is not about the martial arts title. It is about revenge!

episodes.title: Yamcha's Big Break
episodes.overview: The first fight in the quarterfinals is in full swing, with Yamcha challenging Tien. With these two warriors in battle, one thing is for sure: sparks will fly!

episodes.title: Yamcha vs. Tien
episodes.overview: The elimination round is over and Goku, Yamcha and Krillin are among the 8 finalists. The first round: Yamcha fights against his new rival, Tien!

episodes.title: Then There Were Eight
episodes.overview: Out of 182 fighters, only 8 will survive the elimination round. As the battles continue, Goku, Krillin and Yamcha fight to stay on top!

episodes.title: Preliminary Peril
episodes.overview: The World Martial Arts Tournament begins! Among the competitors is a dangerous opponent who almost destroyed Goku in their first encounter. Get ready for action!

episodes.title: Rivals and Arrivals
episodes.overview: Master Roshi and the rest of the gang head to the World Martial Arts Tournament but Goku is still missing. If he doesn't reach the sign-in booth on time, he won't get to compete!

episodes.title: Which Way to Papaya Island?
episodes.overview: Three years have passed since Master Roshi sent Goku off. But before the tournament begins, he must learn a difficult lesson about deception and betrayal.

episodes.title: The Rampage of InoShikaCho
episodes.overview: The monster InoShikaCho is coming for Goku!

episodes.title: Goku Goes to Demon Land
episodes.overview: Goku's journey takes him to a small village terrorized by dozens of demons. The princess of the village was kidnapped by these fearsome creatures, and the king asks Goku for his help.

episodes.title: Goku vs. Sky Dragon
episodes.overview: Goku gets into the middle of a dispute between two martial arts schools, Chin-Star and Phantom-Fang. When Goku makes enemies with Sky Dragon, the leader of Phantom Fang, he must defend the Chin-Star School in a fight to determine the master of martial arts.

episodes.title: Terror and Plague
episodes.overview: Goku gets into trouble when he meets Chao, a little girl who persuades him to save her village from the two dangerous criminals Plague and Terror.

episodes.title: The Eternal Dragon Rises
episodes.overview: Goku has collected all seven Dragon Balls! So it's off to the land of Korin to revive Upa's beloved father.

episodes.title: Pilaf's Tactics
episodes.overview: The seventh Dragon Ball is in the possession of the greedy Emperor Pilaf and secured by his mechanized arsenal! Can Goku take the last ball?

episodes.title: True Colors of the Masked Man
episodes.overview: The battle between Goku and the masked fighter concludes in an unimaginable showdown that will forever change our hero. Meanwhile, Emperor Pilaf forges a plan to steal Goku's Dragon Balls once again.

episodes.title: The Strong Ones
episodes.overview: The final battle in Fortuneteller Baba's tournament has begun, and it is quickly proving to be one for the ages!

episodes.title: The Mysterious Fifth Man
episodes.overview: The battle for the last Dragon Ball continues! Now Goku has to face the fourth fighter and his deadly Devilmite Beam.

episodes.title: The Devilmite Beam
episodes.overview: Goku has a big problem to solve: How can he defeat a 5,000-year-old mummy that has never been defeated? But this is only the third of Baba's fighters!

episodes.title: Goku's Turn
episodes.overview: Fortuneteller Baba unleashes a threat that will test the heroes' skills and bring them to the brink of destruction: the third fighter!

episodes.title: Deadly Battle
episodes.overview: How do you fight someone you can't see? That's the problem Yamcha must face as he continues his fight against an invisible man!

episodes.title: We Are the Five Warriors
episodes.overview: Krillin must face-off against a warrior with real bite!

episodes.title: Who is Fortuneteller Baba?
episodes.overview: Master Roshi sends Goku and his friends on a quest to find the mysterious Fortuneteller Baba. She possesses the power to find lost things.

episodes.title: The Last Dragon Ball
episodes.overview: Staff Officer Black is on the attack, and his sights are set on Goku. The showdown between good and evil comes to its thrilling conclusion!

episodes.title: The End of Commander Red
episodes.overview: In an attempt to acquire two Dragon Balls, Goku must face Commander Red and his soldiers. The ultimate battle between good and evil begins!

episodes.title: A Real Bind
episodes.overview: Goku's best friends have decided to help him. Can this small group of good guys conquer the legions of evil that await them?

episodes.title: Confront the Red Ribbon Army
episodes.overview: Goku makes his way to the Red Ribbon Army headquarters to take the Dragon Balls from them.

episodes.title: The Last of Mercenary Tao
episodes.overview: What will Tao find at the top of the tower? And more importantly, what awaits Goku when the angry assassin comes back down?

episodes.title: The Return of Goku
episodes.overview: The fight of the century is about to begin when Goku and Mercenary Tao face off for a rematch.

episodes.title: Sacred Water
episodes.overview: Goku pushes on in an attempt to capture the bottle of Sacred Water from Korin. Meanwhile, Mercenary Tao prepares for a rematch against Goku.

episodes.title: Korin Tower
episodes.overview: Goku attempts to climb the Korin Tower in hopes of finding the Sacred Water. Legend has it that whoever drinks it will be rewarded with amazing new powers.

episodes.title: Tao Attacks!
episodes.overview: Mercenary Tao made short work of Bora, but Goku won't prove to be so easy. Goku is determined to avenge his friend's death and hang on to the Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: The Nortorious Mercenary
episodes.overview: The Red Ribbon Army hires Mercenary Tao to eliminate Goku. The two meet on the island of Korin.

episodes.title: The Land of Korin
episodes.overview: The Red Ribbon Army tracks one of the Dragon Balls on a volcano island! However, a native is there to protect this sacred habitat and Goku is on his way as well!

episodes.title: Arale vs. Blue
episodes.overview: General Blue has a plane to catch, but not before settling an old score with our hero!

episodes.title: Strange Visitor
episodes.overview: The bizarre characters of Penguin Village await Goku as he searches the countryside for General Blue and the three missing Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Penguin Village
episodes.overview: Goku, Bulma and Krillin return to Master Roshi's island for some much needed rest. However, they aren't the only ones who have survived. An old foe returns, and he won't stop until he has the Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Escape from Pirate Cave
episodes.overview: The Pirate Cave begins to collapse on top of Goku! But that's not even the worst of it, because there is an even greater menace that threatens to destroy our hero!

episodes.title: Blue, Black and Blue
episodes.overview: Goku, Bulma, and Krillin close in on the pirates' treasure, but they're not the only ones!

episodes.title: The Pirate Treasure
episodes.overview: Krillin and Bulma must face General Blue alone! Can Goku make it to his friends in time to save them?

episodes.title: Beware of the Robot
episodes.overview: Goku, Bulma and Krillin discover an underwater cave port at the heart of the Pirate Cave, where a sword-wielding robot lurks in the shadows!

episodes.title: The Trap is Sprung
episodes.overview: The Red Ribbon Army is in hot pursuit of Goku through the corridors of the Pirate Cave, where danger lurks around every corner in the form of booby-traps!

episodes.title: Roshi's Surprise
episodes.overview: Goku, Bulma and Krillin discover an ancient secret that promises great wealth, and even greater danger! The Red Ribbon Army is also on the prowl!

episodes.title: Deep Blue Sea
episodes.overview: Goku, Bulma and Krillin comb the depths of the deep blue sea, where a third Dragon Ball waits to be claimed.

episodes.title: Kame House: Found!
episodes.overview: Goku and Bulma have located another Dragon Ball and travel to Master Roshi's island in hopes of finding some assistance.

episodes.title: Bulma's Bad Day
episodes.overview: Goku and Bulma find themselves on a uncharted desert. When Goku dives into the ocean waters to search for the magic ball, Bulma finds herself in deep trouble!

episodes.title: Danger in the Air
episodes.overview: Goku and his friends celebrate by going to a spectacular amusement park. But the beautiful bounty hunter, Hasky, has Goku and his two Dragon Balls in her sights, and she intends to turn their day at Dream Land into a tragic nightmare!

episodes.title: Master Thief, Hasky
episodes.overview: Goku arrives at Capsule Corporation, Bulma's home in West City. He's hoping to have the Dragon Radar repaired, but the broken device will soon be the least of his worries! The Red Ribbon Army and their hired thief, Hasky, are hot on his tail!

episodes.title: A Trip to the City
episodes.overview: Goku's Dragon Radar is broken, and Bulma is the only one who knows how to fix it. He needs her help, but how will he ever find her in the sprawling urban maze of West City?

episodes.title: The Secret of Dr. Flappe
episodes.overview: The gentle Android Number 8 is carrying a deadly secret inside of him, and a mysterious hermit, Dr. Flappe, may be his only chance at survival.

episodes.title: The Fall of Muscle Tower
episodes.overview: Having bested all of White's tower guards, only one obstacle stands between Goku and his goal, the General himself. In order to save the Village Chief, Goku must match strength and wits against General White.

episodes.title: Horrifying Buyon
episodes.overview: Goku and Android Number 8 confront General White at the top of Muscle Tower. But the wily General sends the duo tumbling through a trap door into the darkness of floor number five.

episodes.title: Mysterious Android No.8
episodes.overview: Proving to be no match for Goku's skills on his own, Murasaki makes a desperate call for reinforcements. He summons the Red Ribbon Army's secret weapon, the monstrous Android Number 8!

episodes.title: Five Murasakis
episodes.overview: Fighting a ninja is difficult. Fighting five? Impossible! However, those are the odds Goku must face when Murasaki unveils his deadly trick of Separation!

episodes.title: Ninja Murasaki is Coming!
episodes.overview: Goku's quest to save the Village Chief from Muscle Tower is in danger of coming to an untimely end when he encounters the fourth-floor guard, Ninja Murasaki.

episodes.title: Major Metallitron
episodes.overview: In an effort to repay the kindness of Suno and her mother, Goku vows to rescue their kidnapped Village Chief from the Red Ribbon Army's heavily fortified Muscle Tower.

episodes.title: Cold Reception
episodes.overview: Goku is dragged into his most exciting adventure yet. The treacherous Red Ribbon Army threatens a peaceful village. Soldiers ravage the land in search of another Dragon Ball, destroying anything that gets in their way.

episodes.title: Cruel General Red
episodes.overview: Colonel Silver's troops scour land, sea, and air in search of the elusive Dragon Ball, but what they find is Goku! With the help of his Dragon Radar, Goku pinpoints the location of the ball and plucks it from under the noses of the Red Ribbon Army.

episodes.title: The Legend of a Dragon
episodes.overview: Goku explores a jungle paradise in search of the Four-Star Dragon Ball. Little does he know, the diabolical Colonel Silver is hot on his tail! And when the Red Ribbon Army carves a path of destruction through the jungle, it's clear they didn't come to monkey around!

episodes.title: The Flying Fortress: Vanished!
episodes.overview: The Ox-King's been had! Now, Goku is here to straighten it out. Emperor Pilaf made an imposter of Goku in order to steal the prized Dragon Ball. But it won't be that easy this time. Goku and an entire army are out to stop him!

episodes.title: Wedding Plans?
episodes.overview: Pilaf is back to his sneaky tricks to get his hands on a Dragon Ball, but he isn't the only one looking! The Red Ribbon Army is also on the hunt, and they'll destroy everything in their path to get what they want.

episodes.title: Pilaf and the Mystery Force
episodes.overview: The race for the Dragon Balls continues, as Goku must battle Emperor Pilaf and his cohorts for control of the Four-Star ball. Amid the chaos rises a new enemy, a mysterious horde of villains who will stop at nothing to realize their lethal agenda.

episodes.title: The Roaming Lake
episodes.overview: Goku begins a search for his grandfather's Four-Star Dragon Ball and finds the adventure of a lifetime. The fate of an entire village rests on his shoulders as he braves the perilous desert to discover the secret of the mysterious Roaming Lake.

episodes.title: The Final Blow
episodes.overview: The tournament has turned serious when Jackie Chun sent out his Kamehameha Wave that has destroyed half the arena and perhaps Goku with it.

episodes.title: Number One Under the Moon
episodes.overview: The final match between Goku and Jackie Chun rages on for hours, the fighters matching technique for technique even as the sun begins to set.

episodes.title: The Grand Finals
episodes.overview: The final bout begins between Goku and Jackie Chun. It's a huge battle between master and student with only one winner!

episodes.title: Danger from Above
episodes.overview: Goku fights Nam, the poor farmer who has entered the tournament so that he can use the championship money to buy water for his drought-stricken village.

episodes.title: Krillin's Frantic Attack!
episodes.overview: Jackie Chun and Krillin square off in the semi-final match. Unable to match Jackie in brute strength or speed, Krillin must use his wits.

episodes.title: Monster Beast Giran
episodes.overview: Goku is set to fight the fierce warrior Giran. He manages to ward off Giran's powerful attacks until Giran takes Goku by surprise.

episodes.title: Yamcha vs. Jackie Chun
episodes.overview: The final matches continue with Jackie Chun defeating Yamcha and knocking him out of the tournament. But there is something mysterious about Jackie Chun.

episodes.title: Smells Like Trouble
episodes.overview: The final eight competitors draw lots for their match-ups in the World Martial Arts Tournament. Krillin draws the first match against an unusually repulsively oaf named Bacterian. It will take some innovative strategy to beat this monstrous man.

episodes.title: Elimination Round
episodes.overview: The tournament is in full swing as Yamcha, Goku, and Krillin all compete to become one of the eight finalists.

episodes.title: The Tournament Begins
episodes.overview: The greatest warriors from around the world are gathered to battle one another in the greatest martial arts tournament ever. Can Goku and Krillin make it past the Elimination Round?

episodes.title: The Turtle Hermit Way
episodes.overview: Goku and Krillin's training continues as they till the ground with their bare hands, dodge a swarm of angry bees, and swim with sharks. Can Goku and Krillin survive the training to prepare for the World Martial Arts Tournament?

episodes.title: Milk Delivery
episodes.overview: As part of their training, Goku and Krillin must deliver milk to a person who lives high up on a mountain.

episodes.title: Find That Stone!
episodes.overview: Master Roshi takes Goku and Krillin to begin their martial arts training on a jungle island. Krillin cheats to beat Goku in the heated rivalry and wins, but soon has to pay a heavy price for his actions.

episodes.title: Look Out for Launch
episodes.overview: While in town on an errand to prove their worth to Master Roshi, Goku and Krillin rescue the young woman Launch and bring her back to Roshi's island.

episodes.title: Goku's Rival
episodes.overview: With the Dragon Balls once again spread across the face of the Earth, the gang has split to pursue new adventures. While Bulma, Yamcha, Oolong, and Puar struggle through the desert after their plane crashes, Goku flies to Master Roshi's island to learn martial arts.

episodes.title: The Legend of Goku
episodes.overview: The Emperor may have captured Goku's human form, but once the little man takes a look at the moon, nothing - except maybe a pair of scissors - can stop him!

episodes.title: A Wish to the Eternal Dragon
episodes.overview: Pilaf demands revenge for his wasted wish, so he puts Oolong and company in a room designed to cook them alive! There's no way out - unless Goku can release the beast within!

episodes.title: The Penalty is Pinball
episodes.overview: Goku, Bulma, and the others momentarily escape their prison only to find themselves trapped in a deadly game of pinball where Emperor Pilaf controls all the balls!

episodes.title: The Dragon Balls Are Stolen!
episodes.overview: As the adventurers close in on the seventh and final Dragon Ball, Bulma and Oolong argue over what their wish should be - but it might not even matter.

episodes.title: Boss Rabbit's Magic Touch
episodes.overview: Bulma's getting free stuff all over town, but it's not because she's so good looking. It seems her outfit reminds the villagers of a bad guy named Boss Rabbit.

episodes.title: The Kamehameha Wave
episodes.overview: Goku and Chi-Chi are sent to borrow a magic fan from Roshi. When the old master can't find it, he returns to Fire Mountain with his Kamehameha Wave!

episodes.title: The Ox-King on Fire Mountain
episodes.overview: Bulma's got a hunch about where to find another Dragon Ball. Unfortunately, it's guarded by the Ox-King, and he won't give it up unless he gets something in return.

episodes.title: Keep an Eye on the Dragon Balls
episodes.overview: The magic Dragon Balls are sought for many reasons. Oolong and Yamcha want success with women, Bulma wants a hot date, and Goku probably just wants something to eat.

episodes.title: Yamcha the Desert Bandit
episodes.overview: Oolong joins the quest to locate the final two Dragon Balls, but the adventurers are interrupted by a desert dweller with ties to Goku's past.

episodes.title: Oolong the Terrible
episodes.overview: Another Dragon Ball is discovered in a small village. Before Bulma can claim the fifth magic ball, Goku must fight with Oolong the Terrible!

episodes.title: The Nimbus Cloud of Roshi
episodes.overview: Bulma gets annoyed when Goku slows things down to help a lost turtle, but his good deed could speed up their quest to collect the seven Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: The Emperor's Quest
episodes.overview: Goku and Bulma aren't the only ones looking for Dragon Balls. The little warrior runs into a couple of Emperor Pilaf's henchmen during his search for a late night snack.

episodes.title: Secret of the Dragon Ball
episodes.overview: Goku's afternoon of fishing is interrupted by a bossy girl who is determined to get her hands on his most prized possession - a mysterious ball that belonged to his grandfather.

title: Dragon Ball GT
overview: Ten years have passed since Goku left his friends and family to hone his skills. But Goku soon finds himself helpless against the mystical power of the Dragon Balls and an accidental wish made by the devious Emperor Pilaf. The wish; that Goku once again become a child! Goku, together with Trunks, and his own granddaughter Pan, blast off into the outer reaches of space in search of the mysterious Black Star Dragon Balls. But these Dragon Balls have a fatal secret: if not collected within one year Earth will be destroyed.

episodes.title: The Resurrection of Cell and Frieza
A Devastating Wish
episodes.overview: Emperor Pilaf finally summons Shenron, only to blow his big chance at making a wish! Goku undergoes some unusual changes, and King Kai has bad news for the inhabitants of Earth!

title: Dragon Ball Z
overview: Now happily married and with a son, martial arts champion Goku must defend Earth from a series of extraterrestrial invaders bent on destruction.

episodes.title: Goku's Next Journey
episodes.overview: Even Stronger!! Goku's Dream is Super-HugeGoku takes Uub on as his student, and bids goodbye to his family and friends as he embarks on a new adventure.

episodes.title: Buu's Reincarnation
episodes.overview: I Am Uub! Now 10 Years Old, the Former Majin?!The World Martial Arts Tournament gets underway. Goku is paired up with the mystery fighter who Goku claims is the reincarnation of Majin Buu.

episodes.title: Granddaughter Pan
episodes.overview: Grandpa Goku! I Am Pan!!Goku intends to participate in the World Martial Arts Tournament. It seems a mysterious fighter has caught his eye. Of course, Vegeta, Trunks, Goten, and Pan will fight as well.

episodes.title: He's Always Late
episodes.overview: Goku is late for his own party... he's busy looking after some pterodactyl eggs.

episodes.title: Celebrations with Majin Buu
episodes.overview: When Goku and his companions return to Earth after defeating Majin Buu, they are welcomed with open arms. But nobody is happy to see the good Buu! Can Mr. Satan's pink pal manage to fit into society? Or is he destined to become an outcast?

episodes.title: Spirit Bomb Triumphant
episodes.overview: After the good Buu and Mr. Satan free Vegeta, Goku launches the Spirit Bomb! Unfortunately, the weary Saiyan doesn't have enough power to deliver the blast, and Buu sends it right back at him! Will Goku be destroyed by his own attack?

episodes.title: People of Earth Unite
episodes.overview: People of earth are united in order to help Goku to prepare his final attack to defeat Buu and honored Vegeta's sacrifice.

episodes.title: Call to Action
episodes.overview: Goku awaits the arrival of the Earthlings collective energy to vitalize the Spirit Bomb, but the energy isn't coming! Have the people of the Earth turned a deaf ear to Vegeta's plea for help at this most critical hour?

episodes.title: Earth Reborn
episodes.overview: As good Majin Buu wages an all-out war against his evil counterpart, Vegeta asks Dende to summon the Dragon on the new Planet Namek. With the good Buu's power dwindling, will Vegeta have enough time to carry out the final phase of his plan?

episodes.title: Old Buu Emerges
episodes.overview: When Vegeta falls, Mr. Satan steps in to take up the challenge! It appears the wannabe hero has signed his death warrant, but when Buu attempts to attack, the monster is crippled by agony!

episodes.title: Minute of Desperation
episodes.overview: Goku's powers are fading, and he must end the battle before it's too late! Enter Vegeta, who begins a furious battle with Buu to buy Goku the time needed to gather energy. Outclassed by his opponent, can the Saiyan Prince survive!?

episodes.title: Vegeta's Respect
episodes.overview: When Super Saiyan 3 Goku collapses from exhaustion, Vegeta enters the fight, but he doesn't last long! Just as Majin Buu is about to deliver the deathblow, Goku makes a comeback!

episodes.title: Battle for the Universe Begins
episodes.overview: With Majin Buu ready for a fight, Kibito Kai is stunned to see Goku and Vegeta playing a game of Rock, Paper, Scissors! Rather than use the Fusion Technique to join their powers, the duo has decided to fight Buu one at a time!

episodes.title: True Saiyans Fight Alone
episodes.overview: With Earth erased from existence, Majin Buu begins his search for Goku and Vegeta, leaving entire worlds destroyed in his wake. But when Buu's hunt leads him to the World of the Kais, Goku and Vegeta draw the line!

episodes.title: End of Earth
episodes.overview: After the chords of attachment to the roly-poly Buu are cut by Vegeta, Majin Buu should mutate into a much weaker form. But instead he gets even stronger! This baffles everyone but Kibito Kai, who discloses Majin Buu's bizarre history!

episodes.title: Evil Kid Buu
episodes.overview: When Super Buu begins to mutate once more, Goku and Vegeta make an escape. But what is it that awaits should they manage to escape? The sinister Kid Buu is revealed and proves to be more deadly and psychotic than all previous incarnations.

episodes.title: Deadly Vision
episodes.overview: Goku and Vegeta reunite the others only to be attacked by Majin Buu! The showdown proves that fighting Buu inside his own head is a mind-bending experience. Can Goku and Vegeta survive in this twisted house of horrors where all is Buu?

episodes.title: Mind Trap
episodes.overview: Dangers abound as Goku and Vegeta continue their search for Gohan and inside of Majin Buu's body! After meeting some disgusting bedfellows, they finally find what they're looking for as they enter Majin Buu's head!

episodes.title: The Innards of Buu
episodes.overview: When Majin Buu absorbs Vegito, the fused Saiyan separates into Goku and Vegeta once again. Deep within the villain, they reveal their plan to rescue Gohan and the others. Can the duo survive the digestive process and carry out their mission?

episodes.title: The Incredible Fighting Candy
episodes.overview: Having been reduced to a coffee-flavored candy, it seems nothing can stop Vegito from being consumed by the evil Majin Buu. But when the gumdrop fights back, Buu realizes that the battle is far from over!

episodes.title: Vegito Downsized
episodes.overview: The battle rages on between Vegito and Majin Buu! The Super Saiyan Combo seems to have the fight well in hand. But is Vegito tempting fate by toying with Buu? What terrible tricks does the wily, pink monster still have up his sleeve?

episodes.title: Rip in the Universe
episodes.overview: The newly-formed Saiyan warrior Super Vegito matches Majin Buu punch for punch. But the monster's new opponent stirs up an uncontrollable anger within the very heart of the beast. Will Majin Buu's frenzy mean the end of planet Earth?

episodes.title: Meet Vegito
episodes.overview: The bodies of Goku and Vegeta join to form a new Saiyan warrior. The monster Majin Buu is impressed by the strength of his new opponent, but refuses to take him seriously. Will Majin Buu's arrogance be his undoing?

episodes.title: Union of Rivals
episodes.overview: After Majin Buu absorbs Gohan, Goku's plan to join forces with his son is ruined. But an unlikely ally arrives on the scene-Vegeta. Will the Saiyan Prince put aside his differences and agree to merge with Goku?

episodes.title: Ready to Fuse
episodes.overview: Goku watches helplessly from Other World as Majin Buu sets his sights on Gohan. Luckily the Old Kai reveals a secret source of power that could save the day. Is Goku ready to bond with his son and put an end to Majin Buu's reign of terror?

episodes.title: The Old Kai's Weapon
episodes.overview: After absorbing Piccolo and Gotenks, Majin Buu's powers have increased exponentially! Armed with some new tricks, Majin Buu is poised for global destruction. Now that Gohan is alone and weakening, is there anyone who can stop the monster?

episodes.title: Majin Buu Transforms
episodes.overview: Majin Buu reappears, ready for battle, but rather than continue his fight against Gohan, Buu stages a clever deception to absorb Gotenks and Piccolo. With the wisdom of Piccolo and the power of Super Saiyan Gotenks, Buu transforms into "Super Buu!"

episodes.title: Search for Survivors
episodes.overview: After being dominated on the battlefield, Majin Buu blows himself up in a desperate attempt to destroy Gohan! But is this just a ploy? Gohan seems to think so! Is Majin Buu plotting an ambush or simply trying to buy a little time?

episodes.title: A Whole New Gohan
episodes.overview: When Gotenks' fusion unravels, it appears the end has finally come for Goten and Trunks. But just as things seem their worst, Gohan descends on the scene with his newly awakened powers! Finally, the tables are turning on Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Unlucky Break
episodes.overview: Gohan continues his training on the World of the Kais. Meanwhile, Gotenks briefly takes the upper hand in the battle with Majin Buu before his techniques begin to fall apart. Will Gohan be ready in time to step in and finish the fight?

episodes.title: Gotenks Is Awesome
episodes.overview: Super Saiyan 3 Gotenks continues his fight with Majin Buu, and the Lookout is caught in the crossfire! As Gotenks turns up the power, so does Majin Buu - and by the time it's over, one of them will be in way over his head!

episodes.title: Feeding Frenzy
episodes.overview: Powered by his insatiable hunger, Majin Buu escapes the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, leaving Piccolo and Gotenks trapped inside. Krillin and the gang are forced to fight the monster on their own. Will Buu finally make a meal out of the good guys?

episodes.title: Trapped In Forever
episodes.overview: The battle between Gotenks and Majin Buu rages on inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. On the outside, family and friends wait anxiously for Gotenks and Piccolo to reappear. Can they successfully defeat Majin Buu and make it out alive?

episodes.title: Super Moves of Gotenks
episodes.overview: The long awaited rematch between Majin Buu and Gotenks begins! But when Gotenks' fighting techniques come up short, he is forced to improvise - resulting in some of the craziest attack moves ever!

episodes.title: Time Struggle
episodes.overview: The Special Training is a Success!! You're Finished Now, Majin BuuBefore he can unleash his fury on the remaining Z-Fighters, Majin Buu is coaxed into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Inside, Trunks and Goten are training diligently, but will they have enough time to perfect their new moves before Majin Buu arrives?

episodes.title: Empty Planet
episodes.overview: A Catastrophe With No Time to Lose!! Earth's Humanity is ExterminatedWhen the new and improved Majin Buu makes a surprise visit to the Lookout to challenge Gotenks, every second becomes a test of survival! And where are Trunks and Goten during the chaos that erupts?... Sound asleep, of course!

episodes.title: Buu Against Buu
episodes.overview: Which One Will Win?! A Good and Evil Boo-Boo ConfrontationGood Buu and Evil Buu begin fighting and it seems Evil Buu is much stronger. After a counterattack from Evil Buu the Good Buu turns into chocalate and the Evil Buu eats him and transforms into Super Buu.

episodes.title: The Evil of Men
episodes.overview: Run Away, Satan!! An Angry Majin Buu EmergesWhen Mr. Satan inspires Majin Buu to give up his evil ways, it seems the professional pretender has really saved the world. But when a deranged madman suddenly spoils Buu's good mood, the pink terror goes on another rampage.

episodes.title: I Kill No More
episodes.overview: I've Stopped Killing!! Majin Buu's Good Boy DeclarationWhile the Z-Fighters continue training in preparation for their battle with Majin Buu, Mr. Satan devises some sneakier plans to take the villain down. But will he even need to carry them out? Is Majin Buu having a change of heart?

episodes.title: Unlikely Friendship
episodes.overview: The Final Weapon is Engaged?! Satan Will Save the EarthAs Majin Buu continues to terrorize humanity, a lone savior appears: Mr. Satan! But his Megaton punch won't be enough to stop the monster, but this unlikely hero may have a few surprises in store for Buu!

episodes.title: Gotenks is Born
episodes.overview: The Birth of a Superhuman Warrior!! His Name is GotenksAfter many comical misfires, Trunks and Goten finally perfect the Fusion technique, and Gotenks is born! Defying Piccolo's command, the super-kid immediately leaves to go fight Majin Buu! Is Gotenks ready for the fight of his young life?

episodes.title: Out from the Broken Sword
episodes.overview: You're Kidding, Right?! The Z Sword is BrokenGohan breaks the Z Sword in training, but from within it comes a new Kai, with a new technique!

episodes.title: Return to Other World
episodes.overview: Where is Gohan?! Training in the Kaiōshin RealmWhile Trunks and Goten continue their quest to perfect the Fusion Technique, Gohan seeks to master the Z-Sword. Back on Earth, an encounter with a blind boy reveals that there is another side to the belligerent Buu!

episodes.title: Goku's Time Is Up
episodes.overview: See You Later, Everybody!! Goku Returns to the AfterlifeTensions rise for Goten and Trunks as their duel with Majin Buu approaches. Meanwhile, Buu prepares for the upcoming battle by building himself a home! Elsewhere, Goku bids a poignant farewell as he finally returns to Other World.

episodes.title: The Fusion Dance
episodes.overview: Absurdly Awful Looking?! The Special Training Transformation PoseLiberated from his master, Majin Buu becomes even more destructive than before, wiping out entire cities in mere seconds! Earth's only hope now rests on the shoulders of two young warriors: Goten and Trunks!

episodes.title: Buu's Mutiny
episodes.overview: Bye-Bye, Babidi!! Majin Buu RebelsGoku uses his new Super Saiyan 3 abilities to combat the evil Majin Buu, buying Trunks the time he needs to locate the missing Dragon Radar. But now that Goku has started the fight, he may not be able to escape!

episodes.title: Super Saiyan 3
episodes.overview: An Astounding, Great Transformation!! Super Saiyan 3Trunks searches frantically for the lost dragon radar, and Goku powers-up to an unimaginable level: Super Saiyan 3! Will this newfound strength be enough to stop Majin Buu from destroying West City?

episodes.title: Race to Capsule Corp.
episodes.overview: West City is Targeted! Stop, Majin Buu!!As Goten and Trunks train to stop the vicious Majin Buu, Idasa's jaded mother tells Babidi exactly where Trunks lives! The Z-Fighters must now find a way to stop the evil wizard before he reaches Capsule Corp!

episodes.title: The Z Sword
episodes.overview: It Came Ou~t!! The Legendary Z SwordMajin Buu launches into a feeding frenzy, transforming an entire town's population into chocolate! Gohan draws the ancient Z-Sword, Goku struggles to teach Goten and Trunks the art of Fusion, and an unlikely hero is asked to join the fight!

episodes.title: Learn to Fuse!
episodes.overview: Gohan is Revived — Kaiōshin's Secret Weapon?!Goku begins training Goten and Trunks in the art of Fusion. Meanwhile, Gohan, having been healed in Supreme Kai's world, tries to remove the legendary Z-Sword to use in the fight against Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Global Announcement
episodes.overview: Goten and Trunks — The World's Most WantedBabidi seeks vengeance against Piccolo, Goten, and Trunks! Plastering images on everyone's mind, Babidi threatens to terrorize humanity until the trio is brought forward! Meanwhile, Gohan is taken to Supreme Kai's world!

episodes.title: Revival
episodes.overview: Enormous Hope!! A New Finishing Technique for the Little SquirtsGoku hatches a plan for defeating Majin Buu: Fusion! By joining two fighters of equal size and strength, an entirely new fighter can be created. But only one such pair remains-Goten and Trunks! Can the young half-Saiyans save the world?

episodes.title: Find the Dragonballs
episodes.overview: The Struggle of Videl and the Others! Find the Dragon BallsVidel, Yamcha, Master Roshi, Chi Chi and Bulma find the last Dragon Ball... then it gets eaten by a dinosaur.

episodes.title: Evil Lives On
episodes.overview: The Nightmare Revisited! Majin Buu has SurvivedMajin Buu's flesh is scattered on the battlefield, but his mystical power is rebuilding the monster into one deadly piece. Babidi is recovering, too, having narrowly survived Piccolo's attack.

episodes.title: Final Atonement
episodes.overview: For Those Whom He Loves… Vegeta Perishes!!After fighting with Majin Buu, Vegeta realizes he isn't fighting for just himself, but for the entire planet, and commits the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: The Warrior's Decision
episodes.overview: A Warrior's Resolution!! I Will Dispose of the MajinThe battle between Prince of Destruction Vegeta and Buu has begun! Vegeta is forced into a tough fight like never before as Buu shows no signs of taking any damage even after a hole is pierced in his stomach. Just as Vegeta is in a pinch due to Buu's unconventional strategy of wrapping his own torn body around his opponent and attacking him, Trunks steps in, unable to bear the sight!

episodes.title: Meal Time
episodes.overview: Free from the grip of Babidi, Vegeta decides to seek his revenge by destroying the monster Majin Buu. Assuming Gohan to be a victim of the voracious villain, the Super Saiyan goes ballistic. Can Vegeta bring down Buu?

episodes.title: The Terror of Majin Buu
episodes.overview: Supreme Kai must use his unique fighting powers to keep Buu at bay - or lose his life! One mile away, Goten and Trunks stumble upon Piccolo, still frozen in stone, and accidentally shatter him to pieces! And there's more! The King of Demons returns!

episodes.title: The Losses Begin
episodes.overview: A Straight Line to Despair?! The Grief of KaiōshinWith his big pink belly and infantile behavior, Buu doesn't fit the bill of a galaxy destroyer - until he hurls Dabura into a cliff with a single blow! Gohan senses a limitless power, and the Supreme Kai insists this is the end!

episodes.title: Buu is Hatched
episodes.overview: I Won't Allow the Revival!! A Kamehameha of ResistanceThe seal encasing Buu is finally broken! Supreme Kai insists on retreat, but Gohan refuses, launching an incredible series of energy attacks. When the shell opens, nothing is inside! Gohan, however, there is no time to celebrate..

episodes.title: Magic Ball of Buu
episodes.overview: The Seal is Broken! Out Comes the Vicious Majin Buu!!Gohan and the Supreme Kai confront Babidi in the depths of his space ship. With the fight between Goku and Vegeta supplying vast quantities of energy for Majin Buu, with not a moment to lose.

episodes.title: The Long Awaited Fight
episodes.overview: Just You Wait, Babidi!! Your Aspirations Will Not be AllowedThe battle between Goku and Vegeta has begun! With Babidi's magic enhancing his already incredible strength, Vegeta matches Goku move for move, but every blow the Saiyan Prince lands is a boost for Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Vegeta's Pride
episodes.overview: A Super Confrontation of Destiny!! The Clash of Goku vs VegetaGoku has no choice but to accept Vegeta's challenge.

episodes.title: The Dark Prince Returns
episodes.overview: Vegeta, the Prince of Destruction, is Revived!! Intrusion at the TournamentIn an all-out assault against Vegeta, Babidi uses his power to undo the unsuspecting Prince from within! Vegeta is stripped of his good qualities by the wicked wizard, and becomes the heartless warrior that he once was!

episodes.title: Heart of a Villain
episodes.overview: A Wicked Heart is Discovered!! Dabura's Good IdeaThe intense battle between Gohan and Dabura rages on, but just as the Stage 3 clash reaches a heated peak, Dabura stops the fight! Why has the evil giant conceded, and what is the great discovery he claims to have made?

episodes.title: Pay to Win
episodes.overview: A Confrontation With the Demon King! It's Your Turn Gohan!!As the final bout of the tournament continues, Number 18 throws the defending champ for a loop by offering to throw the fight! Meanwhile, Babidi has selected his warrior for Stage 3: Dabura, King of the Demon World!

episodes.title: Eighteen Unmasks
episodes.overview: Such Strong Kids!! No. 18's Close Fight?!The battle heats up as Number 18 and Mighty Mask take their fight to the skies. Number 18 gives it everything she's got, but her attacks prove useless against her masked opponent. Could she find the edge she needs to win?

episodes.title: Battle Supreme
episodes.overview: A Great Miscalculation!! Satan vs Three Super Warriors?!At the World Martial Arts Tournament, the five remaining competitors enter the ring for an all-out Battle Royale! The fists fly as Number 18, Mighty Mask, and Mr. Satan duke it out to decide who will be the next Champion of the World!

episodes.title: Next Up, Goku
episodes.overview: Goku's Power Wide Open!! Blow Away YakonBabidi unleashes his monster Yakon to steal the Z-Fighters' energy for Majin Buu. The battle at Stage Two is sure to be intense, as Yakon is one of the most fearsome creatures in the universe!

episodes.title: Vegeta Attacks
episodes.overview: Don't Toy With Me!! Vegeta Breaks Through the First Fight in a FuryAt each stage of Babidi's ship, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta must face a fearsome warrior, each more powerful than the last. There's no room for error. Even the tiniest mistake will enable Babidi to steal their energy for Majin Buu.

episodes.title: King of the Demons
episodes.overview: The Awaiting Trap!! A Challenge From the Demon RealmPiccolo and Krillin are turned to stone by Dabura! Determined to save their friends, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta board Babidi's ship only to find themselves trapped! Can they save their friends and find their way out?

episodes.title: The Wizard's Curse
episodes.overview: The Man Behind the Curtain Appears!! The Evil Mage BabidiThe Z-Fighters race to stop Babidi's cronies from delivering the pure energy that will be used resurrect the dreaded Majin Buu. Will they find Babidis hidden spaceship in time?

episodes.title: Energy Drain
episodes.overview: A Slithering Conspiracy!! Gohan's Power is StolenWhen Gohan transforms into a Super Saiyan, Spopovitch and Yamu spring into action! Armed with a mysterious energy-draining device, the pair launch an attack on the golden-haired teen.

episodes.title: Identities Revealed
episodes.overview: Exposed!! The Saiyaman is Son GohanGohan's identity is finally discovered as he takes his place on the tournament floor, but he has bigger things to worry about. His opponent, Kibito, is determined to see him transform into a Super Saiyan!

episodes.title: Videl is Crushed
episodes.overview: A Tragic Videl!! Are You Coming Out, Angry Super Gohan?To everyones horror, Spopovitch delays his inevitable victory for the purposes of torturing Videl! It appears the muscle-bound thug isn't going to stop until he kills her! Will Videl make it out of the ring alive?

episodes.title: A Dark and Secret Power
episodes.overview: Undyingly Unpleasant?! The Mystery of SpopovitchVidel takes to the ring for what is expected to be an easy victory over Spopovitch. She hits the towering brute with everything shes got, but her attacks have no effect. It seems Spopovitch is possessed by a supernatural power!

episodes.title: Forfeit of Piccolo
episodes.overview: What's the Matter, Piccolo?! An Unheard-of No-Fight ForfeitPiccolo stuns the crowd by surrendering to his mysterious opponent before the first punch is thrown! Next into the ring is Videl, who must face the enormous Spopovitch. Will she be able to handle such a large job?

episodes.title: Who Will Fight Who?
episodes.overview: The Match-Ups Are Decided!! Hurry and Hold the First RoundTrunks and Gohan infiltrate the adult competition at the tournament by donning the disguise of Mighty Mask. The pairings for the day matches are selected. The first to fight: Krillin vs. Pintar, a man easily ten times Krillins size!

episodes.title: Big Trouble, Little Trunks
episodes.overview: Now What, Satan?! The Greatest Pinch in HistoryAfter winning the championship, Trunks fights an exhibition match against Mr. Satan! Can the Champ hold on to his reputation as the world's strongest fighter? Meanwhile, two mysterious figures reveal themselves to Goku!

episodes.title: Best of the Boys
episodes.overview: Happiness Times a Million! The Junior Champion is Decided!!The match for the Junior Division World Championship continues as Goten and Trunks battle for the title! The winner of this final joust becomes the new World Champion! Can Goten outwit the cunning Trunks?

episodes.title: Trunks vs. Goten
episodes.overview: It's My Turn!! Goten's Anxious First FightGoten and Trunks breeze through the Junior Division of the tournament until they find themselves going head-to-head in the finals! Who will win this exciting match? This is one championship fight you won't want to miss!

episodes.title: The World Tournament
episodes.overview: No Small Matter!! Little TrunksThe action begins as the World Martial Arts Tournament opens with the Junior Division! Thirty-five young fighters vie for the prize, but the matches prove to be more comedy than competition - until Trunks steps into the ring!

episodes.title: Camera Shy
episodes.overview: You're in Danger, Saiyaman! Guard Yourself Against a Perfectly Timed Photo?!Everyone qualifies for the World Tournament.

episodes.title: Gather for the Tournament
episodes.overview: Welcome Back, Goku! The Whole Z Team Assembles!!Videl learns to fly, and Gohan and Goten do some last minute honing of their Super Saiyan skills. On the island where the tournament will be held, a special guest arrives! What do you say to a hero who's been dead for seven years?!

episodes.title: Take Flight, Videl
episodes.overview: Ah, I Flew!! Videl's Introduction to FlightWith the Tournament fast approaching, Videl and Goten must learn to fly! Miles away, Vegeta holds a training session of his own, and his young son, Trunks, has a big surprise in store for him

episodes.title: The Newest Super Saiyan
episodes.overview: Even Gohan is Surprised! Goten's Explosion of PowerWhile training for the upcoming tournament, Gohan discovers that Goten has already reached the level of Super Saiyan! Sparks fly when the brothers spar, but the main event happens when Videl meets Chichi for the first time!

episodes.title: I'll Fight Too
episodes.overview: Goku's Also Resurrected?! He's Participating in the Tenka'ichi Budōkai!!The Great Saiyaman is about to become a movie star but the hero's brush with stardom better not take long, because he has to hurry up and tell all of his old friends the big news: Goku is coming back.

episodes.title: Blackmail
episodes.overview: A Robbery Case!! The Culprit is Saiyaman?!When a greedy circus promoter kidnaps a baby dinosaur, all he sees are dollar signs! Little does he know, that the dinosaur is a close, personal friend of the Great Saiyaman!

episodes.title: Rescue Videl
episodes.overview: Gohan, Get Moving Quick! Rescue Videl!!When the Red Shark Gang kidnaps the mayor and demands a showdown with Mr. Satan, it's Videl who answers the challenge. Gohan knows Videl is in over her head, but he can't leave his classroom to help her without blowing his cover!

episodes.title: Gohan's First Date
episodes.overview: Gohan's Confusing First Date?!Gohan thinks being a super-hero is a snap until a pretty girl named Angela discovers his secret. When Angela threatens to tell all unless he goes on a date with her, Gohan's life suddenly becomes more complicated than ever!

episodes.title: I am Saiyaman!
episodes.overview: The Champion and Lover of Justice — The Great Saiyaman AppearsAfraid he will be recognized by his classmates, Gohan gets Bulma to design a retractable super-hero costume that he can activate in an instant. Say goodbye to Gohan - and hello to Saiyaman.

episodes.title: Gohan Goes to High School
episodes.overview: 7 Years Since That Event! Starting Today, I'm a High SchoolerOn his first day of high school, Gohan stops a truckload of bank robbers by turning Super Saiyan. Now, the city can't stop talking about this mysterious "Gold Fighter!" Can Gohan get through class without revealing his secret identity?

episodes.title: Goku vs.Pikkon
episodes.overview: Goku may be a Super Saiyan, but can he withstand Pikkon's unbelievable Thunder Flash Attack?! And that's not all! While Goku's been fighting in Other World, seven years have passed on Earth, Gohan is now a teenager!

episodes.title: Final Round
episodes.overview: Goku advances to the final round of the tournament where he will face the warrior Pikkon! Sparks of energy fly as the brawlers battle for the title! When Pikkon reveals a Piccolo-like secret, Goku must up the ante! It's Super Saiyan time!

episodes.title: Water Fight
episodes.overview: The Other World Tournament advances to the Quarter-Finals, and the battles are out of this world! Goku's opponent, Arqua, appears to be a wimp, but things change quickly when he transforms the entire ring into water!

episodes.title: Tournament Begins
episodes.overview: Goku must train for 10,000 years before he can study under the Grand Kai! But when the West, South, and East Kaiâ&#x20AC;ôs decide to hold an Other World Tournament, Goku gets his chance! All he has to do is defeat the greatest fighters of all time!

episodes.title: Warriors of the Dead
episodes.overview: When Goku hears about a martial arts master known as the Grand Kai, he rushes to meet him for a lesson! Meanwhile, Cell, Frieza, King Cold and the Ginyu Force have teamed up to take control of Other World!

episodes.title: Free the Future
episodes.overview: Peace and order have been restored on Earth in the present, but Trunks' future world is still a place of darkness and despair! Once he arrives home, the future will be forever changed!

episodes.title: One More Wish
episodes.overview: A New Day Will Come… Father! I'll Hang in ThereWith one more wish left, what shall the Z-Fighters wish for?

episodes.title: Goku's Decision
episodes.overview: I Will Carry On in the Afterlife!! Farewell with a SmileCell is finally defeated, but the Z-Fighters still have much to resolve! Can they make it to the Lookout in time to heal the badly-injured Gohan? Is Android 18 still a threat? And can our heroes find a way to bring back Goku?

episodes.title: Save the World
episodes.overview: The Fight is Over… Thank You, Son GokuThe final showdown begins! While Goku telepathically coaches Gohan from the Other World, the Z-Fighters jump in for a five-sided attack! Gohan has the potential inside him, but can Goku show him how to unlock it?

episodes.title: The Horror Won't End
episodes.overview: From Goku to Gohan… A Father's Spirit is Passed DownVegeta lashed out against Cell but was incapacitated in a single blow. Gohan jumps in front to save Vegeta and is wounded in the process. Cell and Gohan unleash their devastating Kamehameha waves as they collide in a fierce beam struggle.

episodes.title: Cell Returns!
episodes.overview: The Nightmare is Reborn!! An Absolute and Perfect TerrorThe nightmare continues! Cell explodes, but a particle of his nucleus survives the blast, providing all the android needs to regenerate himself! Restored to his ultimate form, Cell returns to the Earth more powerful than ever!

episodes.title: A Hero's Farewell
episodes.overview: Bye-Bye Everyone!! Goku's Last Instant MovementClearly overmatched by Gohan, Cell initiates his last line of defense: a self-destruct program that will blow up the entire planet! With only seconds to spare, Goku risks everything to transport Cell away from the Earth.

episodes.title: Cell's Break Down
episodes.overview: Cell's Disaster!! The Destruction of His Perfect FormGohan's Super Saiyan strength appears to have no limit, and the young hero delivers a blow so severe it causes Cell to cough up Android 18!

episodes.title: The Unstoppable Gohan
episodes.overview: Cell is Knocked Out!! Taken Down With Two Super PunchesCell's desire for battle turns into a nightmare as Gohan unleashes the full fury of his strength. The evil android powers up to his maximum level, but will it be enough to spare him from the wrath of Super Saiyan?

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.overview: Anger Exploding Into Power!! The Cell Juniors are Destroyed"The Unleashing" - After Android 16 tells Gohan to unleash his powers. Gohan becomes super sayan and starts destroying cells children.

episodes.title: Cell Juniors Attack!
episodes.overview: The Tragedy of No. 16!! Super Gohan's Anger ExplodesGohan boils with rage as the Cell Juniors wreak havoc on the Z-Fighters. The boy struggles to resist the urge to fight, but he's a powder keg waiting to explode, and Android 16 appears ready to light the fuse!

episodes.title: Android Explosion
episodes.overview: Miniature Threats!! The Cell Juniors AttackCell is determined to unleash Gohan's full potential, but the boy refuses to fight, prompting the android to torture Gohan's friends instead! Next, Cell does the unthinkable by spawning miniature Cells to attack the Z-Fighters!

episodes.title: Gohan's Plea
episodes.overview: Get Angry, Gohan—Release the Dormant Power WithinThe fight between Gohan and Cell intensifies, but the villain's attacks seem to have no effect on the boy! Could the young hero really have the power to defeat the evil android once and for all?

episodes.title: Faith in a Boy
episodes.overview: Someone Who Will Succeed the Strongest… His Name is GohanAfter surrendering to Cell, Goku names the next challenger to enter the Cell Games: Gohan! Goku has supreme faith in his son's abilities, but the young Saiyan will need a lot more than his father's confidence if he's going to survive!

episodes.title: The Fight is Over
episodes.overview: The End of the Desperate Struggle!! Goku Surrenders?!Goku blasts Cell with a Kamehameha Wave that reduces the android to a pile of cinders, but his triumph is short-lived. The monster shows his amazing resilience by fully regenerating himself!

episodes.title: No More Rules
episodes.overview: Lose or Die?! Goku, A Secret Turnabout PlanAs the battle intensifies, Cell quickly grows tired of the rules he created for the tournament. With a flick of his finger, the Android destroys the ring, instantly turning the Cell Games into a deadly fight to the finish!

episodes.title: Cell's Bag of Tricks
episodes.overview: A Direct Hit to the Earth!! Cell's Huge KamehamehaCell attacks Goku with a dazzling array of moves including the Destructo Disk, the Special Beam Cannon, and even the Kamehameha Wave! Goku matches the monster blow for blow, but how long can he last against such a lethal arsenal?

episodes.title: Goku vs. Cell
episodes.overview: Goku's Bout!! The Super-Tense Cell GamesGoku and Cell start fighting with each other in the ring. If Cell wins then he'll destroy the earth. If Goku wins then the Cell will give up.

episodes.title: Losers Fight First
episodes.overview: Wait Just a Minute!! The Great Satan Army ArrivesCaroni and Pirozhki, Mr. Satan's top students, make a spectacular entrance to the ring, but are they really ready to rumble with Cell? Don't miss a minute of the fun, because this fight could be over fast!

episodes.title: The Games Begin
episodes.overview: Cell's Standing Challenge!! The Opening to the Decisive BattleThe wait is over, and the Cell Games are ready to begin! The Z-Fighters arrive ringside, only to discover another challenger already on the scene. It's none other than World Martial Arts Champion, Mr. Satan!

episodes.title: The Puzzle of General Tao
episodes.overview: Goku's Perplexing Problem?! The Dragon Balls are Taken BackGoku comes face to face with an old adversary: General Tao! The search for the Dragon Balls led Goku to the aging general, but unless the Super Saiyan can solve the crafty villain's puzzle, the search may end in vain!

episodes.title: Dende's Dragon
episodes.overview: Dende's New Occupation!! The Dragon Balls are RevivedWith help from King Kai, Goku travels to Namek to recruit a new guardian for the Earth! Most of the Namekians refuse the offer, but there's one little guy who can't wait to go! Dende is back, and he's going to create a new Dragon!

episodes.title: The Cell Games
episodes.overview: Super Trunks Has a Weakness!! Cell, A Shocking Bombshell DeclarationRealizing that his powers are no match for his opponent, Trunks accepts defeat, only to be given a second chance when Cell proposes a tournament! Is Cell really interested in competition, or does he have a sinister motive?

episodes.title: Ghosts from Tomorrow
episodes.overview: A Future of Despair!! Trunks, the Man Who Lived Through HellTrunks vows to stop the future from repeating itself; Cell can't wait for the future to unfold. It's all up for grabs as the two warriors prepare for battle. Only one future will survive. Whose will it be?

episodes.title: Saving Throw
episodes.overview: Save Your Father!! Trunks' Fury, Which Scorches Even the HeavensVegeta lies unconscious after his battle with Cell, and Trunks unleashes his hidden powers to save his father's life. With Goku and Gohan still training, Trunks is the only person standing in the evil android's way.

episodes.title: Trunks Ascends
episodes.overview: Breaking Through the Boundaries of the Super Saiyan!! Trunks Summons a StormTapping into the deepest wells of his energy, Vegeta summons one last attack: the Final Flash! Meanwhile, Trunks struggles to decide whether or not to help his father. Vegeta's pride is at stake, but so is his life!

episodes.title: Vegeta Must Pay
episodes.overview: Super Vegeta in Peril!! An Absolutely Perfect Terror Closes In!!After allowing Cell to reach his final form, Vegeta is ready for the challenge he was promised. But as Cell easily deflects the Saiyan's every blow, it's clear that Vegeta has more his hands than he bargained for!

episodes.title: Cell is Complete
episodes.overview: An Infinite Battle Power!! The Birth of the God of Destruction is Named CellThe earth's greatest fear has come true: Cell is complete! Can anyone stop the android nightmare in his final, perfect form? As the heroes nervously line up, a glimmer of hope shines from above. Gohan is a Super Saiyan!

episodes.title: The Last Defense
episodes.overview: A Shock to the Entire Universe!! Cell, A Spectacular Evolution Toward His Perfect FormWith the remote control smashed, Krillin and Trunks must save Android 18 from Cell's power-hungry grasp. But Vegeta has other plans in mind. Will trunks attack his own father to save humanity?

episodes.title: Bow to the Prince
episodes.overview: On Your Knees, Cell! I am Super Vegeta!!Vegeta shows cell his new power while Goku and Gohun train.

episodes.title: Super Vegeta
episodes.overview: Suddenly Full-Throttle!! The Radiant Vegeta's Super PowerCell obliterates a chain of islands in search of Android 18! Vegeta, fresh from the time chamber, is ready to test his new strength against the monster, but is he really stronger than a Super Saiyan?

episodes.title: Saiyans Emerge
episodes.overview: I'll Finish Everything!! A Reborn Vegeta, Father and Son, Sally ForthTrunks and Vegeta emerge from the time chamber after a year of intense training. Goku and Gohan are next into the room, but with Cell nearing his ultimate form, can the fighters afford to wait another day?

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Tomorrow I am Going to Pulverize You!! Goku's ChallengeWith an onslaught of psychic blasts, Tien gives Androids 16 and 18 a chance to escape, but the powerful attack rapidly drains his strength. Tien may have saved the androids, but can he save himself?

episodes.title: Say Goodbye, 17
episodes.overview: No. 17 is Swallowed… The Transforming Cell is a Super GourmetIt's android against android as 16 clashes with Cell. Android 16 is the stronger fighter, but Cell is far too driven to be stopped now! With an underheanded attack, Cell moves one step closer to his gruesome transformation!

episodes.title: Silent Warrior
episodes.overview: One Final Remaining Hope… The Silent Warrior No. 16 Takes Action!!When Android 16 claims to be as strong as Cell, it seems like a wild boast! But after he launches an offensive that throws Cell against the ropes, it becomes clear that the big android has the power to back up his words!

episodes.title: Up to Piccolo
episodes.overview: The Suicidal Counterattack Proves Ineffective! Piccolo's Flame Burns Out!!Just as Cell is about to absorb Android 17, Piccolo bravely steps in and foils the monster's plan! Does the Super Namekian really have a chance at stopping Cell on his own?! Or is he simply putting off the inevitable?

episodes.title: He's Here
episodes.overview: How I Have Waited For this Day!! Cell's Prologue to PerfectionStronger than ever after fusing with Kami, Piccolo leads the attack against the androids! It looks like the Super Namekian has things under control until Cell arrives on the battlefield! Can anyone stop this hideous monster?!

episodes.title: The Monster is Coming
episodes.overview: The Gekiretsu Kodan that Split the Heavens!! Piccolo vs Artificial Human No. 17Behind the closed doors of the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, Vegeta and Trunks struggle to push past the level of Super Saiyan! Down on Earth, Piccolo challenges Android 17 to a battle!

episodes.title: Time Chamber
episodes.overview: Hasten Your Training, Saiyans! In the Room of Spirit and Time…As Cell continues his deadly march, Goku hatches a plan to squeeze a year's worth of training into just one day! Back at Master Roshi's, the android trio arrives looking for Goku! Can Piccolo hold them off until the Saiyans return?

episodes.title: Our Hero Awakes
episodes.overview: Goku Awakens to Battle! Go Beyond the Super Saiyan!!In South City, Cell plows through more civilians and accidentally runs into Krillin! Goku finally gets back on his feet, but with Cell and the other androids in full stride, can the Saiyan hero still make a difference?

episodes.title: Laboratory Basement
episodes.overview: The Secret of Cell's Birth! What Lies Below the Laboratory?!With hopes of saving the future, Trunks and Krillin race to destroy Dr. Gero's lab. Meanwhile, Piccolo and Tien search for the elusive Cell. But how can they stop an enemy who knows their every move?

episodes.title: Piccolo's Folly
episodes.overview: Piccolo's Grievous Mistake! Cell Escapes Into the City!Piccolo cleverly distracts Cell long enough to regenerate his arm. The Namekian is ready for another round, and Krillin and Trunks have arrived to provide backup! With the odds mounting against him, Cell makes a tactical decision.

episodes.title: His Name Is Cell
episodes.overview: A Life Form of Evil and Destruction!! His Name is Artificial Human CellHeavily-armored tanks fail to halt Cell's rampage, and now it's up to Piccolo to stop the monster! As the Namekian fights for survival, Cell reveals that he's actually an android, the ultimate achievement of Dr. Gero!

episodes.title: Borrowed Powers
episodes.overview: Gingertown becomes a battlefield as Piccolo confronts Cell. This monster from the future gains his strength by sucking the life out of his victims! But that's not the creature's only talent. He also knows the Kamehameha Wave!

episodes.title: The Reunion
episodes.overview: An insect-like monster threatens to turn Gingertown into a ghastly graveyard! In response to this new menace, Kami fuses with Piccolo, and the resulting Super Namekian flies to Gingertown for a showdown of epic proportions!

episodes.title: Seized with Fear
episodes.overview: Trunks and Krillin join Bulma at the crash site of the mysterious time capsule and find an eerie clue: the shell of a large, locust-like creature! Whatever arrived in the time capsule isn't human, and it's on the loose!

episodes.title: More Androids?!
episodes.overview: A Present More Terrifying Than the Future?! Trunks' SuspicionsVegeta, Piccolo, and Gohan lead an exhaustive search through the mountains for #20. But the hunters are also the hunted!

episodes.title: The Secret of Doctor Gero
episodes.overview: No. 20's Defiant Smile… The Secret of Doctor GeroIn his first fight as a Super Saiyan, Vegeta takes control of the battlefield.

episodes.title: Upgrade to Super Saiyan
episodes.overview: The Might of Vegeta!! The Blood of a Super Saiyan AwakensAttacked from within by a crippling virus, Goku is helpless against the maniacal #19. But just when it looks like the end for Goku, Vegeta appears on on the scene.

episodes.title: Double Trouble for Goku
episodes.overview: Goku's Double-Shock!! Caught Between Illness and AdversaryThe battle with the Androids begins as Goku launches an all out assault against #19. The Super Saiyan seems to have the fight under control.

episodes.title: A Handy Trick
episodes.overview: The Cold-Blooded No. 20's Hideous Atrocities!! Goku's Super Transformation of AngerYamcha is held at the mercy of the ruthless No. 20, and Goku and the others must race to help their friend.

episodes.title: The Androids Appear
episodes.overview: Murderers Who Leave No Trace — Which Ones Are the Artificial Humans?!The Androids are here, and they're wreaking havoc on an unsuspecting city! Goku and his friends must now put their training to the test!

episodes.title: Goku's Ordeal
episodes.overview: License Mastery? Goku's Newest TrialGoku and Piccolo take a day off from training to enroll in driving school. These two mighty warriors may be the Earth's only chance for survival.

episodes.title: Z Warriors Prepare
episodes.overview: I Will Overcome… Goku!! The King of the Saiyan Warrior RaceGohan learns some new tricks, Vegeta pushes himself to the breaking point, and Yamcha struggles just to keep up.

episodes.title: Goku's Special Technique
episodes.overview: Goku's New Finishing Technique?! Watch This, My Instantaneous MovementThe future has been written - or has it? That's what Goku and the rest of the Z-Fighters must decide as they hear Trunks' ominous warning.

episodes.title: Mystery Revealed
episodes.overview: My Dad is Vegeta… Confessions of the Mysterious BoyAfter testing Goku in combat, the mysterious stranger reveals his true identity!

episodes.title: Welcome Back Goku
episodes.overview: Heya!! It's Been a While… Son Goku ReturnsAfter defeating Frieza and King Cold, the mysterious stranger announces the exact time and place of Goku's arrival on Earth.

episodes.title: Another Super Saiyan?
episodes.overview: Freeza Halved By a Single Blow!! Another Super SaiyanFrieza and King Cold descend upon the Earth, but a mysterious warrior has come to thwart their diabolical plot for revenge.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Youth
episodes.overview: I Will Defeat Freeza… The Mysterious Boy Awaiting GokuThe Earth faces its darkest hour as Frieza and his father King Cold rapidly approach!

episodes.title: Frieza's Counterattack
episodes.overview: That's Earth, Papa… Freeza and his Father Strike BackGohan's cracking the books, and his new tutor is cracking the whip!

episodes.title: Krillin's Proposal
episodes.overview: You're My Guy… Kuririn — The 101st ProposalKrillin faces his toughest challenge ever: surviving a shopping trip with Maron! And it looks like she's picking out a wedding dress!

episodes.title: Brief Chance for Victory
episodes.overview: Gohan's Brief Chance for Victory!! Destroy Planet Makyō…Blinded by rage and desperate to destroy his enemies, Garlic Junior uses his power to open up the Dead Zone!

episodes.title: The World Awakens
episodes.overview: The Ultra Holy Water Worked!! The World Awakens From its NightmareIn a last ditch effort to save his friends, Gohan launches an all out assault.

episodes.title: Extreme Measures
episodes.overview: A Battle of Extreme Measures!! Kami-sama Breaks the CovenantGarlic Junior and his Spice Boys harness the evil power of the Makyo Star to become stronger than ever, but Gohan, Krillin, and Piccolo are ready to battle.

episodes.title: Suicidal Course
episodes.overview: It Can't Wait Until Morning!! Kami-sama Decides on a Suicidal Course of ActionPiccolo and Krillin spring their trap, revealing that they have pretended to be infected by the Black Water Mist!

episodes.title: Call For Restoration
episodes.overview: Restore Everyone's Minds!! The Ultra Holy Water Resting in the TempleKrillin, after suffering a Spice Boys beating, attempts to free Kami and Mr. Popo, but he soon falls prey to the Black Water Mist.

episodes.title: Battle in Kami's Lookout
episodes.overview: The Heavens Become the Battlefield!! Piccolo Becomes Devilish Again…As Piccolo attempts to hold off the Spice Boys and the infected Z Fighters, Gohan and Krillin race toward Kami's Lookout.

episodes.title: Black Fog of Terror
episodes.overview: Black Mist of Terror…!! Everyone Turns DemonicGarlic Junior releases the Black Water Mist upon an unsuspecting world. As the dreaded fog spreads, so does Garlic Junior's control over the Earth!

episodes.title: The Heavens Tremble
episodes.overview: Terrible Happenings in Heaven!! Garlic Jr. Becomes God?!Gohan's going fishing, Krillin's found a girlfriend, and it looks as though peace has once again returned to the Earth.

episodes.title: Goku's Alive!!
episodes.overview: Son Goku Survived — The Z Warriors Are All Resurrected!!It is a time of joyful reunions as old friends long absent are finally wished home with the Dragon Balls! Krillin and Yamcha are brought back from the spirit realm.

episodes.title: Namek's Explosion... Goku's End?
episodes.overview: Planet Namek's Great Explosion!! Goku Disappears into SpaceEven though it looks like Goku is trapped on the exploding planet Namek, Dende has a good reason to celebrate: the Dragon Balls have the power to bring Goku back to life.

episodes.title: Mighty Blast of Rage
episodes.overview: Freeza Defeated!! A Single Blast Packed With a Totality of RageLearning that the Namekian Dragon Balls can revive humans many times, Gohan and the others let out a cry of joy. Now they can bring Krillin and Chiaozu back to life. On Namek, Goku's crushing victory brings an end to the deadly battle. However, as Goku leaves, Freeza strikes the final blow...

episodes.title: Frieza Defeated!
episodes.overview: Goku's Declaration of Victory!! As Freeza Destroys Himself…Frieza lashes out in a blind rage, launching a reckless volley of energy attacks. In the face of Goku's superior power, the evil tyrant's greatest fear has come true.

episodes.title: Pathos Of Frieza
episodes.overview: Pathos of Freeza! Once He Starts Shaking He's Unstoppable!!Time grows short for Goku as each passing second brings Namek closer to destruction.

episodes.title: Duel On A Vanishing Planet
episodes.overview: Let's Get It On!! Two Remain on a Vanishing PlanetGoku chooses to stay behind and finish his fight with Frieza.

episodes.title: The Last Wish
episodes.overview: I'm Staying on This Planet!! A Final Wish Toward VictoryThe Eldest and the people of Namek have been brought back to life, and the dragon Porunga has reappeared to grant the last of three wishes.

episodes.title: Gohan Returns
episodes.overview: I am Son Goku's Son!! Gohan Returns to the BattlefieldFrieza's victims have been wished back to life, but as they begin to rise, Goku falls - overwhelmed by Frieza's devastating assault.

episodes.title: Approaching Destruction
episodes.overview: Shenlong, Fly Through Space!! The Time of Namek's Destruction Draws NearThe battle between Goku and Frieza rages on! Back on Earth, the seven Dragon Balls have been restored.

episodes.title: A Final Attack
episodes.overview: I Am Going To Win… Risking Survival, A Final AttackWith only minutes to go before the planet explodes, Frieza reaches his maximum power!

episodes.title: Namek's Destruction
episodes.overview: The Destruction of Planet Namek?! A Demonic Flash Penetrates the GroundFinding himself no match for Goku, Frieza attacks Planet Namek! Unable to react in time, Goku is forced to watch helplessly as the fiery blast rips through the planet.

episodes.title: Explosion of Anger
episodes.overview: An Explosion of Anger!! Goku, Avenge Everyone's DeathsEngulfed in golden light, Goku announces that he is now a Super Saiyan.

episodes.title: Transformed At Last
episodes.overview: Transformed At Last!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son GokuA victory celebration comes to a halt when Frieza reappears! With no reserves left, Goku watches helplessly as Frieza directs his fury at Piccolo and Krillin.

episodes.title: Power of the Spirit
episodes.overview: The Incredible Destructive Force of the Genki-Dama!! Who Will Survive?!Chaos erupts on King Kai's planet as the Z-fighters battle the Ginyu Force!

episodes.title: Keep the Chance Alive
episodes.overview: Seize the Chance!! Piccolo's Suicide Support StrikeYamcha, Tenshinhan, and Chiaotzu find themselves in serious trouble when the Ginyu Force invades King Kai's planet!

episodes.title: Trump Card
episodes.overview: An Extra-Large Genki-Dama — This is the Final Trump Card!!Once again, Goku is rescued by a vision!

episodes.title: Embodiment of Fire
episodes.overview: Showdown!! The Embodiment of Flame in a 20-Fold Kaiō-Ken KamehamehaGoku's powerful Kaio-Ken attack has no effect on Frieza.

episodes.title: Bold and Fearless
episodes.overview: That Ain't No Bluff!! The Audaciously Wonderful Guy, Son GokuCaptain Ginyu returns to the battlefield in Bulma's body!

episodes.title: Freeza's Boast
