episodes.overview: Freeza's Terrible Declaration! I Will Defeat You Without Using My HandsFrieza vows to beat Goku without using his hands.

episodes.title: Clash of the Super Powers
episodes.overview: The Two Great Superpowers Collide! A Physical Battle Where Both Get Serious!!!Goku and Frieza continue their epic battle! An underwater attack puts Goku on top until Frieza traps him in an energy ball!

episodes.title: The Ultimate Battle
episodes.overview: The Curtain Opens on the Super Decisive Battle!! I Am Going to Defeat YouGoku wages war on the monstrous Frieza! As the fight intensifies, Frieza directs his energy blasts at Namek itself, turning the planet into a lava-spewing warzone.

episodes.title: The End of Vegeta
episodes.overview: Such Regret…!! The Proud Saiyan, Vegeta DiesGoku rejoins his friends on the battlefield, but not before Vegeta is defeated by Frieza!

episodes.title: The Renewed Goku
episodes.overview: The Moment We've Waited For!!! Son Goku is RevivedVegeta, who firmly believes himself to be a Super Saiyan, fires off a full-power energy blast at Frieza, but it is easily deflected with a kick. He despairs at the overwhelming difference in power. Shedding tears, he experiences failure for the first time in his life... Vegeta has completely lost the will to fight, and just as death draws nearer, Goku's wounds finally heal.

episodes.title: Dende's Demise
episodes.overview: The Death of Dende... Come Forth! Intense, Full-Force PowerHaving reached his ultimate form, Frieza is determined to destroy the remaining Z-fighters one by one, but Vegeta boldly announces the end of Frieza's reign.

episodes.title: Another Transformation?
episodes.overview: Fear Me!! Freeza Does Battle With a 3rd TransformationUnable to watch as Piccolo is overwhelmed by Frieza, Gohan springs into action! Meanwhile, Vegeta devises a risky plan.

episodes.title: Freeza's Second Transformation?
episodes.overview: Sally Forth, Goku!! A Furious Freeza's 2nd TransformationJust as it appears that Piccolo has gained the upper hand, Frieza quickly dashes all hopes for victory by revealing his second monstrous transformation!

episodes.title: Déjà vu
episodes.overview: Piccolo's Self-Confidence! I Will Be the One to Defeat FreezaPiccolo quickly takes control of the battle with Frieza, and the putrid purple monster is shocked to learn the secret behind his opponent's powers!

episodes.title: Piccolo the Super-Namek
episodes.overview: The Tide Suddenly Turns!! Piccolo, the Warrior Who Came LateVegeta witnesses Gohan's attack, but is unable to do anything due to the vast difference in strength. Just as Frieza is about to finish off Gohan, Krillin's Kienzan cuts Frieza's tail. Frieza is puzzled, and Krillin provokes him, running away. Dende takes advantage of the opportunity to rush over to Gohan. What power does Dende possess?

episodes.title: Captain Ginyu...The Frog
episodes.overview: A Huge Miscalculation!! Ginyu Has Turned into a FrogAs the bout between Captain Ginyu and Vegeta heats up, Goku summons the last of his strength and tricks his foe into reversing the Body Switch Technique. Now, Goku, Krillin, and Gohan must join forces with Vegeta for the battle with Frieza.

episodes.title: Gohan, Defeat Your Dad!!
episodes.overview: That Ain't Me! Gohan, Don't Lose Your Nerve, Hit Your Father!!After taking control of Goku's body, Captain Ginyu turns his attention to Gohan and Krillin! With Goku trapped in the Captain's broken body, it's up to Gohan to stop the rampaging Ginyu!

episodes.title: Calling the Eternal Dragon
episodes.overview: Come Forth, Super Shenlong!! Grant Me My WishArmed with the Dragon Radar, Gohan and Krillin recover the seven Dragon Balls from their hiding places. But before they can summon the Eternal Dragon to make their wish, they are confronted by a powerful new enemy - Goku?!

episodes.title: Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is Goku
episodes.overview: Surprise!! Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is GokuIn an attempt to save the Elder, Nail fights a hopeless battle against the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, finding himself no match for Goku's superior abilities, Captain Ginyu unleashes his ultimate attack, the Body Switch Technique!

episodes.title: Frieza Approaches
episodes.overview: What of the Battle's Outcome?! Freeza's Evil Hand Closes Around the EldestGoku astounds Captain Ginyu with his amazing new powers, but the Captain still has a few tricks up his sleeve! Meanwhile, Frieza arrives at the home of the Eldest Namek and begins a battle with the noble warrior, Nail!

episodes.title: Incredible Force!
episodes.overview: Incredible Force!! Did You See It, Goku's Full Power?As the battle between Goku and Captain Ginyu rages on, Gohan and Krillin steal the unguarded Dragon Balls from Frieza's ship. It's a race against time, and our heroes must unlock the power of the Dragon Balls before it's too late!

episodes.title: Ginyu Assault
episodes.overview: At Last, a Direct Confrontation!! Captain Ginyu Takes the FieldIn order to get Jeice and Burter to back off, Goku knocks Burter unconscious with one blow, showing the difference in their strength. Frightened by Goku's power, Jeice flies off to Commander Ginyu. Vegeta, infuriated that Jeice had escaped, finishes off Burter and Recoome, and berates Goku for being too soft on him. Meanwhile, Ginyu receives Jeice's report...

episodes.title: A Legend Revealed
episodes.overview: Lightning Balls of Red and Blue! Jheese and Butta Attack GokuJeice and Burter let their guard down when they see Goku's power level of 5,000 on their scouter, and begin their attack. However, even when the two of them launch direct attacks using their boastworthy speed, they are unable to land a single blow. Feeling that they are at a disadvantage in the hand-to-hand combat, the two finally activate their combined technique.

episodes.title: Goku's New Power
episodes.overview: Uncommon Strength!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son GokuFinally, Goku arrives. Understanding the entire situation, Goku gives Senzu Beans not only to Gohan and Krillin, but also to Vegeta. After making sure that the three are well, Goku goes up against Recoome by himself. Krillin and the others are worried that Goku is too calm, but Goku defeats Recoome with just one blow.

episodes.title: Let the Battle Begin
episodes.overview: Don't Die, Gohan! Goku Finally Touches Down on the BattlefieldHaving collected all seven Dragon Balls, Freeza heads to the Elder to find out how to grant his wish. Meanwhile, Gohan attacks Recoome. He fights with all his might, but Recoome doesn't look too worried.

episodes.title: Recoome Unleashed
episodes.overview: The Savage Reacoom! The Bad, Strong, and Outrageous GuyAfter defeating Guldo with a surprise attack, Vegeta faces off against Recoome. Vegeta launches a preemptive attack at full power, but even an attack with a battle power of 20,000 is ineffective against Recoome. Vegeta is left on the brink of death by the powerful attack. Just as he is about to be hit by Recoome's Eraser Gun, Krillin's quick thinking saves him.

episodes.title: Guldo's Mind Binds
episodes.overview: Is This Some Super-Magic or Just a Trick!? Mr. Gurd is Angry!The battle with the Ginyu Force begins, as Gohan and Krillin launch a barrage of explosive energy blasts at Guldo! The Heroes are rendered helpless by Guldo's Mind Blind technique, and this time, there is no one to save them!

episodes.title: New Ally, New Problem
episodes.overview: Goku on Final Approach! Smash through Freeza's DragnetThe Ginyu Force finally arrives on Planet Namek. The only way to defeat them is to make Vegeta immortal with the power of the Dragon Balls... Krillin and the others work with Vegeta to collect the Dragon Balls, but then the Ginyu Force appears.

episodes.title: Hidden Power
episodes.overview: The Great Battle Approaches! The Ginyu Special Squadron Takes the Stage!!After successfully completing his training, Goku rests on the spaceship in preparation for the final battle on Planet Namek. Meanwhile, Krillin and Gohan finally arrive at the Elder's place, where they encounter Vegeta. They manage to draw out Gohan's power, but it is no match for Vegeta's. Then, five large powers approach Planet Namek.

episodes.title: Bulma's Big Day
episodes.overview: Charge!! The Kaiō-Ken and Kamehameha of an Indomitable SpiritFreeza's subordinates hear Bulma's story and start plotting to get the Dragon Balls for themselves. Bulma tricks them into thinking there are still Dragon Balls remaining in the ocean and takes them on a tour of the ocean in a submarine, but her lie is exposed along the way! Meanwhile, inside the spaceship, Goku has overcome 100 times the gravity.

episodes.title: Destination: Guru
episodes.overview: Bulma, Watch Out!! The Four-Star Ball Falls into Freeza's HandsFreeza unleashes a gigantic blast of energy that shakes the earth, causing Bulma's four-star ball to fall into the sea. Bulma hurriedly dives into the sea in a submarine and confronts a giant crab guarding the Dragon Ball and countless eggs. She manages to retrieve the Dragon Ball safely and return to the surface, but is then captured by Freeza's minions.

episodes.title: Unknown Enemies
episodes.overview: Freeza's Secret Weapon! The Devilish Ginyu Special SquadronThe Ginyu Special Forces launch from Planet Freeza! At their destination, Planet Namek, Gohan returns to Bulma with the Dragon Ball, but is discovered by Vegeta. However, Gohan quickly hides the Dragon Ball from Vegeta, and without a moment's rest, he rushes to the Elder's house with Krillin to have his potential unlocked.

episodes.title: Gohan, the Hunted
episodes.overview: I'm Back to My Old Self Again!! Goku Takes on 100 Times GravityVegeta, who is after Krillin's Dragon Ball, and Zarbon, who has been chasing him, meet again. However, Vegeta easily defeats Zarbon after he transforms. Resigned to his strength, Krillin hands over the last Dragon Ball. At the same time, Goku inside the spaceship continues to fight against 100 times the gravity caused by a magnetic storm.

episodes.title: Zarbon's Mission
episodes.overview: An Enormous Battle Power!! Freeza's Strategy is ShatteredVegeta steals the Dragon Ball from Freeza's spaceship and escapes! In an attempt to collect them all at once, he chases Krillin, who rushes to Bulma with the last one, but Zarbon, who notices the chase, appears and they are on the brink of an explosive confrontation. Meanwhile, Gohan takes advantage of Vegeta's distraction and gets the Dragon Ball that was sunk in the pond.

episodes.title: Piccolo vs. Everyone
episodes.overview: Back from the Brink of Death — The Miracle Man, VegetaOn Kaio's planet, Tenshinhan and the others continue their training against Bubbles and Gregory, but Piccolo, who has doubts about the results of his training, is the only one who does not participate. However, when they start sparring, Piccolo is surprised at how much Yamcha's skills have improved since before. Meanwhile, on Planet Namek, Vegeta has been treated from his injuries and has made a comeback.

episodes.title: Guru's Gift
episodes.overview: Defend the Planet of Hope!! Kuririn's Astonishing Power-UpWhen Krillin speaks to the Eldest Namekian, he gets a double surprise! Not only does he receive a Dragon Ball, but the sleeping powers within him are awoken! Will Krillin's incredible new strength be enough to save his friends?

episodes.title: Zarbon's Special Surprise
episodes.overview: Nothing but Goosebumps! The Handsome Warrior Zarbon's Devilish TransformationVegeta's latest battle heats up as Zarbon reveals his true power: the ability to transform into a monstrous beast! With his increased size and strength, Zarbon seems ready to turn the lights out on the Saiyan Prince - permanently!

episodes.title: The Past and the Future
episodes.overview: Listen to Me Goku! Hands Off FreezaKing Kai becomes concerned after learning that Goku is on a collision course with the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, back on Planet Namek, the battle between Vegeta and Zarbon has begun!

episodes.title: Vegeta has a Ball
episodes.overview: Courage Times One Hundred! The Warriors Gather Under KaiōWith his new abilities, Vegeta quickly tracks down and forcefully acquires another Dragon Ball. Now, there is only one magic orb left to find, and Dende knows who has it - the Eldest Namekian!

episodes.title: Unexpected Problem
episodes.overview: Escape From a Burning Planet!! A Life-or-Death KamehamehaGoku's journey to Namek takes an unexpected detour when his spaceship is knocked off course by an asteroid! Goku has to act fast to get his ship back on track because he's headed straight for the fiery centre of a star!

episodes.title: The Prince Fights Back
episodes.overview: Dodoria Dies by Explosion! Vegeta's Fearsome ShockwaveDodoria's search for Krillin and Gohan brings him face to face with an unexpected foe - Vegeta! The Saiyan prince has a score to settle with Dodoria, and the time for a final showdown between these two powerful villains has arrived!

episodes.title: The Hunted
episodes.overview: Gohan in Peril! A Pursuing Dodoria Summons DeathGohan risks his life to rescue a Namek boy from the clutches of Frieza's evil henchmen. Now Gohan and Krillin have an even bigger problem on their hands: Dodoria is chasing them, and he won't stop until he has his revenge!

episodes.title: Namek's Defense
episodes.overview: Surprise Attack!! The Elder's Target was the ScouterKrillin and Gohan get their first glimpse of Frieza's cruelty as the villain unleashes his henchmen upon an unsuspecting Namek village. Frieza wants the fifth Dragon Ball, and he is prepared to learn its location by any means necessary!

episodes.title: Defying Orders
episodes.overview: Goku's Power at Full-Force!! Six Days to the End of the GalaxyWith the odds rapidly mounting against them, Krillin and Gohan will need some serious help if they hope to recover the Dragon Balls from Frieza and his henchmen.

episodes.title: Frieza Strikes!
episodes.overview: Vegeta's Ambition! I am the Greatest Warrior in the Universe!!Krillin, Gohan, and Bulma are horrified to see Vegeta's space pod land on Planet Namek, but the Saiyan Prince is the least of their problems. Yet another epically evil villain has come to Namek in search of the Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Brood of Evil
episodes.overview: A Tough New Enemy! Emperor of the Universe, FreezaBulma, Krillin, and Gohan finally continue their quest to locate all seven Dragon balls. Unfortunately, the gang soon discovers that they aren't the only ones seeking the magical balls.

episodes.title: A Friendly Surprise
episodes.overview: The Dragon Balls Are All Here! Piccolo-san Comes Back to LifeAs Bulma, Krillin, and Gohan close in on the last of the Dragon Balls, they uncover a shocking secret about their Namekian friends. Meanwhile, Goku works to build up his strength, and Vegeta sets his sights on revenge!

episodes.title: The Search Continues
episodes.overview: Planet Freeza No. 79 — Vegeta Recovers!!Gohan, Krillin, and Bulma continue their search for the Dragon Balls with the help of their new friend Zarkro. Back on Earth, Goku has escaped from the hospital to begin training for his upcoming re-match with Vegeta.

episodes.title: Look Out Below
episodes.overview: Kind-hearted Aliens — There's the Five-Star Ball AlreadyA near-fatal crash landing turns out to have a silver lining when Bulma, Gohan, and Krillin are rescued by two friendly Namekians who agree to help them locate the seven Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: Held Captive
episodes.overview: Really, for Real? There Lies Namek, Planet of HopeBulma, Gohan, and Krillin are mistaken for friends of Frieza and taken prisoner by an angry army of children! To regain their freedom and continue on their mission, the gang must convince the kids of their innocence.

episodes.title: Friends or Foes?
episodes.overview: Friends or Foes? Children of the Mysterious Giant SpaceshipGohan, Bulma, and Krillin blast off for Planet Namek in search of the magic Dragon Balls, but their journey quickly turns chaotic when they encounter a bizarre situation in the vacuum of space!

episodes.title: Nursing Wounds
episodes.overview: Blast-off for Planet Namek! The Terror Awaiting Gohan and CompanyGoku, Krillin, and Gohan prepare for the return of the Saiyans. Meanwhile, Bulma and Mr. Popo search for a second spaceship capable of transporting her to Planet Namek.

episodes.title: Plans for Departure
episodes.overview: The Mysterious Yunzabit! The Search for Kami-sama's SpaceshipBulma accidentally destroys the Saiyan spaceship! Luckily, Mr. Popo reveals the existence of another ship that may be able to reach Namek. Can they find it in time, and will the old ship still work if they do?

episodes.title: Picking Up the Pieces
episodes.overview: We're Off Into Space! The Planet of Hope is Piccolo's HomelandThe gang mourns the loss of Yamcha, Tenshinhan, Chiaotzu, and Piccolo. With Kami gone, Earth's Dragon Balls have disappeared. Will the surviving heroes find a way to wish their fallen friends back to life?

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.overview: Cause a Miracle! The Super Saiyan Son GohanVegeta is crushed beneath the full weight of Gohan's giant ape form! With the Saiyan battered and defeated, Krillin moves to finish the Saiyan with a final blow - but Goku has other plans.

episodes.title: Krillin's Offensive
episodes.overview: Shoot, Kuririn! The Genki-Dama, Packed with HopeGoku passes the power of the Spirit Bomb to Krillin, who - with King Kai's guidance - launches the bomb at Vegeta. The Saiyan is sent flying into the sky, but is the evil warrior really gone for good?

episodes.title: Hero in the Shadows
episodes.overview: Don't Die, Father!! This is Gohan's Hidden StrengthWith Goku caught in the clutches of the giant ape Vegeta, Krillin attacks with his Destructo Disk! When his effort falls short, an unlikely hero steps out of the shadows!

episodes.title: Spirit Bomb Away!
episodes.overview: Battle Power Times 10!! Vegeta's Great TransformationGoku feels the brunt of Vegeta's fully-realised Saiyan power! Earth's greatest hero is left with no choice except to use the Spirit Bomb. If his attack fails, he may find himself completely doomed!

episodes.title: Saiyan Sized Secret
episodes.overview: Now, Goku! A Final Technique with Everything on the LineVegeta and Goku continue trading brutal blows, but the action intensifies when Vegeta reveals the secret power of the Saiyans: the ability to transform into a giant, planet-destroying ape!

episodes.title: Goku vs. Vegeta
episodes.overview: A Hot, Unbounded Battle! Goku vs VegetaGoku decides to take on mighty Vegeta all by himself! The two appear evenly matched, but both are hiding their true strength. The epic battle is underway - which mighty warrior will claim victory?

episodes.title: Lesson Number One
episodes.overview: Father is Awesome! The Ultimate Finishing Technique: Kaiō-KenLocked in battle with the Saiyans, Goku gives Nappa a brutal demonstration of the training he received from King Kai. Broken and defeated, Nappa must now face the ferocious wrath of Vegeta!

episodes.title: Goku's Arrival
episodes.overview: Ferocity of the Saiyans! God and Piccolo Both Die!Piccolo makes the ultimate sacrifice to save Gohan from the rampaging Saiyans. Just when all seems lost, Goku returns to Earth with an incredible new level of power and confronts the invaders.

episodes.title: Nimbus Speed
episodes.overview: Leave it to Me! Gohan's Great Burst of AngerPiccolo, Gohan, and Krillin do their best to stop the Saiyans from finding the Dragon Balls. Meanwhile, Goku rushes back to Earth on the Flying Nimbus, armed with more power than ever before!

episodes.title: Nappa's Rampage
episodes.overview: An Intense 3-Hour Delay! The Kinto-Un Bullet-ExpressVegeta has called a halt to the fighting, and Nappa uses the time to go on a rampage! Meanwhile, Goku reaches the end of Snake Way and races to re-join his friends - but is he already too late?

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Tenshinhan Cries Out!! This is My Last KikōhōChiaotzu sacrifices himself to save his friends from Nappa, but when the smoke clears, the villain still stands! Luckily, Tenshinhan has one trick left that could forever silence the Saiyan warrior!

episodes.title: The Power of Nappa
episodes.overview: Farewell, Ten-san! Chaozu's Suicide StrategyEnraged over the loss of Yamcha, Krillin unleashes a powerful attack that destroys the maniacal Saibamen once and for all. Now Earth's defenders must battle the Saiyans themselves - starting with Nappa.

episodes.title: Saibamen Attack!
episodes.overview: Yamcha Dies! The Terror of the SaibaimanKrillin, Piccolo, and Gohan stand face to face with the sinister Saiyans and their diabolical henchmen. The villains have already proven terrifyingly powerful. Can Earth's heroes hold out until Goku arrives?

episodes.title: The Darkest Day
episodes.overview: Unbelievable!! Saibaimen, Born from the SoilThe Saiyans Vegeta and Nappa landed on Earth, searching for the one with the highest combat ability, and flew to where Piccolo and Gohan were.

episodes.title: Counting Down
episodes.overview: Come Forth, Shenlong! The Saiyans Finally Arrive on EarthGoku finishes his training on King Kai's planet and tests the power of the super technique, the Spirit Bomb, taught to him by King Kai. However, the Saiyans are approaching Earth sooner than expected. Furthermore, King Kai's miscalculation is discovered, and Goku is forced to return to the lower world in a hurry.

episodes.title: Goku's Ancestors
episodes.overview: The Return of the Saiyan Legend! Goku's RootsThe next training that King Kai assigns to Goku is to hit Gregory with a hammer. Gregory is faster than Bubbles, so Goku desperately pursues him! One day, King Kai tells Goku the history of the evil Saiyans and how they were wiped out, leaving only four of them.

episodes.title: Defying Gravity
episodes.overview: The Battle with Gravity! Catch Bubbles-kunGoku finally meets King Kai on King Kai's planet. He somehow manages to pass the gag test (?) set by King Kai, who loves puns, and finally begins his training on King Kai's planet. He chases King Kai's pet Bubbles for three weeks in gravity ten times that of Earth. After Goku successfully overcomes gravity and captures Bubbles, King Kai has certain expectations of him.

episodes.title: The End of Snake Way
episodes.overview: Last Stop on Serpent Road! Are you Kaiō-sama?Six months have passed since the tail was cut off, and Gohan's tail has regenerated and he has once again transformed into a giant monkey! Piccolo immediately tries to destroy the moon, but no matter how much he attacks, he is unable to destroy it. Meanwhile, Goku has finally reached the end of the Snake Way.

episodes.title: Pendulum Room Peril
episodes.overview: City of No Tomorrow! The Long Road to VictoryPiccolo and Gohan return to the wilderness and begin their training. After that, Krillin and the others, who are fed up with not receiving much training, are led to a room where all time is mixed together and are sent on a journey through time. Having traveled through time and space, the four are suddenly attacked by a mysterious duo.

episodes.title: Plight of the Children
episodes.overview: Run, Gohan! Longing for Mt. Paozu, Where Chi-Chi is WaitingGohan is caught in a storm and thrown into the sea, where he washes up on a shore where he is rescued by some unknown children. The group is orphans who have lost their parents and are living alone in the ruins, led by the eldest, Piguero. They refuse to be placed in an orphanage and have been on the run.

episodes.title: Dueling Piccolos
episodes.overview: Escape from Piccolo! Gohan Summons a StormWhen Goku had finally traveled halfway, Gohan, who was training in the wilderness, became homesick and tried to go back home. However, no matter how much he ran along the coast after passing through the desert, he always ended up back where he started. Curious, Gohan climbed a mountain and discovered that he was on an island.

episodes.title: Princess Snake
episodes.overview: Such Sweet Temptation! The Snake Princess's HospitalityKrillin and the others begin their training at Kami's Lookout. Then, Goku returns to Snake Way and discovers a mansion along the way, where he is drawn in by a mysterious force. What's more, the owner of the mansion, the Snake Princess, falls in love with Goku at first sight. She uses various tactics to try and stop him, but Goku evades all of her temptations and tries to hurry on.

episodes.title: Goz and Mez
episodes.overview: Hands Off! Enma-sama's Secret FruitTenshinhan and his friends start climbing the Karin Tower to undergo training from God. At the same time, Goku slips off Snake Way while sleeping and falls into Hell. Unable to return, Goku tries to eat the fruit of the Enshou Tree, but the demons Gozu and Mezu notice him. However, after hearing the story, they challenge Goku to a game of tag, on the condition that they show him the way out of Snake Way.

episodes.title: Global Training
episodes.overview: Catnap on the Serpent Road — Goku Takes a TumbleDespite being followed around by Lunch, Tenshinhan continues his training with Chiaotzu at a waterfall deep in the mountains. After hearing the story of Krillin and Bulma, he decides to undergo training from Kami. At the same time, Goku has finally made it halfway down the Snake Path.

episodes.title: Terror on Arlia
episodes.overview: The Saiyan, Strongest Warriors in the Universe, Awaken!Vegeta and Nappa, two Saiyans heading to Earth, plan to plunder Planet Arlia on the way. However, the once fertile planet Arlia has become a ruined planet ruled by a dictator. The two are obediently taken to the castle, but Nappa wipes out the soldiers and easily defeats the ultimate monster weapon.

episodes.title: A New Friend
episodes.overview: Don't Cry Gohan! His First FightKrillin visits Yamcha in preparation for the crisis one year from now. Yamcha, who had left martial arts to become a professional baseball player, decides to train under Kami after learning of Goku's death and the Saiyan invasion. Meanwhile, Gohan, who has been surviving in the wilderness, begins caring for an injured herbivorous dinosaur.

episodes.title: The Strangest Robot
episodes.overview: Sorry Robot-san — The Tears that Vanished in the DesertGohan falls into a hole in the desert and discovers a robot buried in sand in an ancient underground ruin. The robot tells him not to disturb its sleep, but Gohan, reluctantly, wakes it up again and again. As the robot looks after Gohan, it begins to get along with him.

episodes.title: Gohan Goes Bananas!
episodes.overview: The Great Transformation on a Moonlit Night! The Secret of Gohan's PowerKrillin receives a startling message. Korin wants him to gather Yamcha, Tien, and Chiaotzu and report for special training! And if that weren't enough, he and Roshi still have to find a way to tell Chichi what's happened to Goku and her son. Meanwhile, Gohan's training causes him to undergo a shocking transformation!

episodes.title: Day 1
episodes.overview: Dinosaur Survival! Gohan's Difficult TrainingGohan begins his first day of Piccolo's training. Alone in the wilderness, he must quickly learn to take care of himself. But that isn't easy when he's tired, hungry -- and being chased by hungry dinosaurs! If Gohan's first day is this dangerous, how will he ever survive for the second?

episodes.title: No Time Like the Present
episodes.overview: Even Enma-sama is Surprised — A Fight in the AfterlifeWith Raditz defeated and Goku gone from this world, the surviving Z-Fighters must begin preparing for the arrival of two more Saiyans who will reach Earth in one year's time. Piccolo takes Gohan into the wild for a severe training program, in the hope that his hidden power will be revealed. Meanwhile, Goku embarks on a new adventure in the next world, as he must travel the endless miles of Snake Way to receive training from the legendary King Kai!

episodes.title: Gohan's Rage
episodes.overview: Goku Dies! There's Only One Chance LeftAs Goku takes blow after punishing blow from the evil Raditz, Gohan is able to watch no longer! The young boy's rage unlocks an awesome power sleeping within him, and he unleashes a mighty attack that not even Radtiz can resist! But as quickly as Gohan's power appears, it vanishes. And when Raditz prepares to strike back, Goku must make the ultimate sacrifice to save his son!

episodes.title: Piccolo's Plan
episodes.overview: Piccolo's Trump Card! Gohan is a CrybabyThe situation looks bleak for Goku and Piccolo, as Raditz easily deflects every attack they send his way. But Piccolo may have a way to stop the sinister Saiyan. He's perfected a powerful new attack... the Special Beam Cannon! There's only one problem. Piccolo needs time to gather the energy for the blast, which means Goku will have to last for five minutes against Raditz alone!

episodes.title: Unlikely Alliance
episodes.overview: Alright! This is the Strongest Combo on Earth!Raditz has kidnapped Gohan! And unless Goku agrees to forsake his friends and the people of Earth by joining the sinister Saiyan, he may never see his son again! All hope is not lost, however, as a second uninvited guest arrives on the island and Goku forges an unlikely alliance!

episodes.title: Reunions
episodes.overview: The Strongest Warrior in All of History is Goku's Brother!Goku and Gohan attend a reunion on Master Roshi's island, where Goku introduces his son to all of his old friends. The smiles quickly fade, however, as an unexpected visitor lands on the island, and for Goku the day becomes a reunion of a different kind. A powerful alien has arrived. It's Raditz, Goku's evil older brother!

episodes.title: The New Threat
episodes.overview: Mini Goku is Just Precious! I'm GohanWith no new battles to fight, Goku has been living a quiet life in the countryside with his wife Chi-chi and their son Gohan! While Goku makes plans to spend a happy day with friends on Master Roshi's island, a powerful new threat is on its way to Earth. And the arrival of this sinister alien could spell disaster for Goku and his friends!

title: Ek Bhram - Sarvagun Sampanna
overview: Appearances can be deceptive and so is Jhanvi, the perfect bahu of the Mittal household. Fuelled by revenge, she's planning a sinister future for her 'beloved' in-laws. No one knows why?

episodes.title: Pooja Takes Charge of the Business
Kabir Takes a Stand for Kavya

title: The Expanse
overview: A thriller set two hundred years in the future following the case of a missing young woman who brings a hardened detective and a rogue ship's captain together in a race across the solar system to expose the greatest conspiracy in human history.

title: The Flash
overview: After being struck by lightning, CSI investigator Barry Allen awakens from a nine-month coma to discover he has been  granted the gift of super speed.  Teaming up with S.T.A.R. Labs, Barry takes on the persona of The Flash, the Fastest  Man Alive, to protect his city.

episodes.title: A New World, Part 4: Finale
episodes.overview: The Flash, the fastest man alive, is tasked with his greatest challenge yet, to save the timeline and save existence. Friends old and new gather for an epic battle to save Central City, one last time.

episodes.title: A New World, Part 3: Changes
episodes.overview: Team Flash works together to figure out how to protect Barry, all while being very careful who they trust. Cecile is skeptical of the plan after an unsuccessful attempt. Khione's confidence in Chester enables him to convince Cecile to try one more time.

episodes.title: A New World, Part 2: The Blues
episodes.overview: Iris is alarmed by Barry's disappearance and Cecile assures her everything will be ok, but does she know that for certain? Team Flash is affected by a mysterious substance and Khione develops a better understanding of what she can and cannot control.

episodes.title: A New World, Part 1: Reunions
episodes.overview: As Iris receives word of a career milestone, Barry is suddenly nowhere to be found. In trying to get back home, Barry runs across many familiar faces. Khione continues to figure out her powers and Chester works on a suit for Allegra.

episodes.title: It's My Party and I'll Die If I Want To
episodes.overview: Team Flash throws a surprise birthday party for Barry but things go terribly awry when Ramsey Rosso crashes the festivities.

episodes.title: Partners in Time
episodes.overview: A seemingly simple mold inspection at S.T.A.R. Labs leads to unexpected time anomalies. Barry and Iris try to make sense of the confusion – and figure out how to get back to their reality. Chester admits a secret to Allegra which makes things awkward between the two, and Allegra relies on Cecile to act as a buffer. Meanwhile, Khione meets with an old friend of Team Flash.

episodes.title: Wildest Dreams
episodes.overview: Iris is visited by Nia Nal, as she needs Iris' help. When Iris and Nia fall into a fever dream and explore different possibilities for their lives, Barry, Chester, Allegra and Cecile  desperately try to help them. Meanwhile, Mark entertains Khione but they have different ideas of what is fun, leaving Khione to feel that Mark is trying to make her something she is not.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Lucky
episodes.overview: As Barry and Iris prepare for their new life, luck changes for those in Central City. Cecile takes on a case with Allegra's help, involving a string of unfortunate – and highly unexpected – events. Meanwhile, Chester and the team work with Khione to figure out her abilities.

episodes.title: The Mask of the Red Death, Part Two
episodes.overview: As the Red Death wreaks havoc on Central City, Barry and Iris come up with a plan and turn to Cecile for help. Barry is faced with what he thinks was his greatest mistake, and the Red Death's greatest success. Khione wants to help Team Flash, but Barry can't risk losing her. Joe gives Barry a very much needed pep talk.

episodes.title: The Mask of the Red Death, Part One
episodes.overview: The Flash is forced to make an impossible choice. With the power out in the city, Team Flash calls upon the Rogue Squad to help as Iris is visited by an old friend. Joe and Cecile work on finding a balance.

episodes.title: Rogues of War
episodes.overview: Barry and Iris start to put together the pieces of what's happening in Central City and believe they know what the Rogues are after. Team Flash works together and recruits some unlikely allies to help, and the plan does not go as Team Flash expects. Meanwhile, Allegra does her best to avoid having a conversation with Chester.

episodes.title: Hear No Evil
episodes.overview: Barry feels guilty for what happened to Caitlin and Mark comes up with a plan which makes everyone skeptical. Meanwhile, Red Death looms in Central City and commands that failure is not an option. Joe asks Cecile to make a choice which leads Cecile to think about the greater good. Allegra and Chester take a step in a new direction. Lastly, old friends pay an unexpected visit to S.T.A.R. Labs.

episodes.title: Wednesday Ever After
episodes.overview: Barry creates a map book to guide him and Iris throughout their future in order to keep her safe, but the results are not what he expected, and instead, they relive the same day over and over again. Joe has a heart-to-heart with Cecile. A new big bad is introduced to Team Flash and friends and foes, old and new, begin to descend upon Central City.

episodes.title: Negative, Part Two
episodes.overview: With The Flash still reeling from everything that just happened, the rest of the team rallies to support him when he needs it the most.

episodes.title: Negative, Part One
episodes.overview: The Flash and team are in for the fight of their lives, meanwhile, Iris discovers the cause of her time sickness.

episodes.title: The Man in the Yellow Tie
episodes.overview: With a new speedster in town, The Flash gets much more than he bargained for, meanwhile Cecile's powers experience a growth spurt allowing her to aid Team Flash on an entirely different level.

episodes.title: Keep It Dark
episodes.overview: The Flash goes off the grid to look for answers about a new Meta in town. Meanwhile, Allegra pulls out all of the stops at CC Citizen Media, to protect a source and a friend.

episodes.title: The Curious Case of Bartholomew Allen
episodes.overview: The Flash gets blasted with a shockwave forcing his body to age prematurely.

episodes.title: Into the Still Force
episodes.overview: The Flash gets an assist from XS. Meanwhile, CCPD enlists Chester for help when a mysterious device is found at a crime scene.

episodes.title: Funeral for a Friend
episodes.overview: Team Flash uses the distraction of a bank robbing Meta to detract from the grief of losing someone they love.

episodes.title: Death Falls
episodes.overview: Team Flash is under attack, and each must fight to save not only themselves but each other.

episodes.title: Death Rises
episodes.overview: With a new Meta terrorizing the city, Joe lends a hand to the local authorities, meanwhile, Barry gets an assist from Cecille who helps to track the mass murderer.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Barry and Chester may have found a way to stop the "Black Flame" from hurting anyone else meanwhile Caitlin decides to handle a situation on her own, possibly putting more innocent lives in danger.

episodes.title: Reckless
episodes.overview: Barry's desire to keep Team Flash safe is tested when Frost recklessly courts danger as she tries to stop the "Black Flame", meanwhile, Iris, tries to help a teen girl reunite with her mother but unintentionally does more harm than good.

episodes.title: Phantoms
episodes.overview: Barry and Team Flash get closer to figuring out the Fire Meta but no closer to finding him meanwhile Iris, needing a distraction, follows a story to Coast City.

episodes.title: The Fire Next Time
episodes.overview: Barry trusts his instincts during a murder investigation, believing the suspect, despite the overwhelming evidence against him, meanwhile Iris gives Allegra an opportunity to be a mentor.

episodes.title: Lockdown
episodes.overview: When a criminal invades the CCPD, Barry and Kramer must trust and rely on each other if they are going to make it out safely. Meanwhile, Caitlin learns a valuable lesson while out with Snow and Mark.

episodes.title: Impulsive Excessive Disorder
episodes.overview: Picking up where season 7 left off, after returning home from a visit for their parent's vow renewal, Bart and Nora quickly realize that things are not exactly as they left them. The duo race to repair any fissures in the timeline and restore everything back to the way it is supposed to be.

episodes.title: Armageddon, Part 5
episodes.overview: The conclusion to Armageddon presents an opportunity for The Flash to end his lifelong battle with Reverse Flash for good, but the payoff could be too much for Barry and team to handle. Meanwhile, Mia Queen drops in from the future looking to save a lost loved one, and she won't let anything stand in her way.

episodes.title: Armageddon, Part 4
episodes.overview: Barry is shocked when Eobard Thawne returns in the most unexpected way, and with a tie to a loved one. Damien Darhk offers advice to Barry but there is a catch. An epic battle begins with Reverse Flash pitted against The Flash, Team Flash, Batwoman, Sentinel and Ryan Choi.

episodes.title: Armageddon, Part 3
episodes.overview: Barry meets Black Lightning at the Hall of Justice after things take a dire turn with Despero. Iris suspects something is off with Despero's vision of the future so she seeks help from a powerful ally.

episodes.title: Armageddon, Part 2
episodes.overview: Despero warns The Flash that great tragedies will befall the speedster and cause him to lose his mind. Once that happens, Armageddon will begin. Determined to prove Despero wrong, Barry doubles down on proving his innocence but a devastating revelation from Iris pushes him to the edge and sends him to seek counsel from Black Lightning.

episodes.title: Armageddon, Part 1
episodes.overview: A powerful alien threat arrives on Earth under mysterious circumstances and Barry, Iris and the rest of Team Flash are pushed to their limits in a desperate battle to save the world. But with time running out, and the fate of humanity at stake, Flash and his companions will also need to enlist the help of some old friends if the forces of good are to prevail.

episodes.title: Heart of the Matter, Part 2
episodes.overview: The Flash enlists a host of speedster allies, including Iris and his children from the future—Bart and Nora West-Allen—to end the speedster war and defeat a deadly new adversary: the villainous Godspeed.

episodes.title: Heart of the Matter, Part 1
episodes.overview: Barry and Iris greet their future children, XS and Bart, only for a shocking secret to threaten their new familial harmony. Meanwhile, the Godspeed war intensifies and threatens to destroy Central City.

episodes.title: P.O.W.
episodes.overview: John Diggle arrives in Central City with a weapon to help Barry stop the Godspeed War. Meanwhile, Allegra and Ultraviolet's new bond is put to the ultimate test, while Joe and Kristin Kramer are hunted by a former colleague of hers.

episodes.title: Enemy at the Gates
episodes.overview: When an army of Godspeeds attack Central City, Barry and Iris must put their family plans on hold and focus on the latest threat to their home. Meanwhile, Chillblaine is released from prison and claims to be reformed but Frost has her doubts.

episodes.title: Rayo de Luz
episodes.overview: When Ultraviolet returns to Central City, Allegra is determined to find her cousin and change her heart. Meanwhile, Joe finds evidence that Kristen Kramer may not be the good cop she appears to be.

episodes.title: Masquerade
episodes.overview: Cecile is forced to confront her past in order to break free from a psychic prison. Meanwhile, Chester takes over for Cisco but makes a mistake that puts Barry in serious danger. Joe investigates Kristen Kramer's old military ties and discovers an unsettling truth.

episodes.title: Good-Bye Vibrations
episodes.overview: Cisco and Kamila tell the team they are leaving Central City. However, Barry, Iris and Caitlin don't have much time to digest the news because a new version of Rainbow Raider strikes and OG Team Flash must join together one final time to save the city.

episodes.title: Family Matters, Part 2
episodes.overview: Barry and Iris come together to try and stop a dangerous force from destroying Central City.

episodes.title: Family Matters, Part 1
episodes.overview: Iris seeks to uncover the mysterious truth about Psych. Meanwhile, Barry initiates a new training system, that could potentially backfire, with devastating consequences. Joe and Cisco make life-altering decisions.

episodes.title: Timeless
episodes.overview: After a devastating betrayal, Barry turns to Timeless Wells for help. Meanwhile, Iris leads Team Citizen down a dangerous road in search of answers, and Cisco makes a surprising announcement to Kamilla.

episodes.title: The People v. Killer Frost
episodes.overview: With Frost facing an unjust punishment for her past crimes, Caitlin goes to great lengths to save her sister. Meanwhile, Barry's efforts to protect Speed Force Nora lead to a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Growing Pains
episodes.overview: When a mysterious ice powered enemy frames Frost for a brutal crime, she must find a way to clear her name. Meanwhile, Barry and Iris have a surprise houseguest, and Joe continues to deal with Kristen Kramer.

episodes.title: The One with the Nineties
episodes.overview: Cisco and Chester travel back in time and get stuck in 1998, repeating the same day over and over again. The key to returning home is at Chester's childhood home but he refuses to visit. Meanwhile, Iris forges a connection with the speed force.

episodes.title: Fear Me
episodes.overview: When a powerful new villain channels and amplifies everyone's fears in order to wreck havoc on Central City, Barry realizes that he must face his own worst fear in order to beat this new threat.

episodes.title: Central City Strong
episodes.overview: The Flash must deal with Abra Kadabra's sudden return to Central City; Allegra deals with a tricky situation; Caitlin suspects something is off with Frost; Iris is forced to look at a dark moment in her past.

episodes.title: Mother
episodes.overview: As Eva becomes more powerful, Barry and team must find a way to stop her. They are shocked when an old friend - Sue Dearbon risks her life to help.

episodes.title: The Speed of Thought
episodes.overview: When Barry suddenly gains the power of speed thinking, he attempts to use his new gift to save Iris. While Barry is thrilled with his new power, Cisco is hesitant to trust it. Meanwhile, Eva must face a shattering truth.

episodes.title: All's Well That Ends Wells
episodes.overview: When an experiment to save Barry's speed backfires, Nash Wells searches for a way to save The Flash and comes up with a dangerous plan. Meanwhile, Iris makes a startling realization inside the Mirrorverse and Cecile faces off with Rosa Dillon.

episodes.title: Success Is Assured
episodes.overview: Barry considers a risky plan to save Iris from the Mirrorverse. Ralph attempts to stop Sue from making a grave mistake that could destroy her life.

episodes.title: Pay the Piper
episodes.overview: When Godspeed returns, Barry turns to Hartley Rathaway for help; things get tense quickly after Barry realizes one of the changes from Crisis is that The Flash and Pied Piper are now enemies; Iris tries to escape the Mirrorverse.

episodes.title: Liberation
episodes.overview: After recent events, Barry takes a closer look at his life with Iris. Eva makes a bold move.

episodes.title: So Long and Goodnight
episodes.overview: After Black Hole hires Rag Doll to kill Joe, Singh suggests he go into Witness Protection but Joe refuses to stop investigating Carver. While investigating Carver with Cisco, Ralph runs into Sue. Iris becomes suspicious of Eva.

episodes.title: The Exorcism of Nash Wells
episodes.overview: The Flash takes on a dangerous new meta named Sunshine. Cisco sets out to help Nash.

episodes.title: Death of the Speed Force
episodes.overview: Kid Flash returns to Central City with a Zen attitude and new tricks up his sleeve. While thrilled to see his family again, Wally confides to Barry that he returned because he thinks there is something wrong with the speed force. Meanwhile, Cisco returns from his fact-finding mission across Earth-Prime.

episodes.title: Grodd Friended Me
episodes.overview: Feeling overwhelmed with all the changes since Crisis, Barry conducts an experiment that goes awry and puts him directly in Gorilla Grodd's path. Expecting the worst, Barry is surprised when Grodd asks for his help. Unfortunately for both The Flash and Grodd, things get worse when another villain appears – Solovar. Meanwhile, Iris works with Eva to escape the Mirrorverse.

episodes.title: A Girl Named Sue
episodes.overview: After months of searching for Sue Dearbon, Ralph gets a lead on her whereabouts and finally comes face to face with his missing client. However, Sue refuses to return home to her family, and instead, takes Ralph on a daring adventure. Iris faces a new challenge while Barry considers a potentially dangerous request from a trusted source.

episodes.title: Love Is a Battlefield
episodes.overview: Barry and Iris plan a romantic dinner for Valentine's Day but their evening is interrupted by an old foe – Amunet. Meanwhile, Frost gets into the holiday spirit and attempts to help Allegra reconnect with an old love.

episodes.title: Marathon
episodes.overview: After The Citizen prints an explosive story, Iris's life is threatened. Refusing to hide from those that are attacking her, Iris sets out to expose a dangerous organization. Meanwhile, Barry must face the consequences of the Crisis and fulfill Oliver Queen's wish for him.

episodes.title: Crisis on Infinite Earths: Part Three
episodes.overview: Flash, Killer Frost, and a newly repowered Vibe track down the Anti-Monitor's weapon of destruction and meet an electrifying new hero. Ray, Ralph, and Iris go to recruit the Paragon of Humanity, while Constantine helps Mia and Diggle recover Oliver's soul.

episodes.title: The Last Temptation of Barry Allen, Part 2
episodes.overview: While Bloodwork and Dark Flash infect Central City, Cisco tries to come up with a way to stop them. Joe is badly injured, and Iris has faith that the real Barry is still alive somewhere within the twisted monstrosity of the dark speedster.

episodes.title: The Last Temptation of Barry Allen, Part 1
episodes.overview: With Crisis only two days away, Barry faces a crisis from within when Ramsey infects him with his black blood. Meanwhile, Iris, Allegra, and Kamila investigate the secret organization Ralph and Barry saw at the gala.

episodes.title: License to Elongate
episodes.overview: Barry helps Raph investigate Sue Dearbon's disappearance hoping to get him back to Central City for a surprise. Nash recruits Allegra to help him, while Cecile gives Chester some advice.

episodes.title: Kiss Kiss Breach Breach
episodes.overview: While Barry and Iris take a vacation, Cisco is suspected of killing Gypsy and her father comes looking for revenge.

episodes.title: There Will Be Blood
episodes.overview: Nash comes to Barry and Cisco and ask them to build something for him in return for his getting them something they want. Meanwhile, Ralph stops investigating the Dearbon case, and Ramsey gains the key to curing his HLH.

episodes.title: Dead Man Running
episodes.overview: Barry recruits Ramsey to help him stop a mutated Mitch, but Frost doesn't trust the doctor. Ralph's mother Debbie is accused of murder, and another Harrison arrives on Earth-1.

episodes.title: A Flash of the Lightning
episodes.overview: Barry travels to Earth-3 to find a way to see the future where the Monitor claims he dies. Meanwhile, Cecile is torn between her powers and her career when she uses her empathic powers to discover that a young metahuman is innocent of murder.

episodes.title: Into the Void
episodes.overview: Team Flash face multiple Godspeeds, but focus on their personal issues: Barry and Iris are grieving over losing Nora, Caitlin is unable to summon Killer Frost, and Cisco deals with being Vibe no longer. However, they're forced to set aside their concerns when a black hole appears at seemingly random locations across Central City, threatening to destroy the metropolis.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.overview: Barry must choose between stopping Cicada or releasing Eobard. Nora and Cisco make choices of their own as they face the crisis upon them.

episodes.title: The Girl with the Red Lightning
episodes.overview: Cicada II assembles the part to build an atomizer that will release the meta-human killing virus, and Nora tries to use her psychic connection to the villain to find out what she's going to do next despite the risk.

episodes.title: Gone Rogue
episodes.overview: Back from the future, Nora gathers a group of Rogues to steal meta-tech. Meanwhile, Cicada II steals Cisco's metahuman cure, and Barry considers whether he's a good parent.

episodes.title: Snow Pack
episodes.overview: Iris and Ralph travel to the future to find Nora and confront Eobard, while Barry, Joe, and Sherloque deal with Icicle's newest scheme.

episodes.title: Godspeed
episodes.overview: To learn why Nora joined forces with Eobard, Team Flash reads her journal. They discover that in 2049, Eobard was the only person who was honest with Nora, and taught her how to use her powers.

episodes.title: Time Bomb
episodes.overview: Team Flash discovers the nature of the new Cicada when they find a time sphere that is a future duplicate of Eobard's. They also find out that Cicada II is going after the meta that she believes killed her parents, while Sherloque reaches the conclusion of his investigation.

episodes.title: Failure Is an Orphan
episodes.overview: Barry tries to find the words to convince Cicada to take the cure that Team Flash has developed. Joe and Cecile join forces to question Ambres, and Eobard warns Nora that a new timeline is coming.

episodes.title: King Shark vs. Gorilla Grodd
episodes.overview: The team need a meta to test the cure on, and settle on King Shark. Grodd escapes from ARGUS captivity and initiates his own plan to rule Central City... and then the world.

episodes.title: Cause and XS
episodes.overview: With Barry out of contact in the Speed Force, XS witnesses Cicada kill Killer Frost and tries to travel back in time to stop the outcome... and a different teammate dies with her every attempt.

episodes.title: Goldfaced
episodes.overview: To find a device that will let them administer the meta cure to Cicada, Barry and Ralph go undercover to get it from a black market arms dealer. Meanwhile, Iris decides to go looking for Cicada on her own, and Sherloque meets a woman after his own heart.

episodes.title: Memorabilia
episodes.overview: Sherloque uses a memory machine to try and revive Grace, and Nora ends up trapped in the girl's memories. Barry and Iris go in to save their daughter, and see her memories of a future Iris. Meanwhile, Ralph tricks Cisco into a night out.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.overview: Cicada renews his murder spree against metas and cripples XS, causing Flash to lose control. Meanwhile, Killer Frost worries that she'll be destroyed by the cure Caitlin is working on, and Sherloque continues trying to unravel the mystery behind Nora's journal.

episodes.title: The Flash & The Furious
episodes.overview: When a new meta-tech villain--Silver Ghost--helps Jocelyn Jackam escape, Nora wonders if Jocelyn wants to reform as she claims. Meanwhile, Barry is forced to stay in the pipeline after a confrontation with Silver Ghost, and Cisco discovers a possible meta-human cure.

episodes.title: Elseworlds, Part 1
episodes.overview: Oliver and Barry discover that they've swapped bodies. To find someone who can recognize them for who they are, they travel to Earth-38 to get Kara's help. Before they can solve the mystery of the mind-swap, the heroes have to take down a new menace: AMAZO, a robot with all of their powers.

episodes.title: What's Past Is Prologue
episodes.overview: To defeat Cicada, Nora comes up with a plan to assemble the necessary components from discarded villain items in the past and hide them in the present. Barry travels back in time to recover the three components, and reluctantly takes Nora with him.

episodes.title: O Come, All Ye Thankful
episodes.overview: A new weather-wielding villain appears in Central City, and demands that Team Flash hands Mark Mardon over to her. Nora reveals her unresolved feelings for losing Barry in the future, and the origin of Cicada is revealed.

episodes.title: The Icicle Cometh
episodes.overview: Caitlin is reunited with her long-lost father, but Cisco suspects that not everything is at it seems. Ralph teams up with Cecile to learn who was injured the night of the Enlightenment by the satellite crash, and Iris, Nora, and Sherloque try to track down the core piece of the satellite.

episodes.title: All Doll'd Up
episodes.overview: A new meta launches an attack on Central City, and Flash tries to deal with him while Nora avoids Iris. Meanwhile, Cisco, Caitlin, Sherloque, and Ralph try to track down Caitlin's father Thomas.

episodes.title: News Flash
episodes.overview: Nora reveals what Iris did to her in the future that causes her to be so hostile to her in the present. Ralph and Sherloque try to trace Cicada, and Team Flash faces someone with the ability to control minds.

episodes.title: The Death of Vibe
episodes.overview: While Caitlin and Ralph look into Thomas Snow's death, the others deal with Cicada and bring in a consulting detective to help them.

episodes.title: Blocked
episodes.overview: The team take on a new meta with the ability to create blocks out of concentrated air. Meanwhile, Danielle realizes that she's losing her powers, Barry tries to deal with an overeager Nora, Cisco deals with the loss of Gypsy, and Caitlin wonders whether to track down her father.

episodes.title: Nora
episodes.overview: After Nora meets her parents and reveals that she's stuck in 2018, Flash goes off after a new meta--Gridlock--and subsequently discovers what happens to himself in the future.

episodes.title: We Are the Flash
episodes.overview: With Marlize's help, Barry tries to make a last-ditch attempt to reach the good DeVoe inside of the Thinker... and meets an old friend.

episodes.title: Think Fast
episodes.overview: Thinker gathers the final component in his master plan, and to stop him Barry must train Cisco and Caitlin how to function in Flash Time. However, he refuses to endanger more of his friends. Meanwhile, Harry has an idea as to where they can find Marlize, and Cecile's pregnancy has strange side effects on her telepathy.

episodes.title: Harry and the Harrisons
episodes.overview: When they need an organic weapon to use against Thinker, Team Flash turns to Amunet... but Caitlin has an ulterior motive. Meanwhile, Cisco forms a "Council of Harrisons" after the Council of Wells kicks Harry out of the group.

episodes.title: Therefore She Is
episodes.overview: Thinker continues with his "Enlightenment", and Gypsy joins Team Flash to try and stop him... and to discuss her relationship with Cisco.

episodes.title: Fury Rogue
episodes.overview: While Harry discovers the results of the Thinking Cap overload on his mind, the rest of the team call on a former ally to help them transport Fallout away from Thinker.

episodes.title: Lose Yourself
episodes.overview: Team Flash tracks down the last bus meta, Edwin Guass, and discover that he holds the key to defeating Thinker. Meanwhile, Ralph considers taking extreme measures against Thinker,

episodes.title: Null and Annoyed
episodes.overview: The Mechanic discovers what Thinker has been doing to her, and Breacher comes asking Cisco for help. Meanwhile, Team Flash goes after Subject 11, who can control gravity, and Barry questions if Ralph takes anything seriously.

episodes.title: Run, Iris, Run
episodes.overview: Iris accidentally takes Barry's speed when a new meta with the power to swap powers touches both of them. Now they have to learn how the other half lives as Iris takes to the field and Barry monitors events. Meanwhile, Ralph refuses to leave S.T.A.R. Labs for fear that Clifford will kill him, and Harry undertakes a dangerous experiment to match their opponent's augmented intellect.

episodes.title: Enter Flashtime
episodes.overview: A terrorist detonates a nuclear bomb, and Flash must race between microseconds to try and stop it. Jesse and Jay lend their speed to his efforts, but even the three of them aren't fast enough to stop a nuclear explosion that has already happened.

episodes.title: Subject 9
episodes.overview: The team discovers the identity of the ninth bus meta, but she doesn't want their protection. Meanwhile, Cecile turns to Harry for help when Joe's dreams keep her awake at night.

episodes.title: True Colors
episodes.overview: When Wolfe offers Barry and the bus metas to Blacksmith, Barry engineers an escape for all of them. Meanwhile, Ralph has a crisis of faith when an old "friend" tells him that he eventually fails everyone who counts on him.

episodes.title: Honey, I Shrunk Team Flash
episodes.overview: The team goes after a meta with the power to shrink people and objects... and Cisco and Ralph ended up reduced to two inch height. Meanwhile, Barry tries to give Big Sir hope that they can clear his name.

episodes.title: The Elongated Knight Rises
episodes.overview: While Barry sits in prison, Ralph faces his first major supervillain and is injured for the first time. He has second thoughts about being a hero, and turns to Barry for advice.

episodes.title: The Trial of the Flash
episodes.overview: While Barry stands trial for Clifford's murder, a new meta threatens Central City and only Flash can stop him.

episodes.title: Don't Run
episodes.overview: Iris has to choose between her husband and her friend when Amunet abducts Caitlin while Thinker captures Flash. Meanwhile, Caitlin meets a new metahuman, and Thinker unveils the next stage of his plan.

episodes.title: Crisis on Earth-X, Part 3
episodes.overview: While Flash, Arrow, White Canary, Firestorm, and Alex attempt to return to Earth-1, Felicity and Iris team up to free Kara before Eobard and Fuehrer Queen remove her heart and transplant it into Overgirl.

episodes.title: Therefore I Am
episodes.overview: Barry risks his career and his team trying to confirm that Clifford DeVoe is their unseen adversary. Meanwhile, the origin of the Thinker is revealed.

episodes.title: When Harry Met Harry…
episodes.overview: Flash and Elongated Man team up to fight one of the Thinker's metas, a Sioux Indian woman calling herself Black Bison that is hunting down the three pieces of an artifact. Meanwhile, Harry calls together three of his counterparts to form the "Council of Wells" and figure out who DeVoe is.

episodes.title: Girls Night Out
episodes.overview: The guys and girls throw separate parties for Barry and Iris. While Barry gets drunk with some help from Cisco and Ralph takes them to a strip club, the ladies get involved with Killer Frost when her former boss, Amunet, demands that Killer Frost return to work for her.

episodes.title: Elongated Journey Into Night
episodes.overview: While looking for the bus passengers, Barry and Joe come across Ralph Dibny, a former cop who was fired from the force and gained a.... unique power from the dark matter. Meanwhile, Gypsy's father Breacher comes to see his daughter's new boyfriend Cisco, and soon starts hunting him.

episodes.title: Luck Be a Lady
episodes.overview: The team goes up against the second of the Thinker's metas: Becky Sharpe, aka Hazard, who can gain good luck for herself as long as everyone else suffers. Meanwhile, Cecile suggests to Joe that they buy a new house, and Iris tries to plan the wedding.

episodes.title: Mixed Signals
episodes.overview: Barry and Iris discover that they're having communication issues and go in for couples therapy... just as a new meta starts targeting tech billionaires. Meanwhile, Cisco inadvertently blows off a special day for Gypsy.

episodes.title: The Flash Reborn
episodes.overview: Cisco comes up with a way to bring Barry back from the Speed Force when a new villain challenges Flash to a fight. However, Barry is... different than when he went in.

episodes.title: Finish Line
episodes.overview: Savitar kills one of the team, and then comes up with a new plan to become a god… and Barry must come up with a way to stop him.

episodes.title: Infantino Street
episodes.overview: With 24 hours left to save Iris, Barry recruits Len Snart from the past to steal a Dominator power cell from ARGUS. Meanwhile, Joe and Kid Flash take Iris somewhere that Savitar can't find her, and Killer Frost calls Vibe out to kill him... and the last vestiges of her old self.

episodes.title: Cause and Effect
episodes.overview: Cisco comes up with a plan to stop Savitar involving preventing Barry from forming short-term memories. However, the plan doesn't go as intended. Meanwhile, Killer Frost returns to S.T.A.R. Labs to help the team.

episodes.title: I Know Who You Are
episodes.overview: The team finds Tracy Brand, the woman that Future-Barry said would be able to imprison Savitar four years in the future. However, Savitar intends to kill Tracy and is using Killer Frost to do so. Meanwhile, Cecile tells Joe that she loves him and he freezes up.

episodes.title: The Once and Future Flash
episodes.overview: Barry travels to 2024 to discover who Savitar is and use the information to save Iris. However, he soon discovers that Team Flash was destroyed when Iris was killed... and Barry is responsible. Meanwhile, Killer Frost finds someone who can give her what she wants.

episodes.title: Abra Kadabra
episodes.overview: A new villain, Abra Kadabra, seeking out high-tech items. When Flash captures him, Abra offers the speedster Savitar's name if Flash lets him go. Meanwhile, Julian is forced to operate on a badly injured Caitlin.

episodes.title: Duet
episodes.overview: When Mon-El and Hank bring Kara to Earth-1 to ask Team Flash for help, Music Meister puts Barry under his spell as well and traps him and Kara in a musical where they have to finish the story to escape... and if they die in the musical then they die in real life as well. This story line started at the end of Supergirl: "Star-Crossed", Season 2, Episode 16.

episodes.title: Into the Speed Force
episodes.overview: Barry enters the Speed Force to rescue Wally, and meets some familiar faces. Meanwhile, Jesse ignores H.R.'s advice and sets out to find and defeat Savitar on her own.

episodes.title: The Wrath of Savitar
episodes.overview: The team is forced to use Julian as a conduit to Savitar to question the God of Speed. Meanwhile, Wally is haunted by visions of Savitar that slowly become more real.

episodes.title: Attack on Central City
episodes.overview: Barry considers killing Grodd to stop him, but Harry convinces him that there's always another way. Meanwhile, Jesse tells her father that she's staying on Earth-1 and is surprised at his reaction.

episodes.title: Attack on Gorilla City
episodes.overview: Barry, Cisco, Caitlin, and Julian travel to Gorilla City on Earth 2 to rescue Harrison. However, they are soon captured and Barry is forced to fight a battle to the death against the gorillas' ruler, Solovar.

episodes.title: Untouchable
episodes.overview: A new metahuman, Clive Yorkin, goes after the alternates of the people that wronged him in Flashpoint by turning them into ash. Meanwhile, Iris and Barry finally tell Joe about what Barry saw in the future.

episodes.title: Dead or Alive
episodes.overview: A "collector" from Earth-19 arrives to take H.R. to pay with his life for traveling between dimensions. While Cisco challenges her to a trial by combat, Iris sets out to make her mark on the world before the future that Barry saw comes to pass.

episodes.title: Borrowing Problems from the Future
episodes.overview: Barry finally tells Iris and the others--except Joe--what he saw in the future and together they set out to stop that future from coming to pass. Meanwhile, Caitlin invites Julian to join Team Flash, and H.R. prepares to open the museum.

episodes.title: The Present
episodes.overview: As Christmas arrives, the team discovers Alchemy's identity. Jay travels from Earth 3 to lend the team a hand against Savitar, while Joe forbids Wally from helping.

episodes.title: Invasion!
episodes.overview: The alien Dominators land on Earth, and Barry realizes that he can't fight them alone. He summons Green Arrow and his teammates, and then the Legends, and then Supergirl from her Earth. However, the discovery of future-Barry's message forces Barry to reveal that he may have altered all of their lives when he changed the timeline, sowing the seeds of mistrust.

episodes.title: Killer Frost
episodes.overview: Flash discovers that he's powerless against Savitar's superior speed, but other matters take precedence when Caitlin turns into Killer Frost and goes on a rampage trying to find Alchemy.

episodes.title: Shade
episodes.overview: While Barry tries to deal with a new metahuman, Shade, Alchemy tries to convince Wally to join him and gain the powers that he had in Flashpoint.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.overview: A monster appears in downtown Central City and Julian vows to find the person responsible. While Flash tries to deal with the creature, Cisco tries to deal with his new teammate H.R. and realizes that he's hiding something.

episodes.title: The New Rogues
episodes.overview: Taking the name of Jesse Quick and donning a mask, Jesse offers to help Barry against two metas, Mirror Master and Top. However, her inexperience puts her in danger and gets Flash trapped in a mirror. Meanwhile, Harry, Cisco, and Caitlin search the other Earths for a replacement for a Harry.

episodes.title: Magenta
episodes.overview: A new metahuman, Magenta, unleashes a magnetic wave of terror on the city. Meanwhile, Harry and Jesse come over from Earth-2 and reveal that Jesse now has superspeed... and Wally wonders if he gained the same power.

episodes.title: Paradox
episodes.overview: Barry discovers that he didn't restore the timeline as it originally was, and tries to reconcile the difference. Meanwhile, the Edward Clariss of the new timeline teams up with a new villain to bring Flash down.

episodes.title: Flashpoint
episodes.overview: After preventing his mother's death and altering history, Barry has a perfect life in the resulting timeline. But memory losses suggest that the danger isn't yet over.

episodes.title: The Race of His Life
episodes.overview: The team discovers what Zoom is up to, and why he wants Barry to race him. When they realize that Barry is out of control after the death of someone close to him, they lock Barry up for his own safety rather than let him participate in a race he can't win.

episodes.title: Invincible
episodes.overview: The Earth Two metahumans attack Central City en masse, and Barry is oddly confident that the team can handle them. Meanwhile, Cisco has vibes of an ominous future, and meets the Earth Two counterpart of a woman he loved.

episodes.title: The Runaway Dinosaur
episodes.overview: While Barry is trapped in the Speed Force, his friends desperately try to bring him home... only to discover that he may not want to leave. Meanwhile, the particle experiment reanimates one of the team's old foes, who is obsessed with finding Iris.

episodes.title: Rupture
episodes.overview: Zoom begins his reign of terror, unleashing the Earth Two version of Cisco's brother Dante on the populace. Meanwhile, Barry debates whether to undergo the dangerous process Harry has created to give him back his speed.

episodes.title: Back to Normal
episodes.overview: Barry tries to cope with a life without superspeed, but finds himself forced to don the Flash suit when a metahuman abducts Harry believing that he's Harrison Wells. Meanwhile, Wally asks Joe to arrange a meeting for him with Flash, and Caitlin tries to escape her captivity.

episodes.title: Versus Zoom
episodes.overview: With Harry's help, Barry becomes fast enough to stop Zoom. Using Vibe's powers, the team contacts Zoom on the other Earth and use his past to trap him. But Zoom manages to escape their trap and takes one of them hostage to force Barry to give up his speed.

episodes.title: Flash Back
episodes.overview: When Barry reaches a dead end in going faster, he decides to travel into the past and trick Eobard Thawne--posing as Harrison Wells--into showing him how to go faster. However, something, in the timestream follows Barry back... and it's not friendly.

episodes.title: Trajectory
episodes.overview: A new speedster arrives in Central City and spreads chaos wherever she goes. Flash takes the blame, and Iris' editor plans to write an expose on the hero. Meanwhile, Jesse discovers how far her father will go to protect her.

episodes.title: King Shark
episodes.overview: King Shark escapes from ARGUS captivity and makes his way to Central City to kill the Flash. However, the hero and his friends are preoccupied with the recent death of one of their own. Meanwhile, Wally resents Barry's presence in his family.

episodes.title: Escape from Earth-2
episodes.overview: While Cisco and Harry go looking for a captive Barry, Barry makes contact with the masked prisoner and learns that he is connected with Jay. Meanwhile, On Earth-1, Caitlin perfects Velocity-9 so that Jay can go up against Geomancer before he brings Central City down.

episodes.title: Welcome to Earth-2
episodes.overview: Barry and Cisco travel to Earth-2 with Harry to rescue his daughter, and discover a strange world where friends are enemies and enemies are even worse. Meanwhile, Caitlin help Jay regain his speed so that he can deal with a new metahuman menace, Geomancer.

episodes.title: Fast Lane
episodes.overview: While Flash takes on a new meta, dubbed Tar Pit, Barry offers to help Harry come up with a way to seal the breaches. He's unaware that Harry has secretly siphoned off some of Barry's speed... and plans to remove the rest.

episodes.title: The Reverse-Flash Returns
episodes.overview: Eobard Thawne--Reverse-Flash--kidnaps Dr. McGee and forces her to find a way to send him back to his own time. Flash and his friends discover that Reverse-Flash is from a timeline before he killed Barry's mother, and realize that they may have no choice but to send him back. Meanwhile, Harry and Cisco work to stabilize Cisco's vibe power, and Caitlin desperately tries to find a cure for Jay's illness.

episodes.title: Potential Energy
episodes.overview: The Flash and his friends go up against a new meta-human, the Turtle. Meanwhile, Caitlin discovers the source of Jay's problems, and Patty questions whether she and Barry can have a relationship.

episodes.title: Running to Stand Still
episodes.overview: Weather Wizard frees Captain Cold and Trickster from prison to help him get revenge on the Flash, but Cold has second thoughts. Meanwhile, iris tells Joe about the son he never knew he had, and Patty confronts the man who killed her father.

episodes.title: Legends of Today
episodes.overview: Barry and Cisco take Kendra to Oliver and his team, looking for protection when a mysterious immortal comes seeking Kendra. However, a figure from her past arrives to tell her the truth. Meanwhile, Jay refuses to help Harrison test his new speed-enhancement serum, Velocity-6.

episodes.title: Gorilla Warfare
episodes.overview: While Harrison tells the team that he's heading back to Earth 2 now that they've failed to stop Zoom, Grodd launches a new series of attacks in an attempt to gain the chemicals that he needs to augment his intelligence. Meanwhile, Barry deals with his loss of self-confidence after Zoom cripples him, and Iris calls in a familiar face to help.

episodes.title: Enter Zoom
episodes.overview: After Dr. Light escapes from her pipeline cell, Barry asks Linda to help them lure Zoom to their world. Meanwhile, the team questions Harrison's motives and Cisco tries to use his powers on the Earth-2 visitor.

episodes.title: The Darkness and the Light
episodes.overview: Barry battles another breacher, Doctor Light... and discovers that she's Linda's evil counterpart. Meanwhile, the team deals with a new Harrison Wells in their midst, and Barry asks Patty out on a date.

episodes.title: The Fury of Firestorm
episodes.overview: Martin begins to destabilize without Ronnie to merge with him, and the team desperately seek out another metahuman with similar abilities. They find two men: Henry Hewitt and Jefferson "Jax" Jackson. Meanwhile, Iris does some digging into Francine's past, and Barry is hesitant to become involved with Patty after what happened between him and Iris.

episodes.title: Family of Rogues
episodes.overview: Lisa Snart, aka Golden Glider, comes to the team for help when her brother Captain Cold is kidnapped. However, the Flash soon discovers that the villain is working for his father Lewis, who has some mysterious hold over him. Meanwhile, Caitlin and Jay work together to build a speed cannon so that Jay can return to Earth-2, and Joe tells Iris the truth about her mother.

episodes.title: Flash of Two Worlds
episodes.overview: The team's visitor, Jay Garrick, explains that he comes from a parallel world and was a speedster there, but lost his powers transitioning over. Now he insists that Barry needs his help fighting a new metahuman, Sand Demon, who came from Jay's world. Meanwhile, Officer Patty Spivot tries to join Joe's Metahuman Taskforce.

episodes.title: The Man Who Saved Central City
episodes.overview: Six months after the Flash and his friends stop the Singularity, Central City holds a rally in the speedster's honor. However, Barry doesn't want to go given the sacrifice that was made by the true hero. Meanwhile, a new metahuman, Atom Smasher, sets out to kill the Flash.

episodes.title: Fast Enough
episodes.overview: Harrison presents Barry with an impossible choice: save Nora and create an alternate timeline, while letting Harrison escape. or let his mother die as she did in the original timeline.

episodes.title: Rogue Air
episodes.overview: As Wells once again gets the upper hand on the S.T.A.R. Labs team, Barry realizes he needs to make a big move and reaches out to an old foe, Captain Cold, for help. Joe and Caitlin warn Barry that Cold can't be trusted. True to form, Cold has his own agenda that involves the meta-humans trapped in the containment cells. As things seem to be going from bad to worse, The Flash gets reinforcements - Arrow and Firestorm.

episodes.title: Grodd Lives
episodes.overview: Barry must deal with the Reverse Flash's latest threat to a member of the group. To make matter worse, Dr. Wells unleashes Grodd on the city in order to distract Barry and the team. Joe, Barry and Cisco head down into the sewers to catch Grodd but the gorilla quickly gets the upper hand after he kidnaps Joe. Iris and Barry have a heart to heart talk.

episodes.title: The Trap
episodes.overview: Barry, Caitlin, Cisco and Joe set a trap for Wells. Cisco uses himself as prey which puts him in grave danger. Meanwhile, Eddie makes a decision regarding Iris, which leaves Joe a bit unsettled.

episodes.title: Who Is Harrison Wells?
episodes.overview: Joe and Cisco head to Starling City to continue their investigation of Dr. Wells. While in town, the duo enlists the help of Captain Lance, and Cisco meets the Black Canary, who asks him for a favor. Meanwhile, back in Central City, Barry races to catch a meta-human named Hannibal Bates who can transform himself into every person he touches - which includes Eddie, Iris, Caitlin and even The Flash.

episodes.title: All Star Team Up
episodes.overview: Barry is surprised when Felicity Smoak arrives from Starling City along with her boyfriend, Ray Palmer, who flies in as the Atom. They've come to visit S.T.A.R. Labs as Ray needs help with his suit. Their timing turns out to be fortuitous because it's all hands on deck after a meta human named Brie Larvan unleashes hundreds of robotic bees to attack and kill her former co-workers, including Dr. Tina McGee. A group dinner with Barry, Felicity, Ray, Iris and Eddie turns into a disaster.

episodes.title: Tricksters
episodes.overview: Copycat killer who goes by the name "The Trickster" starts setting off bombs in Central City. In order to stop the villain, Barry and Joe meet with the original Trickster, a criminal mastermind named James Jesse, who has been imprisoned for 20 years. Things quickly go from bad to worse when the Tricksters unite and take Henry prisoner. Meanwhile, Iris asks Eddie for help with a case, and flashbacks show how Harrison Wells came up with the idea for the particle accelerator.

episodes.title: Rogue Time
episodes.overview: The Flash learns that Captain Cold and Heat Wave have returned to Central City. This time Snart has brought along his baby sister Lisa to help wreak havoc on the city.

episodes.title: Out of Time
episodes.overview: Mark Mardon aka The Weather Wizard appears in Central City intent on avenging his brother Clyde's death, and sets his sights on Joe, who shot Clyde.
