When Mardon attacks Joe and Barry, Barry is able to super-speed them to safety but Mardon gets away. Barry warns Joe not to go after a meta-human alone but Joe doesn't listen and ends up in grave danger. Meanwhile, Cisco looks into the night the team captured the Reverse Flash and realizes something doesn't add up and begins to wonder whether Joe was right about Dr. Wells. Barry and Linda end up on an awkward double date with Eddie and Iris.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.overview: After the nuclear explosion separates Ronnie and Dr. Stein, Barry and the team believe both men are safe. Caitlin is thrilled to have her fiancé back and prepares to resume their life together while Dr. Stein returns to his wife. However, when General Eiling targets Firestorm, Ronnie and Dr. Stein must decide if they are safer together or apart. Meanwhile, Mason Bridge tells Iris that there is something secretive going on at S.T.A.R. Labs and Dr. Stein gives Barry some important information about time travel.

episodes.title: The Nuclear Man
episodes.overview: After Ronnie attacks a physicist, Barry and the team realize they need to go after Caitlin's fiancé who is now a dangerous meta-human. They deduce the best way to track Ronnie is to find Dr. Martin Stein who was working on a project called F.I.R.E.S.T.O.R.M. Barry struggles to balance his duties as The Flash and his relationship with Linda Park, and Joe enlists Cisco's help to reinvestigate the murder of Nora Allen. General Eiling returns to Central City.

episodes.title: Crazy for You
episodes.overview: Caitlin decides that she and Barry need to move on from Ronnie and Iris and find new loves so she takes him for a night out at the local karaoke bar. Caitlin doesn't have any luck making a love connection but Barry meets Linda Park, a sports reporter for the Central City Picture News, and asks her out on a date. When Barry tells Iris he has a date, Iris is surprised by her reaction. Meanwhile, Cisco considers Hartley's dangerous offer and the team searches for Shawna, a meta-human with teleportation powers, who just busted her boyfriend Clay out of Iron Heights. When Henry snoops around in an attempt to help Joe and Barry solve the crime, he ends up in the infirmary after getting roughed up by inmates.

episodes.title: The Sound and the Fury
episodes.overview: Dr. Wells' former protégée, Hartley Rathaway, returns to seek revenge on his mentor after being affected by the particle accelerator explosion. Now able to manipulate sound waves, the brilliant Rathaway is a dangerous threat to both Wells and The Flash. Meanwhile, Iris is thrilled when she's hired by the Central City Picture News as their newest cub reporter. Unfortunately, her editor pairs her with a veteran reporter, Mason Bridge, who wants nothing to do with her. Cisco recalls his first day on the job at S.T.A.R. Labs when he met Hartley and Caitlin. Joe asks Eddie for a favor but asks him to keep it a secret from Barry.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Rogues
episodes.overview: Leonard Snart AKA Captain Cold returns to Central City with a new hotheaded partner in tow - Mick Rory AKA Heat Wave. The duo plan to steal a multi-million dollar painting, but Cold has another agenda while in town - to set a trap for The Flash. Snart and Mick kidnap someone close to The Flash and threaten to kill them unless The Flash shows up for a battle of fire and ice. Barry tells Joe he isn't sure he should take on Snart again after the casualties that happened the last time they fought. Meanwhile, Barry asks Dr. Wells, Caitlin and Cisco to help him double his training efforts so he's ready for the Reverse Flash when he returns to Central City. Iris deals with the aftermath of Barry's confession, and Cisco makes the CCPD a new shield.

episodes.title: The Man in the Yellow Suit
episodes.overview: Barry finds himself face-to-face with his nemesis, the man in the yellow suit, a.k.a. Reverse Flash, who killed his mother. Barry is frustrated when the Reverse Flash escapes, but Dr. Wells and Cisco come up with a plan to trap him. All they need is bait, so they turn to Dr. Tina McGee from Mercury Labs to help. Meanwhile, it's Christmas at The West household and Iris is in full holiday cheer. Eddie gives her a surprising gift but also leaves her with a question that could change her life. Joe joins the search for the man in yellow and ends up in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Flash vs. Arrow
episodes.overview: Barry is thrilled when Oliver, Felicity and Diggle come to Central City to investigate a case involving a deadly boomerang. Excited about teaming up with his friend, Barry asks Oliver if he'd like to help him stop Ray Bivolo, the meta-human Barry is currently tracking. Bivolo causes people to lose control of their emotions and has been using that skill to rob banks. Unfortunately, the superhero partnership doesn't go as smoothly as Barry expected. When Oliver tells Barry he still has a lot to learn, Barry sets out to prove him wrong by attempting to stop Bivolo alone. However, when Bivolo infects Barry and sets him on a rage rampage, everyone is in danger, and the only one who can stop him is the Arrow. Meanwhile, Iris is furious when Eddie tries to get a task force to stop The Flash, Joe and Dr. Wells agree the Arrow is a bad influence on Barry, and Caitlin and Cisco deal with a new team in S.T.A.R. Labs.

episodes.title: Power Outage
episodes.overview: The Flash goes up against Farooq aka Blackout, a metahuman who can harness electricity. During their battle, Farooq zaps The Flash and siphons all his electricity, leaving The Flash without his speed. Dr. Wells, Caitlin and Cisco work to reverse the effects on Barry, but their efforts are disrupted when Farooq comes banging on S.T.A.R. Labs doors in search of Wells, who he blames for his accident. Without Barry's powers to protect them, the group must figure out a way to save themselves from the metahuman. Meanwhile, Tockman manages a coup inside the Central City police department and takes several people hostage, including Joe and Iris. While Iris is sure The Flash will save them, Eddie has a trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: The Flash Is Born
episodes.overview: The Flash faces a new meta-human named Tony, who can turn himself into girded steel at will. While Dr. Wells and Caitlin are concerned about Barry's safety, Cisco comes up with a plan to take Tony down. Meanwhile, Iris's blog on The Flash gets her into trouble, and Eddie witnesses Tony's abilities firsthand and begins to ask questions that Joe doesn't want answered. Joe asks Dr. Wells to help him solve Nora Allen's murder.

episodes.title: Plastique
episodes.overview: After a bomb goes off downtown, the army, led by General Eiling, rolls in and takes over the case, much to Joe's surprise. Suspicious, Joe tells Barry that he and his friends at S.T.A.R. Labs should look into the army's involvement. Wells informs the team that Eiling was experimenting on his men to turn them into super soldiers. Cisco confirms one of Eiling's soldiers, Bette Sans Souci, was at the bomb site. The Flash tracks her down and realizes that she's not setting off the bombs, she is a meta-human who can blow things up just by touching them. Meanwhile, when Joe learns Iris is writing about "the streak," he tells Barry to make her stop. Barry realizes Iris won't listen to him so he decides to have The Flash pay her a visit.

episodes.title: Going Rogue
episodes.overview: The Flash stops a robbery but the culprits get away after shooting a guard, and The Flash chooses to save the man instead of following the criminals. Joe shows Barry a book of suspects and Barry identifies Leonard Snart as the leader of the group. While investigating the case, Barry gets a surprise visit from an old friend - Felicity Smoak, who heard about his new abilities and came to check them out for herself. She joins him at S.T.A.R. Labs to help stop Snart after it's revealed that Snart his gotten his hands on a stolen "cold gun," which could kill The Flash. Dr. Wells is furious when he finds out that Cisco built the cold gun without telling anyone and now it's missing. Meanwhile, Iris is getting the silent treatment from Joe because of her relationship with Eddie. Finally, The Flash and Captain Cold have an epic confrontation.

episodes.title: Things You Can't Outrun
episodes.overview: As Barry and the team at S.T.A.R. Labs work to capture Kyle Nimbus, a.k.a. The Mist, a dangerous new meta-human with toxic gas powers, they revisit the painful night the particle accelerator exploded and killed Caitlin's fiancé, Ronnie. Meanwhile, Joe decides to finally visit Henry in jail after all these years, but things take a dangerous turn when Kyle shows up looking to punish Joe for arresting him years ago. Meanwhile, Iris and Eddie continue to hide their relationship from Joe.

episodes.title: Fastest Man Alive
episodes.overview: Barry escorts Iris to a university gathering honoring scientist Simon Stagg. When six gunmen storm the event, Barry changes into The Flash and tries to stop them. While he does save a man's life, he passes out before he can capture the robbers, which frustrates him. As Dr. Wells, Caitlin and Cisco scramble to find out what's wrong with Barry, Joe comes down hard on Barry for taking the law into his own hands and risking his life. Barry realizes that it wasn't six gunmen but a metahuman named Danton Black, who can make multiples of himself. Meanwhile, Iris becomes even more intrigued by the "red streak."

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: Barry discovers his powers and puts them to the test, only when he finds its no longer a test but the real thing when he encounters a certain someone.

title: FROM
overview: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

episodes.title: If a Tree Falls in the Forest...
episodes.overview: Boyd's quest to lead the residents home reaches a terrifying crossroads, and nothing will ever be the same again.

episodes.title: The Calm Before
episodes.overview: The residents of town stand at a crossroads unlike any they've faced before as Boyd sets a daring, and dangerous, plan in motion.

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Head
episodes.overview: A dangerous plan begins to take shape. How much is Boyd willing to risk for the chance to get everyone home? Fatima and Henry find themselves at two very different and disturbing crossroads. Victor helps Tabitha and Ethan prepare for the worst.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.overview: As Tabitha and Jade's troubling history is brought to light, things begin to unravel for another resident in town. Boyd wants to test a dangerous theory.

episodes.title: The Heart Is a Lonely Hunter
episodes.overview: Boyd and Jade find themselves at odds over whether they can trust the knowledge in Jade's head. Deeply troubling news from the settlement makes its way back to town.

episodes.title: What a Long Strange Trip It's Been
episodes.overview: Boyd and Jade set off on a desperate, mind-bending search for answers, while a food run to the settlement takes a chilling turn.

episodes.title: Of Myths and Monsters
episodes.overview: An ominous discovery puts Boyd and his trusted circle on high alert. Julie searches for a way to harness her newfound abilities and Sara is once again tortured by the voices in her head.

episodes.title: Merrily We Go
episodes.overview: Boyd tries to save Acosta from herself as Julie digs deeper into her newfound abilities. Tabitha embarks on a desperate gamble and Victor joins Ethan in a quest for answers.

episodes.title: Fray
episodes.overview: A gruesome discovery sends shockwaves through the town as Jade and Tabitha struggle with the weight of their revelation.

episodes.title: The Arrival
episodes.overview: A new arrival throws the town into chaos. Jade and Tabitha struggle with their revelation at the Bottle Tree. Boyd grapples with the implications of Smiley's return.

episodes.title: Revelations, Chapter Two
episodes.overview: Boyd is pushed to his limit as time begins to run out for someone he loves. Randall is haunted by his trauma and Victor reveals a hard truth. Tabitha's unlikely journey takes a shocking turn.

episodes.title: Revelations, Chapter One
episodes.overview: Tensions are at an all-time high as the town residents learn that one of their own has gone missing.

episodes.title: Thresholds
episodes.overview: Accusations start flying and truths come to light in the aftermath of a tragedy. Victor struggles to recover long-buried memories about the town's past. Julie and Ethan search for answers about the mysterious ruins in the woods.

episodes.title: These Fragile Lives
episodes.overview: The edges begin to fray as concerns about Fatima's pregnancy deepen. Jade follows a clue trail into the forest. Julie and Randall seek a bit of normalcy.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.overview: Fatima and Ellis make a decision about her pregnancy. Boyd fears for the future of his family. Tensions rise in the Matthews house. Randall opens up to Marielle about his fears.

episodes.title: The Light of Day
episodes.overview: Victor must face a painful reminder of his past; Julie looks for ways to cope with her trauma. Boyd struggles to keep the town safe as the residents begin to question his judgement. Tabitha tries to adjust to her new surroundings.

episodes.title: There and Back Again
episodes.overview: Boyd is forced to make a tough decision when newcomers arrive in town at nightfall. Victor unearths memories from the past in the hopes of finding answers.

episodes.title: Mouse Trap
episodes.overview: Kenny leads a group into the forest in search of food. Donna and Ellis try to talk Boyd out of a dangerous plan. Tabitha makes a mind-bending discovery. Fatima questions the welfare of her unborn baby.

episodes.title: When We Go
episodes.overview: Boyd struggles to find a path forward as the town says farewell to one of their own. Fatima's health takes a turn for the worse. Tabitha finds help from an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: Shatter
episodes.overview: Boyd feels the town slipping away from him as the weather grows colder and the residents more desperate.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time...
episodes.overview: Boyd fears he may have finally run out of answers, as the residents of town prepare for the end. Tabitha clings to the belief that the children could be the key to their salvation.

episodes.title: Ball of Magic Fire
episodes.overview: Panic spreads through town as the residents face a chilling new threat to their survival. Jim realizes the magnitude of the mistake he made by enlisting Randall in his cause.

episodes.title: Forest for the Trees
episodes.overview: In their pursuit of the truth about the town, Jim and Randall hatch a dangerous plan. Meanwhile, a new form of terror is brewing.

episodes.title: Belly of the Beast
episodes.overview: Boyd and Kristi seek to capitalize on the apparent death of the Nightmare Creature. Jim finds an unlikely ally in the volatile Randall.

episodes.title: Pas de Deux
episodes.overview: Tensions run high at Colony House when word of the coming food shortage leaks out. A night at the clinic takes a terrifying turn.

episodes.title: Lullaby
episodes.overview: Sara must face the music, as word of her return spreads through town. Victor and Jade strike an unlikely bargain.

episodes.title: This Way Gone
episodes.overview: As Boyd's condition grows more alarming, Sara's return to town puts him in a difficult position. Jim shares a troubling new theory about the town.

episodes.title: Tether
episodes.overview: Kenny and Ellis make a grisly discovery out in the forest. Boyd struggles with the reality of what's happening to him.

episodes.title: The Kindness of Strangers
episodes.overview: A tense night in the diner as the residents and newcomers wait for sunrise. Fear permeates the wreckage beneath the Matthews house, as Jim and Tom struggle to keep a panicked bus passenger quiet.

episodes.title: Strangers in a Strange Land
episodes.overview: In Sheriff Boyd's absence, Donna and Kenny struggle to manage the chaos as a busload of unwitting newcomers arrives in town. Victor and Tabitha go on a chilling journey through the nightmarish labyrinth of tunnels beneath the town.

episodes.title: Oh, the Places We'll Go
episodes.overview: Boyd draws strength from an unlikely source. Jim's radio tower yields consequences which rock him to his very core. The hole that Tabitha has been digging leads her somewhere – and to someone - she could never have expected. Everything is about to change.

episodes.title: Into the Woods
episodes.overview: Boyd and Sara journey deeper into the forest than Boyd has ever gone, encountering new and terrifying mysteries. Jim's confidence in the radio tower begins to wane. An unexpected tragedy causes Donna to unravel. Kenny and Kristi share a moment.

episodes.title: Broken Windows, Open Doors
episodes.overview: In the wake of another death, Boyd questions his decision to leave. Kenny steps up and embraces his new role. Jim rallies the town around his idea to build a radio tower. Fatima urges Ellis to make amends with his father before it is too late.

episodes.title: All Good Things...
episodes.overview: Father Khatri tells Boyd why he believes Sara may be useful. Jim and Tabitha find comfort in each other. Colony House celebrates the one-year anniversary of Fatima's arrival with a party that goes terribly wrong.

episodes.title: Book 74
episodes.overview: Boyd's plan to head off into the forest provokes an unexpected response from Kenny. Jade enlists Jim's help with an experiment while Tabitha makes a chilling discovery that sends her down a unique path searching for answers.

episodes.title: Silhouettes
episodes.overview: Jim, Tabitha, and Ethan begin asking questions about where they are in the hopes it may lead them home. Ellis and Fatima show Julie the lighter side of life in town. Jade struggles to make sense of their situation as Boyd seeks guidance.

episodes.title: A Rock and a Farway
episodes.overview: Julie finds comfort in her new friends as Jim and Tabitha deal with their struggling marriage. Ethan ventures off into the forest with Victor while Father Khatri urges Boyd to embrace his role as leader. Sara receives another horrifying directive.

episodes.title: Choosing Day
episodes.overview: The Matthews family must choose which of the two settlements they will join. Meanwhile, Jade comes to terms with his situation and Boyd is faced with an impossible decision that strikes at the very heart of life in the town.

episodes.title: The Way Things Are Now
episodes.overview: At Colony House, Tabitha and Julie grapple with their new nightmarish reality. Out in the forest, Jim, Boyd and Kristi struggle to treat Ethan's injuries. Tragedy strikes from an unexpected source as a new threat arises among the residents of the town.

episodes.title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
episodes.overview: The Matthews' family road trip takes a horrifying turn when they are detoured to a small pastoral town from which they cannot leave. When their family RV crashes, Sheriff Boyd Stevens and other residents rush to save them before the sun goes down.

title: Full Metal Panic!
overview: Kaname Chidori’s one of the most popular girls at her high school – unfortunately, it’s her growing popularity off campus she should be worrying about. Unbeknownst to Kaname, terrorists are plotting her abduction, believing she possesses the rare and coveted abilities of “the Whispered.”  That’s where Sousuke Sagara enters the picture. He’s a hotshot soldier from the clandestine counter-terrorist organization known as Mithril – and he’s going undercover at Kaname’s school to try and keep her safe. He may be an ace in the cockpit of an Arm Slave mech, but there’s no training in the world that could prepare him for the warzone of high school.

episodes.title: A Fancy Without Honor or Humanity
A Goddess Comes to Japan (2): The Hot Spring
A Goddess Comes to Japan (1): The Suffering
The Pure Yet Impure Grappler / Trespassing on Good Faith
The Hard Sell Fetish / The Patient of Darkness
The Hamburger Hill of Art / Single Minded Stakeout!
The Man From The South / Hostage Who Requires no Negotiation
The Guy I Kinda Like is a Sergeant

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
overview: Disregard for alchemy’s laws ripped half of Edward Elric’s limbs from his body and left his brother Alphonse’s soul clinging to a suit of armor. To restore what was lost, the brothers seek the Philosopher’s Stone. Enemies and allies – the corrupt military, the Homunculi, and foreign alchemists – will alter the Elric brothers course, but their purpose will remain unchanged and their bond unbreakable.

episodes.title: Journey's End
episodes.overview: Ed and Al start a new adventure in searching for new and innovative ways of alchemy.

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Gateway
episodes.overview: Ed fights the original homunculus known as 'The father' trying to defeat him in order to get his and Al's body back.

episodes.title: A Fierce Counterattack
episodes.overview: A truly epic battle erupts when Edward, Mustang, Hawkeye, Greed, Izumi, and Armstrong attack the god-like Father. The odds are against the forces of good - until one brave boy makes a shocking sacrifice.

episodes.title: He Who Would Swallow God
episodes.overview: Millions of lifeless bodies litter the landscape of Amestris, and a being with the power to create suns is unleashed upon the world. Unless Hohenheim has something amazing up his sleeve, all is surely lost.

episodes.title: Eye of Heaven, Gateway of Earth
episodes.overview: The light is gone. Shadows swallow everything. As the planet quakes and the heavens tremble, the souls of heroes and villains alike vanish into darkness. The circle is complete.

episodes.title: Lost Light
episodes.overview: As the light of the sun vanishes, Mustang learns the loss which comes from seeing the other side of the Gateway - and five sacrifices gather in the dark presence of the Father.

episodes.title: Sacrifices
episodes.overview: Mustang must make a difficult choice: will he break alchemy's greatest taboo? Or will he watch the person dearest to him die? Meanwhile, it grows ever more difficult to discern where Ling ends and Greed begins.

episodes.title: Eternal Leave
episodes.overview: The battle for a nation's soul descends into chaos. Bradley unleashes death on those who dare engage him. Beneath Central, the one responsible for the Führer's creation unleashes something far, far worse.

episodes.title: The Return of the Führer
episodes.overview: Central's forces fight with renewed vigor following Bradley's return, and the Führer himself enters the battle. His first opponent is an armored tank. His second foe is even tougher.

episodes.title: The Adults' Way of Life
episodes.overview: A rebel victory is imminent and hope takes hold among Mustang and Armstrong's troops. Central's forces teeter on the brink of collapse - until their fallen leader returns to take control.

episodes.title: Beyond the Inferno
episodes.overview: As Envy writhes within the firestorm unleashed by Mustang's vengeful rage, Hawkeye must take drastic measures to prevent the Flame Alchemist's hatred from going out of control.

episodes.title: Flame of Vengeance
episodes.overview: After a startling radio broadcast grants Mustang's forces the advantage over Central's troops, the Flame Alchemist unleashes the brutal power of burning hatred in the battle against the killer of Maes Hughes.

episodes.title: Combined Strength
episodes.overview: With the philosopher stone in his possession, Alphonse fearlessly takes on pride and Kimble. Elsewhere, the Armstrongs find themselves trapped between Sloth's onslaught and the guns of Central's troops.

episodes.title: The Immortal Legion
episodes.overview: Ed's crew faces a horde of ravenous mannequins, abominations powered by human souls. The twisted creatures aren't the only unstoppable force on the battlefield - Pride, Sloth, and Envy are on the move.

episodes.title: Upheaval in Central
episodes.overview: Mustang leads a ragtag assault force of hardy northern troops - and welcome faces from the past - against Central's defenses. Victory seems certain until the military's most horrifying secret is revealed.

episodes.title: Filial Affection
episodes.overview: With his father's help, Al takes incredible steps to contain the monstrous Pride. As the sun begins to rise on the Promised Day, the youngest Elric listens while the Homunculus ponders his very human mother.

episodes.title: The Oath in the Tunnel
episodes.overview: After investigating the twisted roots of the Bradley family tree, Mustang gathers his most loyal troops. Meanwhile, Ed and his allies continue fighting Selim, who shocks everyone by turning on his own kind.

episodes.title: Emissary of Darkness
episodes.overview: A sinister voice rings out from the shell of Al's armor, and Ed and Greed find themselves under attack. As the Homunculi use the darkness to their advantage, a face from the past arrives to join the battle.

episodes.title: Looming Shadows
episodes.overview: Those who have prepared to reclaim a nation find their plans exposed. The chaos multiplies after an assassin strikes down a mighty leader in broad daylight, and Alphonse falls prey to monsters in the dark.

episodes.title: The Promised Day
episodes.overview: The Promised Day is approaching. While most will face the coming chaos with their own kind, Edward forms a new group comprised of human, chimera and Homunculus

episodes.title: Revving at Full Throttle
episodes.overview: Hohenheim and Alphonse enjoy a chance to get reacquainted. Their bond is restored with ease, inspiring the father to share his secrets with his sons - but one of them is far away and on the run.

episodes.title: Bite of the Ant
episodes.overview: In the snowy north, the soldiers of Fort Briggs engage an invading army and Marcoh leads an attack against monstrous Envy. In Central, an ominous and shocking secret is revealed to Olivier Armstrong.

episodes.title: Signs of a Counteroffensive
episodes.overview: May and Marcoh's efforts to decode the research of Scar's brother yield progress, but it might be too late to prevent catastrophe. Violence is spreading across the land, and it will soon reach the northern border.

episodes.title: The Abyss
episodes.overview: Bound by more than blood, the Elrics have long shared joy and pain. Now, with Al wandering the frigid void - and Ed losing blood by Kimblee's hand - the mystical connection of their souls could prove fatal.

episodes.title: Homunculus
episodes.overview: Long ago, the blood of a simple slave was used in an experiment which created a strange, shapeless being. In exchange for the gift of existence, the being gave the slave a name - and cursed him with immortality.

episodes.title: Daydream
episodes.overview: The ruse of Winry's abduction by Scar is revealed, but a plan of rescue must still be hatched. A brutal storm is coming - one which only Alphonse Elric can brave.

episodes.title: Conflict at Baschool
episodes.overview: When Scar is cornered by a pair of gruesome chimera, the Elrics must enter the fray as his unlikely allies. Later, Winry's attempt to confront Scar over his role in her parents' death ends in disaster.

episodes.title: The First Homunculus
episodes.overview: The first Homunculus reveals itself; Edward is surprised by an offer from Kimblee: Fullmetal can have all he has searched for - in exchange for becoming a mass murderer.

episodes.title: Family Portrait
episodes.overview: As Raven tries to corrupt Armstrong, Ed and Al can only wait in their cell. Long ago, their father faced his own captivity, confined to an eternity of regret in an undying body. To escape the pain, he said goodbye.

episodes.title: The Shape of This Country
episodes.overview: Edward uncovers a conspiracy of staggering scope: a plot that has already claimed countless victims. Clues suggest that Fort Briggs will soon know bloodshed - and an entire nation will suffer.

episodes.title: Ice Queen
episodes.overview: The soldiers at Fort Briggs remain ever vigilant against the threat of spies from Drachma. The massive compound may seem impenetrable - but a violent intruder offers destructive proof to the contrary.

episodes.title: The Northern Wall of Briggs
episodes.overview: The frigid northern borderlands become a battlefield when Kimblee finally closes in on Scar. Deeper into the frozen wasteland, Ed and Al's fight is against the bitter elements as they struggle to reach Fort Briggs.

episodes.title: The Führer's Son
episodes.overview: A secret encounter allows Mustang to spark new ambitions in an old friend - an ally with loyal troops at his command. Meanwhile, Edward and Alphonse share a chance meeting with their biggest fan - young Selim Bradley.

episodes.title: The 520 Cens Promise
episodes.overview: Even as his subordinates are scattered, Mustang finds he still has allies - unfortunately, so do his enemies. The Homunculi unleash one of the Ishvalan War's most notorious killers to deal with Scar and Marcoh.

episodes.title: The Ishvalan War of Extermination
episodes.overview: As Edward hears Hawkeye's tale of a time when idealistic young soldiers were tasked with genocide, the horrors of the Ishvalan battlefield are revealed.

episodes.title: Struggle of the Fool
episodes.overview: The Elrics are at Bradley's mercy; if the brothers make one wrong move, those dearest to them will pay. As Mustang quietly gathers allies at his side, Ed discovers there may be no need to find a Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: Father
episodes.overview: The Elrics come face to face with Father - and his face is familiar indeed. Powerless and amazed, Ed and Al can only watch as Father creates a new Homunculus with alchemy that should be impossible.

episodes.title: Interlude Party
episodes.overview: Visions of the past play out as Hohenheim reflects on the follies of man; the pain that comes with family, the truths of Alchemy and the roots of war.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: Truths are exposed when Al finds the one called Father, and Mustang hears the tale of Bradley's creation - but the most amazing revelation is reserved for Ed after he once again breaks alchemy's greatest taboo.

episodes.title: Doorway of Darkness
episodes.overview: The Homunculi are winning. Ed and Ling face a horrific enemy within the hellish expanse of Gluttony's gut. In Central, Mustang can only watch as his loyal band of soldiers is divided by Bradley.

episodes.title: Inside the Belly
episodes.overview: Gluttony's twisted powers overwhelm the Elrics - and the creature's appetite is satisfied by battle's end. Meanwhile, Mustang acts on his suspicions of Bradley and finds himself in the belly of the beast.

episodes.title: Girl on the Battlefield
episodes.overview: Cooperation between Mustang's cabal and Ling Yao's band leads to the capture of a Homunculus. Unfortunately, their actions also capture the eye of the Homunculus hiding atop the military's ranks.

episodes.title: Backs in the Distance
episodes.overview: Scar's mission to destroy those who slaughtered his people is fueled by justifiable rage. Upon learning the role Scar played in her parents' deaths, Winry claims those murderous feelings as her own.

episodes.title: Advance of the Fool
episodes.overview: Hoping to learn more about the Homunculi, Ed and Al devise a risky strategy to lure the creatures out of hiding. Step one of the brothers' plan: risk death at the hands of their most dangerous enemy - Scar.

episodes.title: Father Before the Grave
episodes.overview: Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

episodes.title: Death of the Undying
episodes.overview: Mustang, Alphonse, Havoc, and Hawkeye split up to search a military laboratory. If Lust has her way, none of them will ever see each other again.

episodes.title: The Arrogant Palm of a Small Human
episodes.overview: Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

episodes.title: Cold Flame
episodes.overview: Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

episodes.title: Footsteps of a Comrade-in-Arms
episodes.overview: After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

episodes.title: Envoy from the East
episodes.overview: The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

episodes.title: Those Who Lurk Underground
episodes.overview: In a violent clash with Greed, King Bradley proves to be a brutal opponent. But the man who finally destroys the Ultimate Shield is more powerful than even the Fuhrer himself.

episodes.title: Beasts of Dublith
episodes.overview: Al is abducted by chimeras led by the seemingly indestructible Homunculus known as Greed. When Ed's rescue attempt falls short, Izumi proves once more that she's got the brothers' best interests in mind.

episodes.title: One is All, All is One
episodes.overview: While visiting Izumi, their childhood teacher, the Elrics recall the early difficulties of grasping equivalent exchange. They also discover she shares their intimate knowledge of alchemy's greatest taboo.

episodes.title: Miracle at Rush Valley
episodes.overview: The Elrics, realizing alchemy has yet to unlock the mysteries of creating life, feel powerless when a new friend goes into labor. Winry, however, jumps into action with a young thief named Paninya.

episodes.title: Separate Destinations
episodes.overview: When the conspiracy surrounding the Philosopher's Stone closes in on the highest ranks of the military, one of Mustang's most trusted and cherished allies is murdered.

episodes.title: Created Feelings
episodes.overview: Al is haunted by the notion his entire existence was simply created by his brother. When the youngest Elric angrily reveals these suspicions, only Winry can convince him just how wrong he is about Ed.

episodes.title: The Fifth Laboratory
episodes.overview: Ed and Al furiously battle the Fifth Laboratory's psychotic guards. In the chaos, the truth behind the Philosopher's Stone is buried beneath rubble - and disturbing new questions are unearthed.

episodes.title: Hidden Truths
episodes.overview: The Elrics discover the horrific ingredient needed to create a Philosopher's Stone. When night falls, they prowl the grounds of a secret laboratory in search of more facts - but the brothers find only danger.

episodes.title: Road of Hope
episodes.overview: Before arriving at the Rockbell home for repairs, the Elrics meet Dr. Marcoh, a State Alchemist running from past sins. The information he gives Ed and Al could put the Philosopher's Stone within reach.

episodes.title: Rain of Sorrows
episodes.overview: Edward and Alphonse are attacked by Scar, a mysterious killer wanted for a string of gruesome murders. His powers are incredible - and his obsession with slaying State Alchemists might be justified.

episodes.title: An Alchemist's Anguish
episodes.overview: The Elrics meet Shou Tucker, a leading researcher in the field of chimeras. He has much to teach Ed and Al about alchemy - and the horrible cruelty that sometimes accompanies it.

episodes.title: City of Heresy
episodes.overview: Science and faith collide when the Elrics confront Father Cornello. He claims to work miracles, but the brothers suspect him of abusing a Philosopher's Stone to manipulate his flock.

episodes.title: The First Day
episodes.overview: A glimpse into the past reveals the pain and desperation that drove the Elric boys to break alchemy's greatest taboo - human transmutation - and their reasons for becoming dogs of the military.

episodes.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
episodes.overview: The Elric brothers adjust to military life and take part in a manhunt for Isaac the Freezer, a former State Alchemist bent on ending the reign of Fuhrer Bradley.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
overview: Two young brothers are raised as alchemists, but when they are severely injured trying to perform a forbidden act, they begin searching for the one thing that can save them; the fabled philosopher's stone.

episodes.title: Laws and Promises
episodes.overview: Ed and Al demonstrate what they will sacrifice for each other.

episodes.title: Death
episodes.overview: Ed battles Envy in order to free Al.

episodes.title: Beyond the Gate
episodes.overview: Ed is sent to the other side of the gate, where his understanding of alchemy is questioned.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.overview: When Al gets kidnapped, Ed must rescue him; Mustang helps Ed.

episodes.title: Homunculus Sealed
episodes.overview: Tucker tries to resurrect his daughter; Sloth captures Al.

episodes.title: Human Transmutation
episodes.overview: The brothers find themselves in danger while separated.

episodes.title: One Who Lets Her Heart Rot
episodes.overview: The truth behind the truth is revealed; Colonel Mustang decides to challenge military leadership.

episodes.title: Hohenheim of Light
episodes.overview: Ed and Al must convince Mustang's faction that the Fuhrer is not what he seems.

episodes.title: The Stray Dog
episodes.overview: Ed and Al begin their journey home; the Fuhrer declares the Elrics to be fugitives.

episodes.title: Holy Mother
episodes.overview: Scar remains determined to create the Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: The Scar
episodes.overview: Al intervenes when Marta tries to get revenge on Kimbley for her friends' deaths; the seventh sin is revealed.

episodes.title: Secret of Ishbal
episodes.overview: Marta leads Ed and Al to the ruins of Ishbal, and she tells them the true cause of the war and the reasons for her transformation; Ed and Al question everything they once believed.

episodes.title: With the River's Flow
episodes.overview: Al questions Ed on their mission, creating tension between the two brothers; Sciezka and Winry come into contact with the dangerous Sloth.

episodes.title: The Flame Alchemist, The Bachelor Lieutenant, & The Mystery of Warehouse 13
episodes.overview: Mustang gets investigated; an adventure with the Flame Alchemist and his loyal followers; mystery unfolds unknown relatives of Maj. Armstrong, and a haunted warehouse.

episodes.title: The Sinner Within Me
episodes.overview: Lust and Gluttony meet with Wrath for the first time; Ed, Al and Winry travel to Ishbal and continue to crack the mystery.

episodes.title: Reunion of the Fallen
episodes.overview: Lust wants to know where she came from, and where she will go when she dies; Lust meets a familiar man who provides answers and memories.

episodes.title: Theory of Avarice
episodes.overview: Greed transforms his body into an impervious shield and tells Ed he must kill him in order to save Al; Armstrong battles Greed and his men.

episodes.title: Al, Captured
episodes.overview: Kidnappers take Al, leaving Ed frantic.

episodes.title: Dante of the Deep Wood
episodes.overview: Izumi sends Ed and Al to meet the alchemist Dante.

episodes.title: Sin
episodes.overview: Izumi escapes with the boy; the brothers try to stop Izumi's plan of atonement.

episodes.title: Assault on South Headquarters
episodes.overview: A former military officer spots Scar; Izumi attacks the military.

episodes.title: The Untainted Child
episodes.overview: The brothers encounter a strange boy.

episodes.title: One is All, All is One
episodes.overview: Hohenheim's visit ends with a harsh warning to Pinako; Ed finds hope and has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

episodes.title: Teacher
episodes.overview: Ed and Al are reunited with Izumi, their former teacher who gives the boys a traumatic interrogation.

episodes.title: Her Reason
episodes.overview: Winry drags Ed and Al to Rush Valley.

episodes.title: Words of Farewell
episodes.overview: Ed and Al give up their search for the Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: Bonding Memories
episodes.overview: Al joins Scar on a renegade mission against the state.

episodes.title: Heart of Steel
episodes.overview: Winry needs to make repairs; Al questions his existence.

episodes.title: Created Human
episodes.overview: Ed is nearly tricked by a face from his past.

episodes.title: The Red Glow
episodes.overview: Ed discovers more about the experiments in the fifth laboratory.

episodes.title: Soul of the Guardian
episodes.overview: Two guardians of Lab 5 unleash an assault on Ed and Al.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Truths
episodes.overview: Ed and Al learn the secret ingredient for the Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: Marcoh's Notes
episodes.overview: Ed and Al scour the library for Dr. Marcoh's records; Scar battles Lust and Gluttony.

episodes.title: House of the Waiting Family
episodes.overview: The Elrics return to their childhood village; Ed visits his monther's grave.

episodes.title: That Which Is Lost
episodes.overview: Ed and Al return to their hometown for repairs.

episodes.title: The Ishbal Massacre
episodes.overview: While on the run, Doctor Marcoh confess to the Elrics.

episodes.title: Destruction's Right Hand
episodes.overview: Ed and Al search for a deserter alchemist.

episodes.title: Fullmetal vs. Flame
episodes.overview: Ed challenges Mustang to a fight.

episodes.title: The Other Brothers Elric (2)
episodes.overview: Ed and Al discover the source of the strange malady.

episodes.title: The Other Brothers Elric (1)
episodes.overview: Imposters parade as Ed and Al.

episodes.title: The Phantom Thief
episodes.overview: Ed and Al stumble into an unpopular manhunt for a crowd-pleasing thief.

episodes.title: Be Thou for the People
episodes.overview: Ed is assigned to inspect the progress in a small mining town.

episodes.title: The Philosopher's Stone
episodes.overview: Ed resigns as State Alchemist; Winry arrives.

episodes.title: Night of the Chimera's Cry
episodes.overview: Shou Tucker must impress the state with his alchemy for his annual assessment.

episodes.title: The Alchemy Exam
episodes.overview: Ed and Al prepare for their Alchemy exam.

episodes.title: The Man with the Mechanical Arm
episodes.overview: Ed and Al are held hostage on a train.

episodes.title: A Forger's Love
episodes.overview: While on their way to seek out a man from their early childhood, Al and Ed arrive in a town haunted by a ghostly woman.

episodes.title: Mother
episodes.overview: The story line flashes back to a younger Ed and Al and tells how their mother died and their determination to bring her back to life.

episodes.title: Body of the Sanctioned
episodes.overview: Edward and Alphonse have to decide if they should reveal the truth behind Cornello's miracles and the possible devastating effects that revelation might have on the townspeople and their lives.

episodes.title: To Challenge the Sun
episodes.overview: Edward and Alphonse meet a so-called religious leader during their travels who can invoke miracles, once seeing his miracles in person, they set out to discover if he is using the fabled Philosopher's Stone.

title: Game of Thrones
overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.

episodes.title: The Iron Throne
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the devastating attack on King's Landing, Daenerys must face the survivors.

episodes.title: The Bells
episodes.overview: Varys betrays his queen, and Daenerys brings her forces to King's Landing.

episodes.title: The Last of the Starks
episodes.overview: The survivors plan their next steps; Cersei makes a power move.

episodes.title: The Long Night
episodes.overview: Winterfell fights the Army of the Dead.

episodes.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
episodes.overview: Jaime faces judgement and Winterfell prepares for the battle to come.

episodes.title: Winterfell
episodes.overview: Arriving at Winterfell, Jon and Daenerys struggle to unite a divided North. Jon gets some big news.

episodes.title: The Dragon and the Wolf
episodes.overview: Cersei sits on the Iron Throne; Daenerys sails across the Narrow Sea; Jon Snow is King in the North, and winter is finally here.

episodes.title: Beyond the Wall
episodes.overview: Jon's mission continues north of the wall, but the odds against his ragged band of misfits may be greater than he imagined.

episodes.title: Eastwatch
episodes.overview: Daenerys demands loyalty from the surviving Lannister soldiers; Jon heeds Bran's warning about White Walkers on the move; Cersei vows to vanquish anyone or anything that stands in her way.

episodes.title: The Spoils of War
episodes.overview: Arya gets to the final destination. Daenerys takes it upon herself to strike back.

episodes.title: The Queen's Justice
episodes.overview: Daenerys holds court. Cersei returns a gift. Jaime learns from his mistakes.

episodes.title: Stormborn
episodes.overview: Daenerys receives an unexpected visitor. Jon faces a revolt. Tyrion plans the conquest of Westeros.

episodes.title: Dragonstone
episodes.overview: Jon organizes the defense of the North. Cersei tries to even the odds. Daenerys comes home.

episodes.title: The Winds of Winter
episodes.overview: Alliances are made, the High Sparrow is holding trials at King's Landing, Daenerys is sailing for the Seven Kingdoms and a new King of the North is crowned.

episodes.title: Battle of the Bastards
episodes.overview: Ramsay surprises his audience. Jon retaliates. Dany is true to her word.

episodes.title: No One
episodes.overview: Jaime encounters a hero; the High Sparrow fixates on another prey; Arya hatches a new plan; Yara and Theon plot their next move; Olenna and Cersei discuss their families' futures. While Jaime weighs his options, Cersei answers a request. Tyrion's plans bear fruit. Arya faces a new test.

episodes.title: The Broken Man
episodes.overview: The High Sparrow eyes another target. Jaime confronts a hero. Arya makes a plan. The North is reminded.

episodes.title: Blood of My Blood
episodes.overview: An old foe comes back into the picture. Gilly meets Sam's family. Arya faces a difficult choice. Jaime faces off against the High Sparrow.

episodes.title: The Door
episodes.overview: Tyrion seeks a strange ally. Bran learns a great deal. Brienne goes on a mission. Arya is given a chance to prove herself.

episodes.title: Book of the Stranger
episodes.overview: Tyrion strikes a deal. Jorah and Daario undertake a difficult task. Jaime and Cersei try to improve their situation.

episodes.title: Oathbreaker
episodes.overview: Daenerys meets her future. Bran meets the past. Tommen confronts the High Sparrow. Arya trains to be No One. Varys finds an answer. Ramsay gets a gift.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.overview: Bran trains with the Three-Eyed Raven. In King's Landing, Jaime advises Tommen. Tyrion demands good news, but has to make his own. At Castle Black, the Night's Watch stands behind Thorne. Ramsay Bolton proposes a plan, and Balon Greyjoy entertains other proposals.

episodes.title: The Red Woman
episodes.overview: Jon Snow is dead. Daenerys meets a strong man. Cersei sees her daughter again.

episodes.title: Mother's Mercy
episodes.overview: Cersei seeks forgiveness; Jon faces a new challenge; Arya plots to cross a name off her list; Tyrion sees a familiar face; and Daenerys finds herself surrounded by strangers.

episodes.title: The Dance of Dragons
episodes.overview: Stannis confronts a troubling decision. Jon returns to The Wall. Mace visits the Iron Bank. Arya encounters someone from her past. Dany reluctantly oversees a traditional celebration of athleticism.

episodes.title: Hardhome
episodes.overview: Arya makes progress in her training. Sansa confronts an old friend. Cersei struggles. Jon travels.

episodes.title: The Gift
episodes.overview: Jon prepares for conflict. Sansa tries to talk to Theon. Brienne waits for a sign. Stannis remains stubborn. Jaime attempts to reconnect with family.

episodes.title: Unbowed, Unbent, Unbroken
episodes.overview: Arya trains. Jorah and Tyrion run into slavers. Trystane and Myrcella make plans. Jaime and Bronn reach their destination. The Sand Snakes attack.

episodes.title: Kill the Boy
episodes.overview: Dany makes a difficult decision in Meereen. Jon recruits the help of an unexpected ally. Brienne searches for Sansa. Theon remains under Ramsay's control.

episodes.title: Sons of the Harpy
episodes.overview: The Faith Militant grow increasingly aggressive. Jaime and Bronn head south. Ellaria and the Sand Snakes vow vengeance.

episodes.title: High Sparrow
episodes.overview: Cersei meets the High Sparrow after learning of a clergyman's embarrassing tale. Meanwhile, Davos talks to Jon about the future of Winterfell, where Ramsay Snow has just learned the identity of his future bride; Arya grows impatient doing menial tasks in the House of Black and White; and Tyrion searches for more comfortable surroundings on a long trip with Varys.

episodes.title: The House of Black and White
episodes.overview: Arya arrives in Braavos; Brienne and Podrick find danger while traveling; Cersei worries about Myrcella in Dorne when Ellaria Sand seeks revenge for Oberyn's death; Jon is tempted by Stannis.

episodes.title: The Wars to Come
episodes.overview: Varys discusses a conspiracy with Tyrion; Daenerys' rule faces a new threat; Jon finds himself between two kings; and Cersei and Jaime try to move on from Tywin's demise.

episodes.title: The Children
episodes.overview: An unexpected arrival north of the Wall changes circumstances. Dany is forced to face harsh realities. Bran learns more of his destiny. Tyrion sees the truth of his situation.

episodes.title: The Watchers on the Wall
episodes.overview: Jon Snow and the rest of the Night's Watch face the biggest challenge to the Wall yet.

episodes.title: The Mountain and the Viper
episodes.overview: Mole's Town receives unexpected visitors. Littlefinger's motives are questioned. Ramsay attempts to prove himself to his father. Tyrion's fate is decided.

episodes.title: Mockingbird
episodes.overview: Tyrion enlists an unlikely ally. Daario entreats Dany to allow him to do what he does best. Jon's warnings about the Wall's vulnerability fall on deaf ears. Brienne follows a new lead on the road with Pod.

episodes.title: The Laws of Gods and Men
episodes.overview: Stannis and Davos set sail with a new strategy. Dany meets with supplicants. Tyrion faces down his father in the throne room.

episodes.title: First of His Name
episodes.overview: Cersei and Tywin plot the Crown's next move. Dany discusses future plans. Jon embarks on a new mission.

episodes.title: Oathkeeper
episodes.overview: Dany balances justice and mercy. Jaime tasks Brienne with his honor. Jon secures volunteers while Bran, Jojen, Meera and Hodor stumble on shelter.

episodes.title: Breaker of Chains
episodes.overview: Tyrion ponders his options. Tywin extends an olive branch. Sam realizes Castle Black isn't safe, and Jon proposes a bold plan. The Hound teaches Arya the way things are. Dany chooses her Champion.

episodes.title: The Lion and the Rose
episodes.overview: Tyrion lends Jaime a hand. Joffrey and Margaery host a breakfast. At Dragonstone, Stannis loses patience with Davos. Ramsay finds a purpose for his pet. North of the Wall, Bran sees where they must go.

episodes.title: Two Swords
episodes.overview: Tyrion welcomes a guest to King's Landing. At Castle Black, Jon Snow finds himself unwelcome. Dany is pointed to Meereen, the mother of all slave cities. Arya runs into an old friend.

episodes.title: Mhysa
episodes.overview: Joffrey challenges Tywin. Bran tells a ghost story. In Dragonstone, mercy comes from strange quarters. Daenerys waits to see if she is a conqueror or a liberator.

episodes.title: The Rains of Castamere
episodes.overview: Robb presents himself to Walder Frey, and Edmure meets his bride. Jon faces his harshest test yet. Bran discovers a new gift. Daario and Jorah debate how to take Yunkai. House Frey joins with House Tully.

episodes.title: Second Sons
episodes.overview: King's Landing hosts a wedding, and Tyrion and Sansa spend the night together. Daenerys meets the Titan's Bastard. Davos demands proof from Melisandre. Sam and Gilly meet an older Gentleman.

episodes.title: The Bear and the Maiden Fair
episodes.overview: Daenerys exchanges gifts with a slave lord outside Yunkai. As Sansa frets about her prospects, Shae chafes at Tyrion's new situation. Tywin counsels the king, and Melisandre reveals a secret to Gendry. Brienne faces a formidable foe in Harrenhal.

episodes.title: The Climb
episodes.overview: Tywin plans strategic unions for the Lannisters. Melisandre visits the Riverlands. Robb weighs a compromise to repair his alliance with House Frey. Roose Bolton decides what to do with Jaime Lannister. Jon, Ygritte and the Wildlings face a daunting climb.

episodes.title: Kissed by Fire
episodes.overview: The Hound is judged by the gods; Jaime is judged by men. Jon proves himself; Robb is betrayed. Tyrion learns the cost of weddings.

episodes.title: And Now His Watch is Ended
episodes.overview: The Night's Watch takes stock. Varys meets his better. Arya is taken to the commander of the Brotherhood. Daenerys exchanges a chain for a Whip.

episodes.title: Walk of Punishment
episodes.overview: Tyrion shoulders new responsibilities. Jon is taken to the Fist of the First Men. Daenerys meets with the slavers. Jaime strikes a deal with his captors.

episodes.title: Dark Wings, Dark Words
episodes.overview: Sansa says too much. Shae asks Tyrion for a favor. Jaime finds a way to pass the time. Arya runs into the Brotherhood Without Banners.

episodes.title: Valar Dohaeris
episodes.overview: Jon is brought before Mance Rayder, the King Beyond the Wall, while the Night's Watch survivors retreat south. In King's Landing, Tyrion asks for his reward. Littlefinger offers Sansa a way out. Cersei hosts a dinner for the royal family. Daenerys sails into Slaver's Bay.

episodes.title: Valar Morghulis
episodes.overview: Tyrion awakens to a changed situation. King Joffrey doles out rewards to his subjects. As Theon stirs his men to action, Luwin offers some final advice. Brienne silences Jaime; Arya receives a gift from Jaqen; Dany goes to a strange place; Jon proves himself to Qhorin.

episodes.title: Blackwater
episodes.overview: A massive battle rages for control of King's Landing and the Iron Throne.

episodes.title: The Prince of Winterfell
episodes.overview: Theon holds the fort; Arya calls in her debt with Jaqen; Robb is betrayed; Stannis and Davos approach their destination.

episodes.title: A Man Without Honor
episodes.overview: Jaime meets a relative; Theon hunts; Dany receives an invitation.

episodes.title: The Old Gods and the New
episodes.overview: Arya has a surprise visitor; Dany vows to take what is hers; Joffrey meets his subjects; Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself.

episodes.title: The Ghost of Harrenhal
episodes.overview: Confusion rages in the Stormlands in the wake of a devastating reversal. Catelyn must flee with a new ally, whilst Littlefinger sees an opportunity in the chaos. Theon seeks to prove himself to his father in battle. Arya receives a promise from the enigmatic Jaqen H'ghar. The Night's Watch arrives at the Fist of the First Men. Daenerys Targaryen receives a marriage proposal.

episodes.title: Garden of Bones
episodes.overview: Tyrion attempts to restrain Joffrey's cruelty. Catelyn attempts to broker a peace between Stannis and Renly. Daenerys and her followers arrive at the great city of Qarth and hope to find refuge there. Arya and Gendry arrive at Harrenhal, a great castle now under Lannister occupation.

episodes.title: What is Dead May Never Die
episodes.overview: Catelyn Stark treats with King Renly in the hope of winning an alliance. Tyrion undertakes a complex plan in King's Landing to expose an enemy. At Winterfell, Bran's dreams continue to trouble him.

episodes.title: The Night Lands
episodes.overview: Stannis uses Ser Davos to seek out new allies for his war with the Lannisters. On the road north, Arya confides in Gendry. Robb Stark sends Theon Greyjoy to win an alliance with his father and the fierce warriors of the Iron Islands. Cersei and Tyrion clash on how to rule in King's Landing.

episodes.title: The North Remembers
episodes.overview: War grips the continent of Westeros. As Tyrion Lannister tries to take his strong-willed nephew in hand in King's Landing, Stannis Baratheon launches his own campaign to take the Iron Throne with the help of a mysterious priestess. In the east, Daenerys must lead her retinue through a desolate wasteland whilst beyond the Wall the Night's Watch seeks the aid of a wildling.

episodes.title: Fire and Blood
episodes.overview: Daenerys must realize her destiny. Jaime finds himself in an unfamiliar predicament.

episodes.title: Baelor
episodes.overview: Catelyn must negotiate with the irascible Lord Walder Frey.

episodes.title: The Pointy End
episodes.overview: Tyrion joins his father's army with unexpected allies. Events in King's Landing take a turn for the worse as Arya's lessons are put to the test.

episodes.title: You Win or You Die
episodes.overview: Eddard's investigations in King's Landing reach a climax and a dark secret is revealed.

episodes.title: A Golden Crown
episodes.overview: Viserys is increasingly frustrated by the lack of progress towards gaining his crown.

episodes.title: The Wolf and the Lion
episodes.overview: Catelyn's actions on the road have repercussions for Eddard. Tyrion enjoys the dubious hospitality of the Eyrie.

episodes.title: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things
episodes.overview: Tyrion stops at Winterfell on his way home and gets a frosty reception from Robb Stark. Eddard's investigation into the death of his predecessor gets underway.

episodes.title: Lord Snow
episodes.overview: Jon Snow attempts to find his place amongst the Night's Watch. Eddard and his daughters arrive at King's Landing.

episodes.title: The Kingsroad
episodes.overview: An incident on the Kingsroad threatens Eddard and Robert's friendship. Jon and Tyrion travel to the Wall, where they discover that the reality of the Night's Watch may not match the heroic image of it.

episodes.title: Winter is Coming
episodes.overview: Lord Eddard Stark, ruler of the North, is summoned to court by his old friend, King Robert Baratheon, to serve as the King's Hand. Eddard reluctantly agrees after learning of a possible threat to the King's life. Eddard's bastard son Jon Snow must make a painful decision about his own future, while in the distant east Viserys Targaryen plots to reclaim his father's throne, usurped by Robert, by selling his sister in marriage.

title: Gintama
overview: In a world where aliens have invaded Edo Period Japan, skyscrapers, trains and motor bikes have replaced the simple life of Earth inhabitants. One man however, still carries the soul of a samurai, Gintoki Sakata, otherwise known as Yorozuya Gin-san. As reckless as he is, Gintoki carries his own resolve and is ready to take on any challenge with his fellow companions.
