title: Gurren Lagann
overview: When a young laborer escapes to the world aboveground, he discovers a violent land in which humans battle robots controlled by a power-hungry noble.

episodes.title: The Lights in the Sky Are Stars
episodes.overview: Simon and Nia are reunited. Team Dai-Gurren uses their combined spiral power to merge everyone together and create the galaxy-sized Tengen Toppa Gurren-Lagann, engaging the Anti-Spirals in a decisive battle for the fate of the universe.

episodes.title: Let's Go, Buddy
episodes.overview: After merging with Lorgenome's ship and transforming into the gigantic Super Galaxy Gurren-Lagann, Simon and his friends successfully fight back against the enemy. However, the enemy traps them in a world of dreams and desires. Just when all hope seems lost, an ally from the past reappears.

episodes.title: I Accept Your Last Wish!
episodes.overview: Team Dai-Gurren tries in vain to escape the ocean of despair created by the anti-spirals. Only a sacrifice can save the others.

episodes.title: I'll Never Forget This Minute, This Second
episodes.overview: Guided by Simon and Nia's feelings for each other, Team Dai-Gurren break through dimensions in search for the Anti-Spirals' homeworld. But after falling into the enemy's trap, they end up losing some of their most precious members, due to its vicious offensive.

episodes.title: Let's Go, This is the Final Battle
episodes.overview: The members of Team Dai-Gurren make their preparations for the imminent war against the Anti-Spirals, but Rossiu is missing. However, when Kinon tells Simon about what he really intends to do, both begin desperately searching for him.

episodes.title: This is My Final Duty!
episodes.overview: The Gurren-Lagann and the Arc-Gurren join together to form the massive Arc-Gurren-Lagann and stop the Human Annihilation System.

episodes.title: You Are Someone Who Ought to Survive
episodes.overview: Yoko had been working on an island as a teacher until she learned of the situation at Teppelin and returned to break Simon free. Reunited, Simon and the members of Team Dai-Gurren launch themselves into space to protect the Arc-Gurren from the enemy forces.

episodes.title: How Far Will God Test Us?
episodes.overview: As Simon arrives in prison, he unexpectedly meets Viral, who comments on how far he has fallen. Meanwhile, the truth about Rossiu's emergency plan and the consequences for those left behind on Earth are revealed.

episodes.title: We Will Survive, By Any Means Necessary
episodes.overview: Rossiu overthrows Simon and places him under arrest. But when the Anti-Spirals launch a large-scale attack on Kamina City, he is left with no choice but to let Simon fight the enemy using the Gurren-Lagann.

episodes.title: Tell Me the Secrets of This World
episodes.overview: After the Anti-Spirals' first attack and Nia's astonishing announcement, Simon desperately searches for her while Rossiu finally completes his secret project.

episodes.title: You Don't Know Anything!
episodes.overview: During the following seven years, a new civilization rises and prospers under Simon's leadership. However, these peaceful times come to end when the threat mentioned in Lordgenome's last words starts to reveal itself.

episodes.title: Compilation Episode
episodes.overview: Recap of the important events of the series so far.

episodes.title: I Will Head Towards Tomorrow
episodes.overview: The last of the Divine Generals falls and the city of Teppelin collapses, revealing a Gunman of gigantic proportions. Simon and Nia struggle to pass through it in order to confront her father, the Spiral King himself.

episodes.title: Well Met, Everyone
episodes.overview: At last, Team Dai-Gurren arrives at the outskirts of Teppelin, but before aiming to the city, they must face a combined full-scale attack of Cytomander and Guame's forces.

episodes.title: Eat Up Everyone!
episodes.overview: Trying to do her part in the Team Nia decides to become a cook. Cytomander, the fourth member of the Divine Generals, launches an aerial attack on the Dai-Gurren. Simon leads the counter-attack on the Gurren-Lagann.

episodes.title: Yoko, Will You Do Me a Favor?
episodes.overview: On their way to Teppelin Team Dai-Gurren stumbles upon a vast ocean and must wait before crossing it. While the rest of the group play at the beach, Yoko starts to feel uneasy about Nia. After preparations are complete, Team Dai-Gurren begins their sea cruise, oblivious to the fact that an ambush is underway by Adiane and Viral.

episodes.title: Simon, Hands Off
episodes.overview: The Team falls into a trap set by the third member of the Four Divine Generals. They are taken captive and await execution underground.

episodes.title: Who is This Bro?
episodes.overview: Nia learns of Kamina's significance in Simon's erratic behavior and offers him some stinging, yet honest advice, which draws the ire of an untrusting Yoko. With tension building within the Team, the crew scrambles to stand by Nia's side when Adiane returns to complete her stalled attack.

episodes.title: What, Exactly, is a Human?
episodes.overview: Team Dai-Gurren managed to take control of the enemy fortress. After falling off a cliff, Simon notices a Gunman throw a capsule into a deep valley.

episodes.title: Later, Buddy
episodes.overview: Having temporarily stalled Viral and Thymilph in the last skirmish, the Team Gurren and their newly arrived allies join forces as "Team Dai-Gurren" and launch a decisive strike against the regrouping Gunmen force.

episodes.title: You're Gonna Do It!!
episodes.overview: One of the Four Divine Generals of the Spiral King arrives to support Viral's Enki. Seizing the opportunity to land a great victory, Kamina and Simon pilot the Gurren-Lagann against seemingly overwhelming odds.

episodes.title: Sit in the Hot Tub 'Til You're Sick!!
episodes.overview: On their way to the Gunmen rallying point, Team Gurren decides to take a break at a hot springs getaway they find in the middle of nowhere, only to discover not everything is as it seems.

episodes.title: I Don't Get It, Not One Bit!
episodes.overview: Team Gurren's journey brings them to an underground village, where society mandates a humbling existence and the worship of Gunmen as divine beings. Team Gurren is joined by Rossiu and two children, Gimmy and Darry.

episodes.title: Having Lots of Faces Doesn't Make You Great!
episodes.overview: In order to take the fight to the Beastmen, Team Gurren sets out to strike a possible Gunmen rallying point. Along the way, they encounter the eccentric Black Siblings, as well as the prospects of having to defeat a multi-faced enemy.

episodes.title: Who Do You Think You Are, Having Two Faces!!
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the previous battle, Kamina, Simon, and Yoko proceed to forage for provisions. However, a chance encounter with a formidable Beastman, Viral, and his powerful Gunman forces the Gurren and the Lagann to combine to form a new Gunman.

episodes.title: I Said I'm Gonna Pilot That Thing!!
episodes.overview: Now above ground Kamina Simon and Yoko find themselves faced with 2 more gunmen. They dispatch these 1 of them with the help of people from Yokos home of Ritona town. Ritona is soon under attack by 3 more Gunmen but some quick (and insane) thinking by Kamina saves them..

episodes.title: Bust Through the Heavens with Your Drill!!
episodes.overview: Kamina is jailed for trying to escape to the surface. Suddenly a mysterious women named Yoko comes from aboves to the underground village while fighting a giant robot. Simon helps fend off the robot with the help of his new "Gunmen" which he found while drilling around.

title: Halo
overview: Depicting an epic 26th-century conflict between humanity and an alien threat known as the Covenant, the series weaves deeply drawn personal stories with action, adventure and a richly imagined vision of the future.

episodes.title: Halo
episodes.overview: The climactic battle for the Halo begins. John makes a fateful choice. Soren and Kwan undertake a rescue mission. Halsey and Miranda unleash an ancient horror. Season finale.

episodes.title: Thermopylae
episodes.overview: John-117 comes face to face with Makee. A revelation leads Ackerson to question his loyalties. Soren and Laera's relationship begins to fracture. Halsey, Kwan and Miranda work to solve a mystery.

episodes.title: Onyx
episodes.overview: John seeks revenge on a secret ONI planet. Perez trains to become a new kind of soldier. Kai finds herself torn between her Spartan code and her loyalty to Master Chief. Makee turns to Cortana for help in her search for the Halo.

episodes.title: Aleria
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of defeat, the survivors struggle to pick up the pieces. On the desolate planet of Aleria, John grapples with an unprecedented loss. Soren and Laera search for their missing son. Makee treads carefully as the Arbiter grows impatient.

episodes.title: Reach
episodes.overview: A Covenant assault threatens humanity's most important stronghold. John, Perez and Silver Team fight an overwhelming enemy. Adm. Keyes rallies the UNSC forces to make a stand. Halsey and Soren must work together to escape captivity.

episodes.title: Visegrad
episodes.overview: John and Silver Team embark on an unsanctioned mission. Laera, Kwan and Kessler must escape Soren's mutinous crew. Ackerson receives troubling intelligence from Cortana. The threat of an attack forces Ackerson to make an irrevocable decision.

episodes.title: Sword
episodes.overview: John pushes Silver Team to its limit as he searches for missing Spartans. Kai worries about John's stability. Kwan finds the Rubble is a far more dangerous place in Soren's absence. Halsey seeks the identity of her captor.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.overview: A deadly evacuation mission signals a shift in Master Chief's war with the Covenant. On Reach, a new regime takes the reins at FLEETCOM. John senses a looming threat close to home.

episodes.title: Transcendence
episodes.overview: Beaten, battered, and betrayed, John 117 leads the Spartans on a suicide mission to find the Halo and save humanity. But at what price?

episodes.title: Allegiance
episodes.overview: John and Makee come to terms with their shared vision. Halsey has one last chance to save her mission, and herself. As things come to a head, everyone must choose a side.

episodes.title: Inheritance
episodes.overview: Kwan's journey to uncover her family's "true purpose" takes her deep into the deserts of Madrigal. Soren obsesses over unfinished business.

episodes.title: Solace
episodes.overview: Survivors from the battle return to Reach. John confronts Dr. Halsey, and the lies of his past.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.overview: On the run and out of options, Kwan and Soren have a difference of opinion. With the possibility of finding the mysterious Halo on everyone's minds, John makes a horrible discovery. And the war rears its ugly head.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Guided by his visions, John takes Halsey and Cortana back to where it all began, looking for answers from his past. With Soren along for protection, Kwan goes in search of an army. Meanwhile, John's behavior inspires another Spartan to begin a journey of self-discovery. And Miranda discovers a possible link between the artifact and something much larger.

episodes.title: Emergence
episodes.overview: John meets his new partner, and he discovers secrets inside his own memory. Kwan wants to return to Madrigal to continue her people's fight for independence, but Soren has other plans for her. Makee initiates her plan to retrieve the Madrigal object, with deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Unbound
episodes.overview: John takes Kwan to an old friend and learns more about the mystery object, which the Covenant and Makee are determined to steal. With the alien threat growing, Dr. Halsey has a plan to deal with John's unpredictable behavior.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.overview: In the year 2552, humans on the planet Madrigal have been fighting for independence from Earth, but a fatal encounter with the Alien Covenant complicates things. Master Chief John 117 and his super-soldier "Spartans" join the fight. After the battle, Master Chief heads to his home planet of Reach with a Madrigal survivor and a mysterious object he discovered on the planet. But a controversial order has John questioning his mission, and himself.

title: Hell's Paradise
overview: For a chance at a pardon, a ninja assassin joins other condemned criminals on a journey to a mysterious island to retrieve an elixir of immortality.

episodes.title: Endings and Beginnings
episodes.overview: As Gabimaru and his companions finish their respective battles, the additional expedition arrives.

episodes.title: Ephemeralness and Fire
episodes.overview: Gabimaru recalls the days he spent with Yui. How will his battle against Rien end?

episodes.title: Master and Student
episodes.overview: Shion and Nurugai take on Zhu Jin, but both sides lack the ability to finish the other off.

episodes.title: Love and Karma
episodes.overview: The expeditioners work together to take on Tao Fa and Ju Fa, who have undergone Kishikai transformations.

episodes.title: Chrysanthemum and Peach
episodes.overview: When Tao Fa asks Ju Fa for help, Ju Fa recalls the time they spent together.

episodes.title: Two People and One Person
episodes.overview: Gantetsusai and Fuchi struggle against Tao Fa, but they seem to be enjoying themselves.

episodes.title: Conflict and Growing Together
episodes.overview: Gabimaru's group finally enters the sacred mountain, but the Tensen can see everything they're up to.

episodes.title: Humans and Sages
episodes.overview: As the expeditioners prepare, Gabimaru asks Mei if she's sure she wants to leave the island with them.

episodes.title: The Samurai Code and Carnage
episodes.overview: Sagiri believes Shugen will be an ally and eagerly anticipates the expedition's arrival, but Shion is skeptical.

episodes.title: Immutability and Change
episodes.overview: While Aza Chobe battles Rien, Gabimaru regains his memories and begins training in the use of tao.

episodes.title: Reality and Fantasy
episodes.overview: Aza Chobe and Gabimaru lose themselves in battle, but Mei stops their fight.

episodes.title: Dawn and Confusion
episodes.overview: Shugen and Jikka are sent to Shinsenkyo, while Gabimaru and his companions battle Aza Chobe and Toma.

episodes.title: Dreams and Reality
episodes.overview: Sagiri's party faces Mu Dan's seemingly unstoppable true form. Shion does his best to rise to the challenge with his mastery of waves.

episodes.title: Umbrella and Ink
episodes.overview: Mu Dan confronts Sagiri's party and reveals shocking truths about the island's true nature.

episodes.title: Weak and Strong
episodes.overview: Chobe brings new abilities to bear as he faces the Tensen's servants. A secret of Mei's is revealed to Gabimaru, hardening his resolve to fight and opening him up to a new perception of the world.

episodes.title: Yin and Yang
episodes.overview: Mei attempts to explain something very important to Sagiri's party in the forest. Shion tries to explain how he interacts with the world to Nurugai. A mysterious servant of the Tensen tries to explain why Aza Chobe and Toma shouldn't escape.

episodes.title: Gods and People
episodes.overview: Sagiri's group sets off in search of Horai. Gabimaru goes ahead and encounters the same powerful being that confronted Tenza...

episodes.title: Student and Master
episodes.overview: Tenza and Nurugai also encounter one of the island's strange denizens with unfathomable power. All seems lost before they encounter another Yamada Asaemon...

episodes.title: Flowers and Offerings
episodes.overview: Chobe and Toma encounter people unlike any they've ever encountered before. Gabimaru and Sagiri's party finally meet people who live on the island.

episodes.title: Heart and Reason
episodes.overview: Rokurota, the Giant of Bizen, attacks Gabimaru and Sagiri's party. Meanwhile, Chobe and Toma's paths cross with another party's while they look for sustenance in the mountains.

episodes.title: The Samurai and the Woman
episodes.overview: Gabimaru and Sagiri's group cross paths with another Yamada Asaemon, Genji, who takes a dim view of Sagiri's involvement in the present matter. Meanwhile, Yamada Asaemon Tenza tries to find a way off the island along with his charge, Nurugai.

episodes.title: Hell and Paradise
episodes.overview: Yuzuriha approaches Gabimaru and Sagiri with an offer.

episodes.title: Weakness and Strength
episodes.overview: Gabimaru, Sagiri, and the others arrive on Shinsenkyo, and their battle for survival begins.

episodes.title: Screening and Choosing
episodes.overview: The condemned criminals are gathered on the beach to prepare for the expedition to Shinsenkyo, but first, they must reduce their numbers.

episodes.title: The Death Row Convict and the Executioner
episodes.overview: Gabimaru the Hollow has been sentenced to death. Carrying out that sentence, however, may require the services of an extraordinary professional.

title: Hellsing
overview:
Vampires exist. It is the duty of Hellsing, an organization sponsored by the British government, to hide that frightening fact and protect the blissfully unaware populace.

Lately, vampire activity has been on the rise and the cause is more alarming than anything they could have imagined.

title: Hellsing Ultimate
overview: For over a century, the mysterious Hellsing Organization has been secretly protecting the British Empire from the undead. When Sir Integra Hellsing succeeded as the head of the organization, she also inherited the ultimate weapon against these supernatural enemies: Alucard, a rogue vampire possessing mysterious and frightening powers. Now, Hellsing must deal with a more dangerous threat than vampires.

episodes.title: Hellsing X
episodes.overview: Shocking revelations and epic bloodlettings highlight this harrowing final chapter in the Hellsing Ultimate Saga. Find out what becomes of Arucard and the rest of the supernatural freak show!

episodes.title: Hellsing IX
episodes.overview: Arucard, gravely injured, recalls his painful childhood, his supernatural transformation, and violent and bloody altercation with Walter.

episodes.title: Hellsing VIII
episodes.overview: This harrowing episode features the epic return of Arucard - and Integra's willingness to unleash his true power on their enemies!

episodes.title: Hellsing VII
episodes.overview: When her memories are violated, Seras becomes trapped in an illusion which forces her to relive the most horrifying moments of her life. Upon waking from the nightmare, the real pain begins as the battle nears its end.

episodes.title: Hellsing VI
episodes.overview: The Vatican's formidable combat unit is mobilized in preparation for battle. Back in the heart of London, the Hellsing Mansion is attacked, and the Wild Geese represent the last line of defense against the undead.

episodes.title: Hellsing V
episodes.overview: While Arucard is trapped aboard an aircraft carrier, London is plagued by a gruesome vampire onslaught. Elsewhere, Integra narrowly escapes a hoard of Nazi vampires

episodes.title: Hellsing IV
episodes.overview: An important meeting between Hellsing and the Queen is interrupted by tidings of impending war. Meanwhile, Arucard is sent to deal with the deviants responsible for the hijacking of an aircraft carrier.<

episodes.title: Hellsing III
episodes.overview: The Hellsing organization resorts to the recruitment of mercenaries in the wake of a devastating attack on headquarters, and Integra's suspicions concerning the origins of their enemy are confirmed.

episodes.title: Hellsing II
episodes.overview: Two daring vampire brothers lead a violent raid on the Hellsing compound. The carnage is great, but Arucard and company manage to gain a key piece of information while turning the battle's tide.

episodes.title: Hellsing I
episodes.overview: During a mission to eradicate a vampire priest and his minions, Arucard is forced into a difficult decision upon encountering an injured police woman. Later, Father Alexander Anderson and Arucard clash for the first time..

title: Hellsing: The Dawn
overview: Hellsing agents Alucard and young Walter, the resourceful Hellsing family butler, are sent to Nazi-occupied Europe in 1944 to stop the Nazis' attempt to create a vampire army.

title: Kaala Paani
overview: Set in the near future, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are quarantined from the rest of the world as a mystery disease engulfs them, prompting the islanders to attempt an unprecedented feat in human history - escaping the Kaala Paani.

episodes.title: Darwin's Bay
episodes.overview: While thousands prepare to evacuate the island, Qadri faces an unprecedented dilemma and a harrowing question: Is one life worth more than another?

episodes.title: Forefathers
episodes.overview: After making a startling discovery, Ritu faces immense pressure to navigate a potential cure — but can she outrun her past?

episodes.title: The Immortal Being
episodes.overview: Rage consumes a grieving Chiranjeevi — only for him to uncover a shocking link to an Indigenous tribe. Ritu and Ketan team up to find a rare plant.

episodes.title: Eraba Reta Mono
episodes.overview: Jyotsna and the kids search for an isolated bunker and a reclusive older man with crucial supplies. Ketan recounts the reason behind his transfer.

episodes.title: Garjen
episodes.overview: With the islands under lockdown, Santosh works relentlessly to reunite with his children, while an ailing Gargi ponders her role as their guardian.

episodes.title: The Switch
episodes.overview: As a crisis unfolds, Lt. Gen. Qadri takes crucial steps — but fails to alert the public. Jyotsna struggles to escape her traumatic past.

episodes.title: Nature Wins
episodes.overview: Dr. Soudamini Singh investigates the source of a mysterious illness in the region as a massive festival brings thousands of tourists to Port Blair.

title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress
overview: In the midst of an industrial revolution, the people of Hinomoto fight hordes of undead creatures, known as Kabane, using powerful armored trains.

episodes.title: Iron Fortress
episodes.overview: Ikoma tries to rescue Mumei and Ayame tries to rescue her people, but lord Biba has other plans.

episodes.title: Burning Life
episodes.overview: Biba, Mumei and Ayame arrive at Kongokaku in the Kotetsujyo. Ikoma feels down, but soon learns something that gives hope.

episodes.title: The Attacking Weak
episodes.overview: The iron fortress rumbles on to Kongokaku while Ayame agrees with Biba for lack of better options. Mumei learns more about her brothers intentions and Ikoma schemes.

episodes.title: Fangs of Destruction
episodes.overview: Iwato station, the last stop before Kongokaku, refuses the Hunters' Kokujo to enter. But lord Biba is allowed a meeting, during which Biba shows his true colors and with some "help" from Horobi makes a move. Mumei is distraught when she finds out whats been going on.

episodes.title: The Silent Hunter
episodes.overview: When Shitori station is attacked the Hayajiro Kokujou arrives with the hunter squad. It is an elite team that hunts Kabane and is led by lord Amatori Biba.

episodes.title: Begging the Heavens
episodes.overview: The Kotetsujyo reaches Shitori station. Luckily it's still unharmed, this means the crew can stock up on supplies and spend some well earned leisure time.

episodes.title: Gathering Light
episodes.overview: The crew of the Kotetsujyo explores options to leave Yashiro station, whilst Mumei and Ikoma need to find a way out of their own predicament. Both need to worry about the Black Smoke.

episodes.title: Inescapable Darkness
episodes.overview: As the Kotetsujyo nears Yashiro station it becomes obvious it has suffered a major attack recently. Mumei meets with an old aquaintance which puts her in an odd mood. The growing food shortage forces the group to take risks in in order to advance.

episodes.title: Flowing Blood
episodes.overview: After the killing of the pregnant kabane by Mumei, the people of the Kotetsujyo are more than ever mistrustful of the kabaneri. A new kind of enemy provides an opportunity for kabeneri and "kabaneri-friends".

episodes.title: Prayer Offer
episodes.overview: Having escaped Kenkin Station, the Kotetsujyo heads for Kongokaku, the Shogunate's fortress. However, the people on the Kotetsujyo quickly turn against Ikoma and Mumei and attempt to drive them off the train. Having been thrown into her leadership position, Ayame lacks the power to subdue them...

episodes.title: Never-ending Darkness
episodes.overview: Ikoma somehow survives and heads towards the last Hayajiro left in Kenkin Station, the Kotetsujyo. Meanwhile, Ayame and her people were left behind to fend off the Kabane when a young girl named Mumei appears before them. The girl clears open a path to the Kotetsujyo with incredible combat prowess.

episodes.title: Frightened Corpse
episodes.overview: As the Kabane attack Aragane station, Ikoma flees to his home, lures a Kabane into the house and successfully kills it with his bolt gun, but doesnt get away wholly.

title: Loki
overview: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: The clock is ticking in the season finale which finds Loki and Sylvie on a date with destiny.

episodes.title: Science/Fiction
episodes.overview: Loki traverses dying timelines in attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

episodes.title: Heart of the TVA
episodes.overview: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone's favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

episodes.title: Breaking Brad
episodes.overview: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.overview: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

episodes.title: For All Time. Always.
episodes.overview: Loki and Sylvie arrive the Citadel at the End of Time. Will they finally discover who is behind the Time Variance Authority?

episodes.title: Journey Into Mystery
episodes.overview: Upon discovering the Time Keepers aren't real, Judge Renslayer prunes Loki with the Time Stick. Now in an unknown land surrounded by variant Lokis, they urge him to follow them. Meanwhile, turning on the judge, Sylvie demands to be told everything about the TVA.

episodes.title: The Nexus Event
episodes.overview: Loki and Sylvie find their way off the Lamentis-1 mere moments before complete annihilation. Now, the question on everyone's mind, especially those in charge of the TVA — how did these two variants create a Nexus Event in the face of an apocalypse?

episodes.title: Lamentis
episodes.overview: Loki finds himself trapped in an apocalypse with a dead TemPad and the last person he wants by his side: the Loki Variant, Sylvie. Now the two must find their way off of the doomed moon before complete annihilation.

episodes.title: The Variant
episodes.overview: Mobius puts Loki to work investigating The Variant, but not everyone at the TVA is thrilled to be working alongside The God of Mischief.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: Loki, the God of Mischief, finds himself out of time and in an unusual place and forced — against his godly disposition — to cooperate with others. Welcome to the TVA, y'all!

title: Love, Death & Robots
overview: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.

episodes.title: For He Can Creep
episodes.overview: London, 1757. A poet confined to an insane asylum believes Satan wants him to write a verse that will end the world. And the only thing standing between him and the Prince of Darkness is his cat, Jeoffry.

episodes.title: Smart Appliances Stupid Owners
episodes.overview: From an angry toothbrush to an overworked smart shower head and an intelligent toilet, various household appliances divulge tales of bemusement, scorn, and wonder about their human owners.

episodes.title: How Zeke Got Religion
episodes.overview: B-17 Flying Fortress Liberty Belle has the oddest mission of World War Two: a journey into occupied France to bomb a church before the Nazis can raise an ancient evil.

episodes.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
episodes.overview: On a space station orbiting Jupiter, decadent aristocrats gather to witness a brutal contest of genetically modified gladiators — fierce combatants riding deadly, engineered dinosaurs.

episodes.title: Golgotha
episodes.overview: A conscientious vicar plays host to an emissary of an alien race who believes their messiah has been reborn on earth… as a dolphin.

episodes.title: The Other Large Thing
episodes.overview: The story of a cat who plans world domination. Sanchez, as his puny human "pets" know him, is helped by a new robotic butler who can hack into the World Wide Web and is eager to help his new master.

episodes.title: 400 Boys
episodes.overview: In a post-apocalyptic city where warring gangs follow a bushido-like code of honor, a new gang, the 400 Boys, forces them to unite.

episodes.title: Spider Rose
episodes.overview: On a remote asteroid mining operation, a grieving Mechanist gets a new companion and has a chance to avenge herself against the Shaper assassin who killed her husband.

episodes.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
episodes.overview: Tiny terror is unleashed in this mini alien apocalypse using tilt-shift techniques that make the end of the world look almost cute.

episodes.title: Can't Stop
episodes.overview: A unique take on the Red Hot Chili Peppers' legendary 2003 performance at Slane Castle, Ireland, with band members Anthony Kiedis, Flea, Chad Smith, and John Frusciante recreated as string-puppets.

episodes.title: Jibaro
episodes.overview: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

episodes.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed
episodes.overview: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

episodes.title: Mason's Rats
episodes.overview: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

episodes.title: Swarm
episodes.overview: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

episodes.title: Kill Team Kill
episodes.overview: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

episodes.title: Night of the Mini Dead
episodes.overview: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It's the cutest apocalypse you'll ever see.

episodes.title: The Very Pulse of the Machine
episodes.overview: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

episodes.title: Bad Travelling
episodes.overview: Release the Thanapod! A ship's crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

episodes.title: Three Robots: Exit Strategies
episodes.overview: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

episodes.title: The Drowned Giant
episodes.overview: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

episodes.title: Life Hutch
episodes.overview: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

episodes.title: All Through the House
episodes.overview: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

episodes.title: The Tall Grass
episodes.overview: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

episodes.title: Snow in the Desert
episodes.overview: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

episodes.title: Pop Squad
episodes.overview: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

episodes.title: Ice
episodes.overview: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

episodes.title: Automated Customer Service
episodes.overview: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

episodes.title: The Secret War
episodes.overview: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

episodes.title: Alternate Histories
episodes.overview: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

episodes.title: Ice Age
episodes.overview: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

episodes.title: Blindspot
episodes.overview: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

episodes.title: Zima Blue
episodes.overview: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

episodes.title: Lucky 13
episodes.overview: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

episodes.title: Fish Night
episodes.overview: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

episodes.title: Helping Hand
episodes.overview: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

episodes.title: Shape-Shifters
episodes.overview: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

episodes.title: The Dump
episodes.overview: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

episodes.title: Good Hunting
episodes.overview: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

episodes.title: Beyond the Aquila Rift
episodes.overview: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

episodes.title: When the Yogurt Took Over
episodes.overview: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

episodes.title: Sucker of Souls
episodes.overview: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

episodes.title: Suits
episodes.overview: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

episodes.title: The Witness
episodes.overview: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

episodes.title: Three Robots
episodes.overview: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

episodes.title: Sonnie's Edge
episodes.overview: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

title: Lycoris Recoil
overview: A spirited secret agent and her aloof colleague work in an unassuming, charming cafe while happily helping their customers' out in any way they can.

episodes.title: Recoil of Lycoris
episodes.overview: Majima challenges Chisato to a one-on-one fight.

episodes.title: Nature versus nurture
episodes.overview: Chisato is dragged into a fight against Majima at the old radio tower.

episodes.title: Diamond cut diamond
episodes.overview: The Lycoris of DA stormed the Enkuboku to stop Majima.

episodes.title: Repay evil with evil
episodes.overview: Chisato breaks the news that she will shut down Cafe LycoReco so that Mizuki and Kurumi do not get caught up in her personal affairs.

episodes.title: What's done is done
episodes.overview: Chisato's artificial heart is targeted.

episodes.title: Another day, another dollar
episodes.overview: Cafe LycoReco is in the red after their budgets nears bankruptcy; Takina decides to take charge  of accounting on her own.

episodes.title: Time will tell

episodes.overview: LycoReco received a request from the top hacker, Walnut. He wants help fleeing the country from other hackers in the same business who are all after his head. The members of LycoReco work together to help Walnut escape, but a violent group of armed assailants attacks Chisato and the others…!?

episodes.title: Easy does it
episodes.overview: Takina Inoue, a secret agent who protects the security of Japan called a "Lycoris," is ordered to transfer to the café LycoReco in consequence of a certain incident. Takina is enthusiastic about returning to DA now that she's buddied up with the super-elite No. 1 Lycoris (?) Chisato, but her job at LycoReco is just one weird thing after another!?

title: Marvel's The Punisher
overview: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

episodes.title: The Whirlwind
episodes.overview: When Pilgrim abducts Amy and demands David's return, Pilgrim and Frank meet in final combat.

episodes.title: Collision Course
episodes.overview: Mahoney takes Frank for a ride, Pilgrim pays Curtis and Amy a visit, and Krista takes a fall for Billy.

episodes.title: The Abyss
episodes.overview: While Frank lies in custody, Dinah teams up with Karen Page to find out what really happened at the warehouse.

episodes.title: The Dark Hearts of Men
episodes.overview: Frank goes after Billy, and Curtis and Pilgrim both end up with blood on their hands. Krista and Dinah talk about hells, and Krista realizes how Billy can break Frank.

episodes.title: Flustercluck
episodes.overview: Following Anderson's orders, Pilgrim puts a bounty on Frank and Amy's head. Amy turns to a friend for help, while Frank continues looking for Billy... who is paying a visit to Dinah.

episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.overview: Billy starts to remember the past after his encounter with Frank, and then makes an offer to the Boys. Curtis meets Amy for supper, and Frank pays a visit to his wife's grave.

episodes.title: One Bad Day
episodes.overview: Frank and Curtis close in on Billy, who is preparing for his first robbery.

episodes.title: Nakazat
episodes.overview: Once Frank and Amy develop the photos, Frank goes after Poloznev. Billy goes after Curtis, and Mahoney goes after Dinay.

episodes.title: One-Eyed Jacks
episodes.overview: Frank sets out to find out more about Konchevsky, and uses Turk Barrett as bait. Billy makes a new friend, and Krista goes to the window.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.overview: Frank and Billy both visit some old associates, while Amy remembers some of the circumstances that put her on the run from Pilgrim.

episodes.title: Trouble the Water
episodes.overview: Pilgrim and his men launch an attack on the station to get Frank, and Frank tries to convince Sheriff Hardin to let him help.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.overview: Frank and Amy end up in a motel room together, but the people after Amy get information on Frank from Beth and come after him. Meanwhile, Dinah pays Billy another visit in the hospital.

episodes.title: Roadhouse Blues
episodes.overview: Frank stops at a roadhouse and makes a new friend, and soon gets involved in trouble when thugs come after a young girl who may or may not want his protection.

episodes.title: Memento Mori
episodes.overview: Billy escapes capture and takes hostages to force Frank to come to him for a final showdown.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.overview: Frank gives Dinah what she wants, and she learns that he murdered her former partner. Meanwhile, Micro and Frank make a deal to get Sarah and Zach back, but one of them is killed in the process.

episodes.title: Danger Close
episodes.overview: Billy captures Sarah and Zach, and sends a squad of mercenaries to the power station. Frank is waiting. Meanwhile, Dinah meets with Billy and then Marion.

episodes.title: Virtue of the Vicious
episodes.overview: Lewis goes after Ori and Frank tries to stop him. Afterward, Detective Sergeant Mahoney tries to piece together what happened. Meanwhile, Dinah tells Hernandez what really happened that got Sam and the others killed.

episodes.title: Front Toward Enemy
episodes.overview: Lewis declares war on the government and anyone who supports it, and sends his manifesto to Karen. Meanwhile, Dinah considers what to say at Sam's service, or whether she should say anything at all.

episodes.title: Cold Steel
episodes.overview: After paying his mother a visit, Billy tells Dinah about his childhood. Meanwhile, Dinah sets a trap for the person who has bugged her office, while Micro and Frank discuss strategy.

episodes.title: Crosshairs
episodes.overview: Clay tries to give his son Lewis some advice. Meanwhile, Frank attacks Bennett but it's a ruse to get Bennett to lead them to Agent Orange.

episodes.title: The Judas Goat
episodes.overview: After Frank is injured, Micro turns to Curtis for help. Meanwhile, Dinah asks Billy if he knows that Frank is alive, and Lewis learns where O'Connor served.

episodes.title: Gunner
episodes.overview: Frank and Micro track down Gunner, and Frank goes to see his old friend and learn if he knows who Agent Orange is. Meanwhile, Dinah lies under oath to cover up Frank's involvement,and Karen reaches out to Frank after Dinah interviews her.

episodes.title: Resupply
episodes.overview: Frank goes after arms dealers, and discovers that Dinah and her team are after them as well. Meanwhile, Sarah gets a return visit from Frank, and Dinah gets a visit from her mentor.

episodes.title: Kandahar
episodes.overview: While Frank questions Micro about his intentions, he remembers what happened in Kandahar as part of Operation Cerberus.

episodes.title: Two Dead Men
episodes.overview: The elusive whistleblower known as Micro contacts Frank, who tracks Micro back to the family that believes he's dead. Meanwhile, Karen does some research for Frank, and Dinah goes on a date with Billy Russo.

episodes.title: 3AM
episodes.overview: After he apparently dies, Frank tries to live peacefully but events overtake him. Meanwhile, an ICE agent tries to track down a U.S. military heroin ring.

title: Mob Psycho 100
overview: Shigeo Kageyama, a.k.a. "Mob," is a boy who has trouble expressing himself, but who happens to be a powerful esper. Mob is determined to live a normal life and keeps his ESP suppressed, but when his emotions surge to a level of 100%, something terrible happens to him! As he's surrounded by false espers, evil spirits, and mysterious organizations, what will Mob think? What choices will he make?

episodes.title: Confession ~The Future~
episodes.overview: Mob continues down his path of destruction. Amongst all of the destruction and chaos, Reigen finally reaches Mob with the help of Serizawa, and he desperately tries to talk to him.

episodes.title: Mob 3 ~Trauma~
episodes.overview: Mob continues to walk to the park where Tsubomi is waiting as he destroys everything around him, but the former upper echelon members from the Claw, Koyama, Sakuragi, and their boss, Suzuki stand in his way.

episodes.title: Mob 2 ~Rival~
episodes.overview: Mob tries to save a child that is about to be run over by a car and is run over himself. People start to gather but Mob stays silent. Mob wakes up in berserk mode and starts walking, destroying the street and the buildings nearby.

episodes.title: Mob 1 ~Moving~
episodes.overview: After winter break is over, Mob is hit with shocking news. Tsubomi is actually going to transfer within the next month. As many other boys profess their feelings to Tsubomi and ask her out.

episodes.title: Transmission 2 ~Encountering the Unknown~
episodes.overview: The group somehow finally makes it to the summit of Mt. Mudboat. Takenaka had been up all night reading all the texts about UFOS and the Telepathy Club comes together to send a telepathic message into Space.

episodes.title: Transmission 1 ~Winter Break~
episodes.overview: Kurata Tome has always dreamed about communicating with the universe through telepathy, and now, her high school graduation was drawing nearer. When they are about to start winter break.

episodes.title: Divine Tree 3 ~Dimple Is~
episodes.overview: Mob's attitude seems to change once he hears what Dimple says. Mob apologizes to Dimple for getting carried away with the thought of being popular and for not hearing what Dimple had been trying to tell him.

episodes.title: Divine Tree 2 ~Peace~
episodes.overview: Mob heads into the Divine Tree, only to have to face off with Teru. Mob finds himself speechless, having to confront even Teru who has been completely brainwashed by Psycho Helmet.

episodes.title: Divine Tree 1 ~The Founder Appears~
episodes.overview: After Psycho Helmet's appearance, tree roots start emerging all around the city. Sensing danger, Mob goes with Reigen and Ritsu to destroy the Divine Tree, but eventually, they are overwhelmed by the members of the Psycho Helmet.

episodes.title: Getting Carried Away ~100%~
episodes.overview: Mob is in a great mood because he got to talk to Tsubomi for the first time in a while. As he's walking through town, he feels the stares of other girls... Mob gets a little carried away and believes that his time has finally arrived.

episodes.title: Yokai Hunter Amakusa Haruaki Appears! ~The Threat of a Hundred Demons!!~
episodes.overview: Mob is very busy preparing for the cultural fair that's coming up in two weeks. Meanwhile, Serizawa is trying to start over, and is thinking about going to night school. That is when a self-proclaimed yokai hunter arrives.

episodes.title: Future ~Career Paths~
episodes.overview: A giant broccoli known as the Divine Tree looks down upon Seasoning City. It's time to fill out career path surveys at Salt Middle School and most students are excited about their hopes and dreams.

episodes.title: Boss Fight ~The Final Light~
episodes.overview: The conclusion of the final fight and the start and reinvigoration of numerous relationships.

episodes.title: Battle for Social Rehabilitation ~Friendship~
episodes.overview: Three years ago, Serizawa was troubled with about his psychic powers. One day, he was visited by the boss, Suzuki Toichiro. Serizawa ends up trusting him since he's the first person to understand what he's going through.

episodes.title: Guidance ~Psychic Sensor~
episodes.overview: The total offensive of the psychics who want to defeat Claw has begun, but the Supercives are really powerful and will give them more than one problem.

episodes.title: Collision ~Power Type~
episodes.overview: The boss of the Claw, Suzuki Toichiro barricades himself into Seasoning City Culture Tower after declaring war on the world. After instantly getting rid of the police barriers, they make their next move.

episodes.title: Show Me What You've Got ~Band Together~
episodes.overview: While The Claw makes their schemes public, Reigen forms a defense team.

episodes.title: Even Then ~Continue Forward~
episodes.overview: The day for the annual marathon and Salt Middle School was drawing nearer. Mob proclaims that if he places in the top 10 he'll tell Tsubomi how he feels about her. Everyone around him cheers Mob on and he starts training hard every day until the day of the event. Meanwhile, Tsubomi and her friend Miki go to Reigen's Spirits and Such Consultation Office with a request. Ritsu happened to be at the office, helping out in Mob's absence, but he hears Tsubomi say something rather surprising.

episodes.title: Cornered ~True Identity~
episodes.overview: After splitting up with Mob, Reigen starts doing a lot of the jobs on his own. He then gets an offer to appear on a TV program. Reigen is ecstatic and accepts the offer, but this was all a trap set by Jodo Kirin, the president of the Rising Sun Spiritual Union. Jodo corners him during the live filming of the show and the fact that Reigen is a fraud comes to light. Reigen gets bashed from all sides and ends up having to hold a press conference.

episodes.title: Poor, Lonely, Whitey
episodes.overview: Reigen's loneliness pushes him to achieve even more than ever before without Mob after realising he doesn't have any friends.

episodes.title: Discord ~Choices~
episodes.overview: Mob gets trapped inside a parallel world created by Mogami Keiji. Minori ends up transferring to his class, and Mob becomes the target of bullying. He can't ask anyone for help, and his negative emotions start to build inside. The truth behind the tragedy that Mogami went through when he was alive comes to light. Meanwhile, Reigen and the others were waiting for Mob to regain consciousness back at the Asagiri mansion. Dimple attempts to save Mob by infiltrating Minori's body.

episodes.title: Inside ~Evil Spirit~
episodes.overview: Reigen and Mob receive a new job. This time, their client is a wealthy man named Asagiri Masashi. He's not just rich, but super rich, so Reigen and Mob head to his mansion only to find other self-proclaimed psychics there as well. One of the psychics there happens to include the president of the Rising Sun Spiritual Union, Jodo Kirin. The job is apparently to exorcise the evil spirit that is apparently possessing his daughter, Minori.

episodes.title: One Danger After Another ~Degeneration~
episodes.overview: Reigen sets up an official homepage for his Spirits and Such Consultation Office and he immediately starts to get jobs left and right, including a middle-aged man asking Reigen to curse someone and a woman who's being haunted by a ghost. As he was listening to their problems, Mob realizes something. Why do people treat humans and spirits so differently? Meanwhile, Reigen gets another request from a group of college students that want to take a photo at a haunted location, but.

episodes.title: Urban Legends ~Encountering Rumors~
episodes.overview: Reigen looks for new ways to get some money and decides that urban legends are what will take him out of poverty once and for all.

episodes.title: Ripped Apart ~Someone Is Watching~
episodes.overview: Mob is still trying to lead an ordinary daily life, but the people around him do not allow it and try to get him out of his comfort zone with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Mob and Reigen
episodes.overview: Mob is finally pushed to his limit when he has to face Sakurai, Muraki, Matsuo and Ishiguro of the upper echelon. But then, he comes to a rather surprising decision...

episodes.title: Master ~Leader~
episodes.overview: Mob, Ritsu, and Teru are trapped in a room where they can't use their powers. And then, someone rather unexpected shows up in front of them: Mob's master and self-proclaimed psychic, Reigen.

episodes.title: The Heinous Aura ~Mastermind~
episodes.overview: Mob and Teru infiltrate the Claw's 7th Division to save Ritsu. Meanwhile, Ritsu tries to escape with the other esper kids and they run into the upper echelon and leader of the 7th Division. Teru and Dimple run into trouble after a strenuous battle, and the boss from Claw finally shows himself...

episodes.title: Claw ~7th Division~
episodes.overview: Mob and Teru leave to rescue the kidnapped kids from Claw as Ritsu and the others try to escape on their own.

episodes.title: The Older Brother Bows ~Destructive Intent~
episodes.overview: After Ritsu stirs up trouble with his new found psychic powers, a new psychic; Koyoma, is sent by Claw to capture him.

episodes.title: Exaltation ~I've Obtained Loss~
episodes.overview: Ritsu meets Dimple who teaches him how to use his new-found powers as thugs from other schools try to find and beat the one responsible for Hanazawa's defeat.

episodes.title: Discord ~To Become One~
episodes.overview: Peaceful days return after Mob's fight with Teru. As usual, Reigen continues to trick people as a fake psychic, and the president of the Telepathy Club, Kurata Tome, drags Mob around to find other espers. Then one day, a mysterious man talks to Mob's younger brother, Ritsu...

episodes.title: OCHIMUSHA ~Psychic Powers and Me~
episodes.overview: Mob is challenged to a one-on-one fight with Black Vinegar Middle School's shadow leader, Hanazawa Teruki, otherwise known as Teru. Mob doesn't use his powers but Teru goes all out on him, destroying everything around him. Teru continues to unleash his incredible power when Mob suddenly remembers a tragedy that happened between him and Ritsu...

episodes.title: Idiots Only Event ~Kin~
episodes.overview: After the incident with the religious organization (LOL), the evil spirit, Dimple, keeps following Mob around. Also, because of the incident, Mezato Ichi from the school paper starts following around Mob, as well. Then one day, another student joins the Body Improvement Club. Progress Towards Mob's Explosion: 45%

episodes.title: An Invitation to a Meeting ~Simply Put, I Just Want to be Popular~
episodes.overview: It's great that Mob joined the Body Improvement Club, but he suddenly faints as he's running along the riverside. His wish is to get stronger and to be able to get closer to his beloved Tsubomi-chan. One day, as Mob is feeling troubled, a woman with a strange mask approaches him... Progress toward Mob's explosion: 20%

episodes.title: Doubts about Youth ~The Telepathy Club Appears~
episodes.overview: The Telepathy Club is told that they are going to be shut down by the student council due to lack of members. It was then that one of the members, Inukawa, thought of possibly getting Mob to join. However, Mob gets a call from Reigen about taking care of an incident at Highso Girls' Academy...

episodes.title: Self-Proclaimed Psychic: Reigen Arataka ~And Mob~
episodes.overview: Psychics fight with supernatural phenomena that cannot be explained by science. Reigen Arataka that runs the Spirits and Such Consultation office is one of those psychics... well, a fake one. His only hope is a super dull middle-schooler named Kageyama Shigeo, a.k.a. Mob. 27% towards Mob's explosion.

title: Mohanagar
overview: One fateful night, a police station in Bangladesh, and a motley crowd consisting of criminals, an eminent industrialist, media, general public. What does this night have in store for them?

episodes.title: Bina Meghey Bawjropat
episodes.overview: Harun hits the bull's eye by playing his ace move to outsmart the DB officers. However, the arrival of a new player in the capital puts Harun in mortal peril.

episodes.title: Poya Baro
episodes.overview: Harun recalls his last face-off with Masum. He gets baffled to see someone who has known it all since their Shakaripur days.

episodes.title: Damadol
episodes.overview: Harun plays his trump card and eradicates Afnan's master plan. In the meantime, the DB officers get closer to the reality of what happened with Masum after he went missing from custody.

episodes.title: Shankher Kawrat
episodes.overview: Old sins cast long shadows. As Afnan stumbles upon a close confidant of Harun by design, the common motive of Harun and Afnan starts coming to the fore.

episodes.title: Koto Dhaney Koto Chal
episodes.overview: Harun and Afnan are like two peas in a pod when it comes to their wits. While the DB officers are desperate to find a loophole in Harun's judgment in Masum's case, Afnan eagerly tries to know Harun's next move.

episodes.title: Gur Khonja
episodes.overview: As flashbacks of the aftermath of the bombing incident keep haunting Harun, he begins to sink into the quicksand. Masum waits to face dire consequences.

episodes.title: Dumurer Phool
episodes.overview: It's a roll of the dice as Afnan desperately tries to get hold of Zara, and OC Harun tries to get away from the DB officers.

episodes.title: Gokuler Shannr
episodes.overview: The cat gets out of the bag as the DB officers question Harun about an old bombing incident at a government rally and his hush-hush investigation.

episodes.title: Kenche Gondush
episodes.overview: While Afnan Chowdhury gets bail, Detective Branch gets hold of OC Harun. A dirty secret from Harun's past term at the Shakaripur police station threatens to rear its ugly head.

episodes.title: Kistimaat
episodes.overview: A twist bemuses everyone in the police station. How would OC Harun manage to get Afnan Chowdhury out of this mess?

episodes.title: Goray Golod
episodes.overview: Man proposes, God disposes. But isn't OC Harun smart enough to outsmart God's plan?

episodes.title: Andher Joshthi
episodes.overview: Things have turned out to be a David vs Goliath fight. Would Sub inspector Moloy play the David of the night?

episodes.title: Amabashyar Chaand
episodes.overview: Money talks and when OC Harun gets hold of it, it starts singing. What is Harun's plan for now?

episodes.title: Golar Kaanta
episodes.overview: A starlet from the film industry arrives at the police station. Why does she come late at night? Do the duty officers escape her charm?

episodes.title: Shape Bor
episodes.overview: Things become complicated when Assistant Commissioner Shahana Huda takes charge of the case. How would OC Harun tackle the situation now?

episodes.title: Chiching Faank
episodes.overview: One accident with a number of interpretations. How would Officer in Charge Harun and Sub inspector Moloy react to it?

episodes.title: Ishaner Megh
episodes.overview: Officer in Charge Harun and Sub inspector Moloy Kumar go for a final round up in the capital at night. Little do they know what is waiting for them in the police station.

title: Money Heist
overview: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

episodes.title: Una tradición familiar
episodes.overview: With multiple lives on the line and Spain's economy at stake, the Professor and Tamayo engage in one final showdown.

episodes.title: Lo que se habla en la cama
episodes.overview: The Professor is left reeling after his tactics are used against him, and when it seems like all hope is lost, he makes a bold decision.

episodes.title: La teoría de la elegancia
episodes.overview: Tamayo hunts for the gold as the team races against the clock. Mónica worries she's having a psychotic break. Years earlier, Berlin is deceived.

episodes.title: Ciencia ilusionada
episodes.overview: Tamayo mounts a manhunt in his neighborhood as his foes hide. In the past, Berlin and Palermo explain how they plan on getting the gold out of the bank.

episodes.title: Válvulas de escape
episodes.overview: Sierra takes advantage of the Professor's grief and gains the upper hand. Meanwhile, the team deals with the emotional fallout of their dead friend.

episodes.title: Vivir muchas vidas
episodes.overview: While surrounded by gunfire and trapped in the kitchen, Tokyo reminisces about her first love and her initial encounter with the Professor.

episodes.title: Tu sitio en el cielo
episodes.overview: With Helsinki's life in danger, the thieves mount a covert counter attack. Years earlier, Berlin and his son conduct their first heist together.

episodes.title: El espectáculo de la vida
episodes.overview: A betrayal and an emergency both catch Sierra by surprise. Palermo rallies the troops as the army closes in on the gang.

episodes.title: ¿Crees en la reencarnación?
episodes.overview: Arturo seizes an opportunity to fight back while escalating a personal vengeance. Lisbon makes a crucial discovery.

episodes.title: El final del camino
episodes.overview: The Professor faces off with Sierra as Tamayo raises the stakes of the negotiations by calling the army. In the past, Berlin meets with a family member.

episodes.title: Plan París
episodes.overview: The Professor, Benjamin and the others attempt to free Lisboa. Tokyo's anger threatens her faith in the plan. Sierra takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Tumbar la carpa
episodes.overview: The group reels following the attack on one of their own. The Professor puts his adjusted plan in motion with the help of new recruits and Palermo.

episodes.title: KO técnico
episodes.overview: With Nairobi held hostage, Gandía negotiates with the crew. The Professor desperately seeks a new plan to save his team.

episodes.title: 5 minutos antes
episodes.overview: Denver turns to an undercover source for help. Nairobi attempts to motivate her team as the danger around them intensifies.

episodes.title: Suspiros de España
episodes.overview: In the past, Berlin predicts that Gandía will cause problems for the operation. Sierra's interrogation of Lisboa leads to a personal revelation.

episodes.title: Lección de anatomía
episodes.overview: The Professor's mole attempts to pass along his message to the person inside the tent. Denver's jealousy toward Mónica and Rio's friendship heightens.

episodes.title: La boda de Berlín
episodes.overview: Palermo shocks the group with his actions. Sierra pressures her subject to take a deal. The Professor remembers his brother's wedding.

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.overview: Anger and grief heighten tensions between the group. The Professor, while in mourning, attempts to make a daring and dangerous escape.

episodes.title: La deriva
episodes.overview: Tokyo attempts to drown her sorrows. Sierra uses personal tactics to target a vulnerable Nairobi, while Suárez continues to hunt down Raquel.

episodes.title: Pequeñas vacaciones
episodes.overview: Tokyo's happiness turns bittersweet. Ángel closes in on a quarreling Raquel and the Professor. Authorities offer a multimillion-dollar reward for tips.

episodes.title: Todo pareció insignificante
episodes.overview: Just as Inspector Sierra orchestrates a plan to sneak a team into the Bank of Spain, the Professor and Raquel lose communication with Palermo.

title: Mr. Robot
overview: A young programmer, Elliot, suffers from a debilitating anti-social disorder and decides that he can only connect to people by hacking them. He wields his skills as a weapon to protect the people that he cares about. Elliot finds himself in the intersection between a cybersecurity firm he works for and the underworld organizations that are recruiting him to bring down corporate America.

episodes.title: Hello, Elliot
episodes.overview: It's finally time to learn the truth, friend. Elliot hides the alternate Elliot's body in a storage container, intent on taking the alternate Elliot's place and marrying Angela. A police officer, Dominique, attempts to arrest Elliot after she discovers the alternate Elliot's body. Elliot escapes to Coney Island, where he discovers that there was no wedding. Mr. Robot explains to Elliot that the world they are in is not the parallel world Whiterose spoke of, but rather an illusion created by Elliot, with the intention of keeping "the real Elliot" trapped. Bewildered and confused, Elliot wakes up in Krista's office. Krista (who is a manifestation of Elliot's mind at this point) explains that the Elliot we have known since the beginning of the series is not the real Elliot, but a persona called "The Mastermind" that the real Elliot created to deal with his rage and anger at the world. However, this persona decided to take over and trapped the real Elliot in the Utopian world, getting rid of Darlene, who is the real Elliot's strongest connection to reality, and Krista explains that the Mastermind must give control back to the real Elliot, but he refuses as the world collapses. The Mastermind wakes up in the hospital, where Darlene reveals that Whiterose is dead, her machine is destroyed, and that she knew that the Mastermind had taken over. Accepting his identity, the Mastermind returns to Elliot's mind with the rest of his other personas. The real Elliot wakes up in the hospital and is greeted by Darlene.

episodes.title: whoami
episodes.overview: Nothing is as it appears in our new world. Elliot wakes up in an abandoned lot following the explosion at the Washington Township plant, which is no longer there. He discovers the town is a thriving suburbia, where his mother and father, both alive, live. He finds out that his parents never abused him as a child, and that Darlene does not exist. He returns to the city, where he encounters Angela's parents, Emily and Phillip (the latter still being in Angela's life), who reveal to him that Elliot is marrying Angela the following day. He goes to the alternate Elliot's apartment and hacks his computer, discovering a hidden drive of sketches of himself, Darlene, and the rest of fsociety. The alternate Elliot returns home to find the original Elliot at his iMac (as depicted at the end of the previous episode). Initially alarmed, the alternate Elliot explains that the sketches are of a persona he created that would lead an exciting life as a vigilante hacker, the very life the original Elliot lives. They touch, causing another earthquake, which severely injures the alternate Elliot. Alternate Elliot gets a call from Angela; hearing her for the first time since her death, the original Elliot decides that he can have the life he always wanted, and kills the alternate Elliot.

episodes.title: eXit
episodes.overview: Enough is enough. Elliot goes to the Washington Township power plant. Whiterose's men kill the FBI agents sent for Zhang, as she proclaims there is only Whiterose now. Elliot finds the Washington Township nuclear plant seemingly deserted. He activates his hack to destroy Whiterose's machine, but is found by Dark Army agents, who lead him past the slaughtered employees to Whiterose. They argue about the nature of people, hatred and the world. Whiterose claims her machine will create a better world. Elliot says those who love him, even when he hates himself, make the world worth saving. Whiterose has already activated the machine, triggering a meltdown. She says Elliot has a choice, and kills herself. Elliot plays an adventure game Whiterose left for him on an old computer, thinking he can stop the meltdown; but seems to be too late. He and Mr. Robot express their love for each other as everything turns red. In an alternate world, Elliot is upbeat and happy, CEO of AllSafe, engaged to Angela, and an only child, with a loving relationship with his still-living father. Zhi Zhang is a beloved, wealthy woman known for her philanthropy. Elliot lands a major account with F Corp after saying he'll always stand with Tyrell, who is F Corp's CEO. Elliot returns home, surprised to see Elliot in a hoodie, whom he doesn't recognize, sitting at his computer.

episodes.title: 410 Gone
episodes.overview: Following the Deus Group hack, Zhang's identity as Whiterose has become public. Dominique has mostly recovered and leaves the hospital. Under FBI investigation for her actions as a Dark Army agent, she's not allowed to see her family. Darlene convinces her to run away with her and Elliot, to hide from the Dark Army. Elliot departs alone for the Washington Township plant, instead. Leon transports Darlene and Dominique to the airport, giving Dominique advice about living with a new identity. Darlene transfers a substantial portion of the Deus Group's money to everyone with Ecoin accounts, seeing it as justice. Dominique is frightened seeing Irving at the airport bookstore, promoting his new novel. He informs her the Dark Army doesn't care about her or Darlene anymore. Without that threat, Dominique chooses not to fly to Budapest with Darlene, having a job and family to look after. At the gate, Darlene has a panic attack about being alone and flees to a bathroom, missing Dominique who turned back to get on the plane. Darlene steadies herself and is okay on her own, missing the flight. Dominique finally gets some sleep as the plane takes off for her fresh start.

title: Mushi-Shi
overview: Ginko, a Mushi master, travels from place to place researching the Mushi and helping people who are suffering because of it.

episodes.title: Tree of Eternity
episodes.overview: The one place that has stood the test of time, but humans have come. But the memories aren't lost.

episodes.title: Mud Grass
episodes.overview: Death clings and grows, what should have stayed in the ground has started to creep up.

episodes.title: Lightning's End
episodes.overview: Unanswered hopes and unheard feelings lead one to seek out signs that will guide them forward through the suffocating darkness that not even lightning can illuminate.

episodes.title: Azure Waters
episodes.overview: Thirsting for and beguiled by water, the boy continues to live his life, as though lost or responding to a distant memory from the womb...

episodes.title: Sea of Otherworldly Stars
episodes.overview: A myriad stars adorn a solitary patch of an otherwise pitch-dark sky above her. The girl gazes upon the eerie sky and familiar light.

episodes.title: Thread of Light
episodes.overview: A lost boy seeks solace, but the skies only offer a glimpse of unattainable affection. Man is capable of becoming attuned to what lies outside of the five senses--the brilliance of life, the light that shines from within.

episodes.title: Hidden Cove
episodes.overview: There are channels that exist in this world unbeknownst to man. At times, man can send their thoughts to traverse these paths at will to another and share the same thoughts.

episodes.title: Lingering Crimson
episodes.overview: Dusk--an uncertain hour that is neither day nor night. When two long shadows intersect, a darkness awakens from its long slumber.

episodes.title: Fragrant Darkness
episodes.overview: A man feels something vaguely familiar, yet terrifying, as he smells the scent of flowers at night. As an old man, walking through the woods, he finds a tunnel, and is compelled to enter it. While going through it, he reminisces about important events in his life up to that point, but it seems there is something he can't quite recall. Perhaps long ago, the visit of a traveler looking for shelter on a rainy day, might help shed light on the unsettled feeling he has.

episodes.title: Cushion of Grass
episodes.overview: After his encounter with Nui and before becoming a mushishi, young Ginko moved from place to place, due to his condition of attracting mushi. At one point he found himself instructed and cared for by a mushishi named Suguro, in the lands of a dying Mountain Lord. Ginko wonders about his place in the world and the natural order, as Suguro worries that the new Mountain Lord hasn't yet appeared.

episodes.title: Depths of Winter
episodes.overview: A mountain refuses to welcome spring. Snow continues to fall, and animals continue to slumber. It is the will of the mountain lord... as if he, himself, is waiting for death.

episodes.title: Valley of the Welling Tide
episodes.overview: Amidst the wintry snow, a valley is full of green and ripe for harvest. A man toils on without need for slumber, as if to make amends. He works for his family's livelihood, and for his blood legacy...

episodes.title: Wind Raiser
episodes.overview: A ship sails with wind in its sails across the calm seas. A boy able to command the mushi and call the wind must find his own path in order to see the horizon within himself.

episodes.title: Cloudless Rain
episodes.overview: The woman continues her travels as she foretells the coming of rain. With every raindrop that falls from the clear blue skies, she is reminded of her curious fate, one that cannot be washed clean by any amount of tears.

episodes.title: Floral Delusion
episodes.overview: The countless blooms adorning the branches are trees are an enthralling tableau showcasing the beauty of spring. Those who have a neverending desire for such beauty will eventually broach a taboo. For whom do the ephemeral flowers bloom?

episodes.title: Mirror Lake
episodes.overview: Who, or what, is reflected on the surface? When the boundary between the real and unreal collapses, only the self who lives in this world can determine how to continue one's existence.

episodes.title: The Hand That Caresses the Night
episodes.overview: A hunter roams the mountains at night without the tools of his trade. The being that toys with life, and then extinguishes it is a fragile "thing" caught between the realm of man and mushi.

episodes.title: Beneath the Snow
episodes.overview: Snow constantly falls around him. Impervious to the freezing cold, the man is gripped by the searing memory of a winter he had spent together with his little sister.

episodes.title: The Warbling Seashell
episodes.overview: Birdsong is suddenly heard when a sea shell is held up to a girl's ear. In a fishing village still reeling from a tragedy years before, a strange mushi indicates an ill omen. What misfortune will be brought to bear on the people?

episodes.title: Mushi-shi
episodes.overview: Kouki--a stream of light flowing deep underground, the font of all life. When a man ignorant of its effects on the living meddles with it, the mushi-shi must act before there are unintended consequences.

episodes.title: The Sound of Footsteps on the Grass
episodes.overview: On the side of a very special mountain, three young boys will meet, each bound to different paths: Taku of the Mountain, Isazu of the Watari and Ginko of the Mushi?

episodes.title: Eye of Fortune, Eye of Misfortune
episodes.overview: Ginko encounters a wanderer of a different breed, a street musician who sings hauntingly of the mushi.

episodes.title: The Journey to the Field of Fire
episodes.overview: Rumors of a new kind of mushi have brought Ginko out to visit another master, one who's been studying the discovery for some time.

episodes.title: The Sound of Rust
episodes.overview: Ginko's wanderings are driven off course when he comes across a strange sound echoing through the frozen mountains.

episodes.title: Shrine in the Sea
episodes.overview: Ginko travels to an island to investigate the legend of the uminaoshi, people who have died and been reborn.

episodes.title: Cotton Changeling
episodes.overview: Ginko must urge parents of a mushi disguised as a child to put an end to it's short life.

episodes.title: A Sea of Writings
episodes.overview: A family renowned for two things: An exhaustive archive of the records of Mushi Masters and a black birthmark, a curse that's survived through the generations.

episodes.title: String from the Sky
episodes.overview: Ginko finds and returns a young lady residing in the shadow world of the mushi.

episodes.title: Clothes That Embrace the Mountain
episodes.overview: Ginko follows an artisan's flight home, led by a painting alive with mushi.

episodes.title: Picking the Empty Cocoon
episodes.overview: The arcane arrival of a broken message sends Ginko to visit the source, a sad remnant barely clinging to life and desperate hope.

episodes.title: Sunrise Serpent
episodes.overview: Ginko finds in the dark of night a mushi that thrives on memories, its appetite for the things most cherished.

episodes.title: The Pretense of Spring
episodes.overview: Driven to seek shelter from a snowy storm, the Mushi Master Ginko is drawn into a yearly mystery of a boy who hibernates every winter.

episodes.title: Inside the Cage
episodes.overview: Resting in a bamboo forest, Ginko is joined by a man who has been lost within the shadowy confines for several years.

episodes.title: One-Night Bridge
episodes.overview: Ginko travels to a remote village, summoned by a letter of plea.

episodes.title: One-Eyed Fish
episodes.overview: A mountainside tragedy leaves a young boy alone, to be rescued by the Mushi Master Nui.

episodes.title: The Sleeping Mountain
episodes.overview: Ginko is sent in search of another Mushi Master, this one the guardian of a mountain, neighbor to a village.

episodes.title: The White Which Lives Within the Ink Stone
episodes.overview: The doctor friend of Ginko's needs his help. While out on a call, three village children broke into his storage shed and stumbled upon an artifact of deadly consequence: An ink stone.

episodes.title: The Heavy Seed
episodes.overview: In his never ending quest for food, Ginko is sent to a village blessed with abundance in a year of strife.

episodes.title: Where Sea Meets Man
episodes.overview: Ginko's path crosses that of a forsaken soul waiting along the shore, waiting for the young wife lost several years before.

episodes.title: Raindrops & Rainbows
episodes.overview: Forced to seek shelter as temporary reprieve from the rain, Ginko meets a man chasing rainbows out of desperation rather than hope.

episodes.title: Those Who Inhale the Dew
episodes.overview: The Mushi Master Ginko sneaks onto an island all but completely locked away from the world. He has been led there by a young boy who must daily watch his friend die.

episodes.title: The Traveling Swamp
episodes.overview: Trekking across mountains to a seaside village, Ginko finds his fellow hikers unsettling indeed.

episodes.title: The Pillow Pathway
episodes.overview: Ginko travels back to a place he's been before, to check in on a man whose dreams carry portents of the future.

episodes.title: Tender Horns
episodes.overview: Summoned to a remote village, Ginko has traveled into the winter which swallows all sound.

episodes.title: The Light of the Eyelid
episodes.overview: A young girl has been locked away by her family, for fear of a disease without cause or cure. Ginko arrives as loyalty allows the contagion to spread.

episodes.title: The Green Seat
episodes.overview: The Mushi Master Ginko travels deep into the mountains, driven there by rumors of a young boy who possesses a rare gift - The ability to draw forth new forms of life with a simple paint brush.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
overview: At the turn of the century, the Angels returned to Earth, seeking to wipe out humanity in an apocalyptic fury. Devastated, mankind's last remnants moved underground to wait for the day when the Angels would come back to finish the job. Fifteen years later, that day has come... but this time, humanity is ready to fight back with terrifying bio-mechanical weapons known as the Evangelions. Watch as Shinji, Rei, Asuka and the rest of the mysterious shadow agency Nerv battle to save earth from total annihilation.

episodes.title: Take Care of Yourself
episodes.overview: The Human Instrumentality Project continues. Shinji must decide whether to accept a world alone, or embrace connections with others.

episodes.title: Do You Love Me?
episodes.overview: The Human Instrumentality Project begins, and the souls of humanity merge. The Eva pilots confront the nature of their existence as reality dissolves.

episodes.title: The Beginning and the End, or "Knockin' on Heaven's Door"
