As these passions clash with each other in all places of Kyoto, a small, over-looked fire begins to flare up.

episodes.title: The Great Kyoto Fire (Part Two)
episodes.overview: Kenshin and Aoshi engage in a battle on the deck of the ironclad Rengoku. Behind the scenes, Sanosuke manages to board the ship and tries to blow up the engine room with the explosives he got from Tsunan. However, Shishio's underlings Hoji, Shuzo, Toshiro prevent him from going any further. Meanwhile in Kyoto, Arato faces off against Kamatari and Henya alone to buy time for the police forces to evacuate.

episodes.title: The Great Kyoto Fire (Part One)
episodes.overview: It is now midnight. Goichi and the others start moving as it is time to put the Great Kyoto Fire plan into action, when they witness Shishio's other underlings being chased by the police. Henya is annoyed that the fires haven't started on time. Meanwhile, an order is dispatched to the Ten Swords, and they start moving upon hearing their orders. Behind the scenes, Kenshin and the rest arrive at Osaka Bay only to come across something.

episodes.title: As If in Flight
episodes.overview: Kenshin and Hajime realize that Shishio has another objective in mind that lies in Osaka. They meet up with Sanosuke there. To stop the Great Kyoto Fire, Kenshin asks for help from everyone at Aoiya via a letter while leaving Ryusaku Arato, the chief of police, in charge of supervising on the ground in Kyoto. Kenshin, Hajime, and Sanosuke head to Osaka Bay on a carriage after they finish their errands. Then, senior police officer, Hikozaemon Omi brings along Juro Kitazawa, a young 11-year-old boy who says he wants to meet with Arato.

episodes.title: The Other Objective
episodes.overview: Shishio's underlings inconspicuously prepare for their battle plan when patrols arrive causing them to retreat.

episodes.title: The Ten Swords Summoned
episodes.overview: As a result of passing down the ultimate technique, Seijuro endures a fatal wound.

episodes.title: Between Life and Death
episodes.overview: Kenshin undergoes training so that he can learn the ultimate technique. He barely manages to get in a hit against Seijuro in a bout, where he then learns "Kuzuryuusen,"a powerful technique that launches nine slashes at the same time. Kenshin learns to see through Seijuro's swift sword movements and masters "Kuzuryuusen" by looking at it only once. However, the technique was only born out of the process of passing down the ultimate technique, "Amakakeru Ryuu no Hirameki" of Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu.

episodes.title: Misao's Decision
episodes.overview: Aoshi injures Okina, leaves Misao behind, and shows up at Aoiya. He asks the Oniwaban Group where Kenshin is. Aoshi's in a ghastly state, but accepts what Yahiko and Kaoru tell him and decides to wait for Kenshin where Shishio is. Okina is on the verge of death but undergoes treatment by Megumi, who has come rushing to Kyoto.

episodes.title: Aoshi vs. Okina
episodes.overview: Hoji plans an attack of Aoiya at night using a secret unit, the Owl Clan, in order to capture Okina and catch a hint of Kenshin's whereabouts, but instead the Owl Clan were the ones defeated. Okina challenges Aoshi to a battle via a member of the clan whom he sent back to Shishio's location.

episodes.title: Meeting of the Warlords
episodes.overview: Kenshin reunites with Kaoru and the rest at Seijuro Hiko's place, who is a master of Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu. Seijuro learns from Kaoru that Kenshin goes around the country acting as a rurouni who helps people, when he then decides to pass down the last ultimate technique of the Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu.

episodes.title: Seijuro Hiko
episodes.overview: Kenshin obtains a new sakabato. Having involved Seiku in this conflict, he decides to leave Aoiya before inviting any further danger. Meanwhile, Misao stops by Shirobeko, a beef hot-pot restaurant where Kaoru and Yahiko work part time, where she learns Kaoru is searching for Kenshin.

episodes.title: Sakabato First Attack
episodes.overview: Going back in time, the 4th year of Keio. Kenshin is suffering from a high fever in the main hall of a desolate shrine. Kenshin falls asleep and when he awakens, he finds himself being nursed back to health by former private detective Giichi and his wife Satsuki in their home.

episodes.title: Drawing of the Forbidden
episodes.overview: Known as "the Sword Hunter" in the Ten Swords organization, Cho is adept at maneuvering a variety of different and unique swords. As for Kenshin, he continues to risk his life and fight for peace in the new era and to save Seiku's son, Iori, even though he's forced to fight with a broken sakabato.

episodes.title: Cho of The Ten Swords
episodes.overview: Seeking a replacement for his broken sakabato, Kenshin visits Seiku, the son of highly honored swordsmith Shakku Arai, only to learn that he has quit making swords. Respecting Seiku's philosophy of peace, Kenshin gives up his request for a new blade. Meanwhile, Ten Swords member Hoji Sadojima reports to Shishio on Kenshin's movements.

episodes.title: Arrival in Kyoto
episodes.overview: Kenshin and Misao arrive in Kyoto, where they're welcomed by Okina, a grandfather figure to Misao. It turns out, Okina is a former member of the Oniwaban Group. Okina offers his help and Kenshin ask him to help find someone for him.

episodes.title: Encounter in the Forest
episodes.overview: Sanosuke makes his way to Kyoto while trudging through the forest and getting lost at the same time. On the road there, he meets Anji Yukyuzan, a fallen monk currently in training. Sanosuke witnesses Anji unleash an astonishing strike up close, a technique that took Anji 10 years to acquire. There, Anji decides to teach Sanosuke "the Mastery of Two Layers," an art of destruction. However, he requires Sanosuke to learn the technique within one month; if he fails, he will have to die. Against this unreasonable and excessive condition laid out to him, Sanosuke declares he'll learn it within a week. The training for this technique, which will make or break his life, begins….

episodes.title: To Kyoto, Once More
episodes.overview: Kenshin defeats Senkaku and finally faces off against Shishio. However, Shishio expresses his disappointment at Kenshin's policy of refusing to kill and lets his close associate, Sojiro Seta, deal with Kenshin. He leaves the village with another associate of his, Yumi Komagata. To continue his pursuit of Shishio, Kenshin faces off with Sojiro and exchanges blows of Battojutsu, which can make or break the fight's outcome. It is a battle of divine speed from both sides...

episodes.title: Portrait of the Ambitious
episodes.overview: Kenshin steps into Shingetsu Village, a place where the Mishima brothers escaped from. The village is currently under the control of Senkaku, Shishio's subordinate, who rules with an iron fist and uses violence to control the villagers. They are frightened of the violence and unable to do anything but obey. The village has decayed and exudes an unusual aura about it. Kenshin heads over to where Shishio is located with Hajime, who's learned about the current situation and visited the village. In the background of these events, Eiji's heart burns with the desire for revenge against Senkaku.

episodes.title: The Abandoned Village
episodes.overview: The name of the girl that Kenshin encounters in the forests is Misao Makimachi, and she came from Kyoto to find Aoshi's Oniwaban Group. Kenshin is surprised to hear his name. Upon seeing Kenshin's reaction, she asks him if he knows where Aoshi is, but he keeps his mouth shut. However, Kenshin is touched by the emotions Misao has for Aoshi, in which he then decides to make the journey to Kyoto with her.

episodes.title: On The East Sea Road
episodes.overview: Megumi is alone in Tokyo and coincidentally encounters Aoshi at Kamiya Dojo, who's come back for another fight with Kenshin. Aoshi asks Megumi where Kenshin is, but she feigns ignorance. Unhappy with the lack of response, he threatens to kill her if she doesn't tell him, when a man suddenly appears. Meanwhile, Kenshin encounters a young girl in the forests of the Hakone mountains as he makes his way to Kyoto.

episodes.title: To Kyoto
episodes.overview: Making the decision to fight against Shishio, Kenshin leaves Kamiya Dojo and sets off for Kyoto via the Tokaido by himself. Meanwhile, Sanosuke and Yahiko attempt to go to Kyoto to follow Kenshin.

episodes.title: In the 11th Year of Meiji, May 14th
Meiji Swordsman Romantic Story: Act Zero – Part Two
Meiji Swordsman Romantic Story: Act Zero – Part One
And Then, Another
episodes.overview: Sanosuke's fight with Kenshin continues, but despite his strength, he is no match for Kenshin. During the fight he remembers his past, but also notices the similarity between Kenshin and the person he admired as a kid.

title: Rurouni Kenshin
overview: The Meiji Era was one of great renewal for Japan, where swords and killing were outlawed. However, many survivors from the time of Revolution still live, lurking in the shadows and waiting for a chance to use their killing blades again. Only Kenshin Himura, formerly one of the most brutal of killers, hopes to keep his swordsman's honor and still live in the new era.

title: Sacred Games
overview: A link in their pasts leads an honest cop to a fugitive gang boss, whose cryptic warning spurs the officer on a quest to save Mumbai from cataclysm.

episodes.title: Radcliffe
episodes.overview: Unsettling truths, complex betrayals and unforeseen connections emerge for Sartaj, Gaitonde and Shahid Khan as doomsday descends on Mumbai.

episodes.title: Torino
episodes.overview: After committing a drastic act, Gaitonde can't silence Guruji's voice in his mind. Parulkar reaches a shocking realization. Sartaj makes a breakthrough.

episodes.title: Azrael
episodes.overview: Batya lets Sartaj in on several secrets, leaving him reeling and conflicted. Gaitonde returns to Mumbai to set Guruji's destructive plan in motion.

episodes.title: Vikarna
episodes.overview: As Sartaj's team baits a trap for Shahid Khan, Majid suspects a department member. Immersed in ashram life, Gaitonde learns of Guruji's lethal plans.

episodes.title: Bardo
episodes.overview: Sartaj's team tries to reach Shahid Khan via an internet chatroom. In 2003, Gaitonde's growing disenchantment with his life brings him closer to Guruji.

episodes.title: Apasmara
episodes.overview: Sartaj traces how Shahid Khan's nuclear consignment was delivered to India. In the early 2000s, Gaitonde takes bold action to maintain his notoriety.

episodes.title: Siduri
episodes.overview: With the terrorist-cell investigation underway, Sartaj visits Guruji's ashram. In the late '90s, Gaitonde is urged to seek a spiritual anchor.

episodes.title: Matsya
episodes.overview: After making a discovery in Gaitonde's bunker, Sartaj joins a mission to foil a deadly conspiracy. In 1994, Gaitonde resurfaces in a new location.

episodes.title: Yayati
episodes.overview: To save Mumbai from impending doom, Sartaj races against time to find out who Gaitonde's third father is and what's planned to happen on the 25th day.

episodes.title: Rudra
episodes.overview: Hoping to tie up the many loose ends of their case, Sartaj and Anjali reunite to figure out how the enigmatic Trivedi is linked to Gatonde's prophecy.

episodes.title: Pretakalps
episodes.overview: When Sartaj's constable, Katekar, is pressured to investigate the disappearance of a young man from a Muslim slum, disastrous consequences follow.

episodes.title: Sarama
episodes.overview: To save Nayanika, Sartaj intervenes during a RAW operation, In 1992, as political unrest increases, so does the bloodshed from Gaitonde and Isa's fued.

episodes.title: Brahmahatya
episodes.overview: TV Starlet Nayanika visits Bunty with a hidden camera. In the mid-'80s, Gaitonde discovers a racket even more lucrative than drugs and guns: politics.

episodes.title: Aatapi Vatapi
episodes.overview: The woman found in the bunker leads Sartaj to Gaitonde's thug, Bunty. In a flashback, Gaitonde recalls stealing a lucky charm from rival Suleiman Isa.

episodes.title: Halahala
episodes.overview: News of Ganesh Gaitonde creates a stir among Mumbai's VIPs, from politicians to film stars. Removed from the case, Sartaj begins his own investigation.

episodes.title: Aswatthama
episodes.overview: A mysterious phone call from an anonymous man leads police officer Sartaj Singh on a chase around Mumbai in a dangerous cat-and-mouse game.

title: See
overview: A virus has decimated humankind. Those who survived emerged blind. Centuries later when twins are born with the mythic ability to see, their father must protect his tribe against a threatened queen.

episodes.title: I See You
episodes.overview: Series finale. Baba and Ranger infiltrate Sibeth's camp, determined to stop her and Tormada once and for all.

episodes.title: God Thunder
episodes.overview: Tormada and Sibeth launch a violent attack on Pennsa that puts Maghra and the city's inhabitants in grave danger.

episodes.title: The Lowlands
episodes.overview: Baba and his group take a dangerous shortcut through the lowlands to get to Pennsa. Maghra and Tamacti Jun make a horrifying discovery.

episodes.title: The House of Enlightenment
episodes.overview: A standoff at the House of Enlightenment gives way to a bloody siege between Baba's party and Tormada's soldiers.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.overview: Tormada presents his new weaponry to The Triangle as Baba leads a group to the House of Enlightenment to destroy Tormada's arsenal.

episodes.title: This Land Is Your Land
episodes.overview: Wren arrives in Pennsa and shares information about Tormada's plans. Tamacti Jun tries once more to quell the Witchfinders' insurgency.

episodes.title: Watch Out for Wolves
episodes.overview: After a devastating loss, Baba heads to Pennsa to warn his family. Maghra debates the Witchfinders' fate. Wren stages a daring escape.

episodes.title: Heavy Hangs the Head
episodes.overview: Baba embraces life in the mountains as hatred for the sighted grows in Pennsa. A Trivantian scientist develops a terrifying new weapon.

episodes.title: Rock-a-Bye
episodes.overview: Baba and Edo lead their armies into an epic battle that builds to an intense face-off between the brothers.

episodes.title: The Queen's Speech
episodes.overview: Queen Kane's treachery forces Maghra's hand. Kofun gets upsetting news. Haniwa makes a final plea to Wren in a bid for peace.

episodes.title: The Truth About Unicorns
episodes.overview: Maghra, Lord Harlan, and Baba head to the peace summit. Haniwa warns them about Paris' vision. The queen and Kofun spend the day together.

episodes.title: The Dinner Party
episodes.overview: Baba and his family are finally reunited, but his joy is cut short when he learns about the queen's plans.

episodes.title: The Witchfinder
episodes.overview: Kofun and Toad arrive in Pennsa just as Maghra makes a life-changing decision. Baba, Paris, and Haniwa run into a trusted friend.

episodes.title: The Compass
episodes.overview: Edo's leadership is called into question. Baba and Haniwa meet a secret tribe of warriors known as The Compass.

episodes.title: Forever
episodes.overview: An old enemy comes face-to-face with Baba. Jerlamarel struggles to accept a life without sight.

episodes.title: Brothers and Sisters
episodes.overview: Baba ventures into hostile territory in search of Haniwa. Queen Kane consecrates a new Payan capital and makes a surprising announcement.

episodes.title: House of Enlightenment
episodes.overview: The twins meet Jerlamarel and finally discover the truth.

episodes.title: The Lavender Road
episodes.overview: The twins reach a crossroads in their journey to the House of Enlightenment.

episodes.title: Silk
episodes.overview: Baba and family are betrayed. Queen Kane uses her cunning to face a new conflict.

episodes.title: Plastic
episodes.overview: As Tamacti Jun's army nears Baba and family, Maghra's past comes to light.

episodes.title: The River
episodes.overview: An attack on the village leads to sacrifice and new challenges.

episodes.title: Fresh Blood
episodes.overview: The twins struggle to keep a secret from their mother.

episodes.title: Message in a Bottle
episodes.overview: A special gift for the twins sparks tension in the group.

episodes.title: Godflame
episodes.overview: A journey of survival begins when an army of Witchfinders attacks the village of Alkenny.

title: Spartacus
overview: Torn from his homeland and the woman he loves, Spartacus is condemned to the brutal world of the arena where blood and death are primetime entertainment.

episodes.title: Victory
episodes.overview: Spartacus and his outnumbered rebels make one last attempt to win freedom in an epic final battle against the Romans.

episodes.title: The Dead and the Dying
episodes.overview: Crassus learns that a fellow prominent Roman is attempting to steal the glory of defeating Spartacus. Spartacus aims to secure a bargaining chip he can use against the Romans.

episodes.title: Separate Paths
episodes.overview: Spartacus and the rebels arrive at a crossroads. With the relentless Crassus driving his men hard in the pursuit of Spartacus, the conflict between Tiberius and Caesar escalates.

episodes.title: Mors Indecepta
episodes.overview: Their forces trapped on an impassable ridge, Spartacus and Crixus clash over the method of escape. Crassus has increasing difficulty controlling the actions of those closest to him.

episodes.title: Spoils of War
episodes.overview: As Crassus leads an onslaught against the rebel-occupied city, Gannicus is trapped behind enemy lines. Tiberius is tasked by Crassus to hold a celebration in honor of a man he despises.

episodes.title: Blood Brothers
episodes.overview: Spartacus puts a plan in motion to weaken Crassus's forces and gain the upper hand. Betrayal threatens to foil the plan.

episodes.title: Decimation
episodes.overview: The possible infiltration of a Roman spy causes tension between Spartacus and his men. Crassus resurrects a long abandoned form of Roman punishment to teach his soldiers a brutal lesson.

episodes.title: Men of Honor
episodes.overview: Spartacus considers striking a deal with a band of marauders to ensure his people stay supplied and fed. Crassus's son Tiberius makes a bold and fateful decision.

episodes.title: Wolves at the Gate
episodes.overview: Spartacus leads a daring assault to provide food and shelter for his people. Crassus builds a fearsome army and receives an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Enemies of Rome
episodes.overview: Spartacus continues to build a formidable army and outwit Rome's best commanders. The powers of the Empire are forced to turn to wealthy, ambitious Marcus Crassus to aid the campaign.

episodes.title: Wrath of the Gods
episodes.overview: Dwindling supplies and a superior enemy brings the rebellion to its knees. Spartacus must restore hope to his people as they careen towards a final confrontation with Glaber's army.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.overview: Spartacus must convince his people to unite against a Roman assault. Lucretia struggles to be free from the commands of men who threaten her fate. Glaber's ruthlessness has consequences.

episodes.title: Balance
episodes.overview: Spartacus gets a chance for vengeance when a prominent Roman is captured. The intrigue amongst Glaber and the women surrounding him heats up.

episodes.title: Sacramentum
episodes.overview: Spartacus and his rebels try to increase their numbers by freeing fighters enslaved in foreign wars. Lucretia recruits one of her husband's former gladiators to outmaneuver powerful Romans.

episodes.title: Chosen Path
episodes.overview: Spartacus urges his rebels to train for the defense of their new sanctuary. Lucretia and Ilithyia seek comfort from each other, while Glaber's forces swell with some deadly new recruits.

episodes.title: Libertus
episodes.overview: Spartacus leads a bold mission to free Crixus from the Romans, but a storied gladiator from the House of Batiatus complicates matters. Ilithyia's scheming puts her marriage to Glaber at risk.

episodes.title: Empty Hands
episodes.overview: Spartacus leads survivors through the woods, but Crixus returns to a place of past suffering. Lucretia pries into Ilithyia's affairs, seeking influence with a powerful Roman.

episodes.title: The Greater Good
episodes.overview: Spartacus must navigate a divide that opens up among the gladiators after news of Naevia's fate. Lucretia reveals a long-held secret to gain information, and an attack puts the rebels at risk.

episodes.title: A Place in This World
episodes.overview: Spartacus liberates a Roman villa, but its slaves are wary. Oenomaus throws himself into the brutal Pits, and Glaber supports Lucretia's prophecies, despite Ilithyia's protests.

episodes.title: Fugitivus
episodes.overview: Spartacus discovers the grave responsibilities and costs in his new role as a leader of freed slaves. Claudius Glaber's arrival in Capua forces Spartacus to keep his rebellious band intact.

episodes.title: Kill Them All
episodes.overview: Discontent within the ludus grows as Spartacus continues to plan his revenge upon Batiatus. Unaware of the looming threat from the gladiators, Batiatus and Lucretia host a lavish party for the elite, where Spartacus and Crixus will battle to the death, to settle the dispute of who is truly the champion of Capua once and for all.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.overview: Lucretia and Batiatus eagerly await the arrival of Gaius Claudius Glaber with the hopes of receiving his patronage for the ludus. Barely healed from his recent brush with death, Spartacus is immediately forced back into the arena. However, having discovered the truth of Sura's death, Spartacus begins to plan his revenge against Batiatus.

episodes.title: Old Wounds
episodes.overview: Gripped by guilt and mourning, Spartacus hovers on the brink and is plagued with disturbing visions and dreams. Meanwhile, Batiatus plots revenge against his enemies.

episodes.title: Party Favors
episodes.overview: Spartacus and Crixus are set up to fight in an exhibition match for Numerius' 15th birthday, but Crixus is intent on blood. However, interference by Ilithyia results in devastating consequences.

episodes.title: Whore
episodes.overview: Batiatus breaks the news that Spartacus is to service Licinia, the richest woman in Rome. Worried that Spartacus may be unable to satisfy having spent so much time without a woman, Lucretia sends a female slave to ensure his best performance.

episodes.title: Mark of the Brotherhood
episodes.overview: As Spartacus embraces his new role as champion, Batiatus purchases a fresh lot of slaves during an auction to be trained as gladiators and ponders the idea of selling Crixus.

episodes.title: Great and Unfortunate Things
episodes.overview: Overcome by the pressure of Batiatus' control, Spartacus must make a choice: leave his past behind and assume the mantle of a champion gladiator, or die.

episodes.title: Delicate Things
episodes.overview: With the glory and riches reaped from Spartacus' victory in the arena, it appears that his long-desired reward will be granted when Batiatus informs him that he will be reunited with his wife.

episodes.title: Shadow Games
episodes.overview: When Batiatus is presented with a gladiatorial opportunity of a lifetime, Spartacus and Crixus must overcome their mutual hostility to fight as a team against a legendary and unbeaten opponent.

episodes.title: The Thing In the Pit
episodes.overview: Having performed shamefully in the arena against Crixus, Spartacus is forced to fight in the Pits for Batiatus, who is increasingly plagued by debt. Lucretia takes matters into her own hands to try and bring some money into the ludus.

episodes.title: Legends
episodes.overview: Though Spartacus has proven himself during training and now wears the attire of a gladiator, his coarse attitude and relentless quest to see his wife isolates him from his fellow gladiators and Doctore.

episodes.title: Sacramentum Gladiatorum
episodes.overview: Enslaved in gladiatorial school, the newly christened Spartacus must try to suppress his desire for vengeance when his new master promises to reunite him with his wife.

episodes.title: The Red Serpent
episodes.overview: A Thracian warrior, enlisted by the Romans to fight, has his destiny sealed by an act of rebellious violence. As punishment he is torn away from his wife and faces death by being forced to fight in the gladiatorial arena.

title: Squid Game
overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

episodes.title: Humans Are…
episodes.overview: As Jun Ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

episodes.title: ○△□
episodes.overview: No Eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi Hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?
Even as Gi Hun supports Jun Hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi Hun an ultimatum.

episodes.title: It's Not Your Fault
episodes.overview: Jun Ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum Ja makes a desperate plea to Gi Hun to help Jun Hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.

episodes.title: The Starry Night
episodes.overview: The games resume, and Gi Hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae Ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun Hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

episodes.title: Keys and Knives
episodes.overview: No Eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

episodes.title: Friend or Foe
episodes.overview: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

episodes.title: O ﻿ X
episodes.overview: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

episodes.title: One More Game
episodes.overview: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

episodes.title: Six Legs
episodes.overview: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.
New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

episodes.title: Halloween Party
episodes.overview: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.

episodes.title: Bread and Lottery
episodes.overview: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

episodes.title: One Lucky Day
episodes.overview: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

episodes.title: Front Man
episodes.overview: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

episodes.title: VIPS
episodes.overview: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

episodes.title: Gganbu
episodes.overview: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

episodes.title: A Fair World
episodes.overview: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

episodes.title: Stick to the Team
episodes.overview: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

episodes.title: The Man with the Umbrella
episodes.overview: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

episodes.title: Hell
episodes.overview: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

episodes.title: Red Light, Green Light
episodes.overview: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

title: Star Wars: The Bad Batch
overview: The 'Bad Batch' of elite and experimental clones make their way through an ever-changing galaxy in the immediate aftermath of the Clone Wars.

episodes.title: The Cavalry Has Arrived
episodes.overview: Omega and the Batch battle Imperial forces for their freedom.

episodes.title: Flash Strike
episodes.overview: Odds are against the Batch as they operate behind enemy lines.

episodes.title: Into The Breach
episodes.overview: The Batch prep for a gambit in enemy territory.

episodes.title: Juggernaut
episodes.overview: While seeking an unexpected source, the Batch must make a daring escape.

episodes.title: Point Of No Return
episodes.overview: The Empire closes in on the Batch.

episodes.title: Identity Crisis
episodes.overview: Emerie confronts the dark secrets behind Hemlock's scientific research.

episodes.title: The Harbinger
episodes.overview: As the Batch plans their next move, a mysterious stranger arrives.

episodes.title: Bad Territory
episodes.overview: Desperate for intel, Hunter and Wrecker track down a dangerous bounty hunter.

episodes.title: Extraction
episodes.overview: As enemies close in, the Batch must evacuate a stronghold.

episodes.title: Infiltration
episodes.overview: The Batch reunites with an ally in need.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.overview: Tensions rise as our heroes navigate new dynamics on a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: A Different Approach
episodes.overview: Stranded in dangerous territory, Omega and Crosshair must work together.

episodes.title: Shadows Of Tantiss
episodes.overview: Omega and Crosshair hatch a daring plan.

episodes.title: Paths Unknown
episodes.overview: Following a lead, Hunter and Wrecker make a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Confined
episodes.overview: Imprisoned on Tantiss, Omega adjusts to a new life.

episodes.title: Plan 99
episodes.overview: The heroes are tested.

episodes.title: The Summit
episodes.overview: An infiltration proves more challenging than expected.

episodes.title: Tipping Point
episodes.overview: New information has our heroes taking on a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Pabu
episodes.overview: The team takes refuge and finds new allies.

episodes.title: The Outpost
episodes.overview: A new friend is made on a harsh and unforgiving outpost planet.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.overview: The Batch finds a mysterious missing vessel.

episodes.title: Retrieval
episodes.overview: Attempting to recover a lost asset, the Batch must learn to trust a thief.

episodes.title: The Crossing
episodes.overview: The team tackles a risky mission on a hostile world.

episodes.title: Truth & Consequences
episodes.overview: Brought into a risky mission, the Batch must use stealth to survive.

episodes.title: The Clone Conspiracy
episodes.overview: A conspiracy begins to unravel.

episodes.title: Tribe
episodes.overview: The Bad Batch helps bring a new friend home.

episodes.title: Entombed
episodes.overview: The Batch searches for an ancient treasure that stirs up a shocking surprise.

episodes.title: Faster
episodes.overview: The team enters the colorful and dangerous world of racing.

episodes.title: The Solitary Clone
episodes.overview: Clones battle against a Separatist hold out.

episodes.title: Ruins of War
episodes.overview: The Batch must decide who to trust as they plan their escape.

episodes.title: Spoils of War
episodes.overview: The Bad Batch plans a risky heist.

episodes.title: Kamino Lost
episodes.overview: As Tipoca City falls, the Bad Batch must figure out a way to survive — and reckon with the choices of their former squadmate and brother.

episodes.title: Return to Kamino
episodes.overview: The Bad Batch look to rescue Hunter from their former friend.

episodes.title: War-Mantle
episodes.overview: While on a job for Cid, the Bad Batch find themselves drawn into a new mission.

episodes.title: Infested
episodes.overview: When Cid runs into trouble, the Bad Batch are called in to help.

episodes.title: Rescue on Ryloth
episodes.overview: The Batch is tasked with a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Devil's Deal
episodes.overview: As the seeds of rebellion foment on an outer rim world, the Empire schemes to squash it.

episodes.title: Common Ground
episodes.overview: A new mission finds the Bad Batch helping a former enemy.

episodes.title: Bounty Lost
episodes.overview: Secrets are revealed as the Bad Batch look to rescue Omega.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: While the Bad Batch look to pay off their debts, Crosshair closes in.

episodes.title: Battle Scars
episodes.overview: A mysterious visitor comes looking for the Bad Batch.

episodes.title: Decommissioned
episodes.overview: Cid hires the Bad Batch for another job, and it doesn't go quite as planned.

episodes.title: Rampage
episodes.overview: Following a clash with a bounty hunter, the team takes on a job in exchange for intel and credits.

episodes.title: Cornered
episodes.overview: The Bad Batch make a pit stop for repairs and rations. Little do they know, however, that it's not just the Empire hunting them.

episodes.title: Replacements
episodes.overview: The Bad Batch make an unexpected stop, while the Empire introduces its own elite squad.

episodes.title: Cut and Run
episodes.overview: Hunter and the Bad Batch seek refuge with an old friend. But they quickly discover there are no more safe havens.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.overview: The clones of The Bad Batch find themselves in a changing galaxy after The Clone Wars.

title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
overview: Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu and other Jedi Knights lead the Grand Army of the Republic against the droid army of the Separatists.

episodes.title: Victory and Death
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and Rex must use their wit and skills to survive the turbulent end of the Clone Wars.

episodes.title: Shattered
episodes.overview: After capturing Maul on Mandalore, Ahsoka's journey to the Jedi Council is disrupted when Order 66 is declared, turning her world upside down.

episodes.title: The Phantom Apprentice
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and Republic forces confront Maul on Mandalore.

episodes.title: Old Friends Not Forgotten
episodes.overview: Anakin and Obi-Wan must decide whether to help Ahsoka pursue Maul or rescue Palpatine.

episodes.title: Together Again
episodes.overview: Ahsoka bargains for the sisters' freedom and makes a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Dangerous Debt
episodes.overview: Taken prisoner by the Pykes, Ahsoka and the Martez sisters attempt to escape.

episodes.title: Deal No Deal
episodes.overview: Trace makes a rash decision after learning what they are transporting is for the Pyke Syndicate.

episodes.title: Gone With a Trace
episodes.overview: Ahsoka befriends a pilot but must hide her Jedi past while trying to stop a dangerous droid.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Anakin Skywalker and the Bad Batch attempt to gain a victory for the Republic.

episodes.title: On the Wings of Keeradaks
episodes.overview: After their escape, Anakin Skywalker and the clones defend a local village

episodes.title: A Distant Echo
episodes.overview: Anakin Skywalker, Rex, and the Bad Batch make a shocking discovery on Skako Minor.

episodes.title: The Bad Batch
episodes.overview: Captain Rex and the Bad Batch must infiltrate an enemy base on Anaxes.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.overview: After many grueling trials, Yoda next travels to the ancient Sith homeworld of Moraband, where he must face an ancient evil determined to rule the galaxy.

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.overview: Letting the Force guide him, Yoda voyages into the heart of the galaxy to an ancient world that is one of the wellsprings of the Force and the source of midi-chlorians. Yoda undergoes difficult trials administered by the Five Priestesses, mysterious Force-wielders who hold the secret to immortality.

episodes.title: Voices
episodes.overview: Yoda is deeply unsettled when he hears a voice from beyond the grave: the voice of Qui-Gon Jinn. Knowing that it is impossible for a Jedi to retain his identity after death, the Jedi Council begins to worry that Yoda may be corrupted by the influence of the dark side. Determined to find answers, Yoda escapes the Jedi Temple to follow the disembodied voice.

episodes.title: The Lost One
episodes.overview: A Jedi mission finds a lightsaber belonging to the long-dead Master Sifo-Dyas, prompting Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to being an investigation into his decade-old disappearance. This sparks Darth Sidious to order Darth Tyranus to clean up any loose ends that may lead the Jedi to discover the truth of the Sith conspiracy.

episodes.title: The Disappeared: Pt. 2
episodes.overview: Jar Jar Binks' beloved Queen Julia of the planet Bardotta has been abducted by the bloodthirsty Frangawl Cult to fulfill a dark and ancient prophecy. Representative Binks and Jedi Master Windu must find the missing Queen before the cult can rise in power.

episodes.title: The Disappeared: Pt. 1
episodes.overview: The peaceful world of Bardotta and its mystic ways are threatened by an ancient prophecy, and its top spiritual leaders have vanished. Queen Julia of Bardotta calls for help from her most trusted friend in the Senate, Jar Jar Binks. Recognizing the importance of Bardotta's spiritual balance, the Jedi Council sends Mace Windu to accompany Binks and investigate.

episodes.title: Crisis at the Heart
episodes.overview: After making a deal with Count Dooku to resuscitate the ailing Banking Clan, Clovis finds himself a pawn in Dooku's designs. Clovis has brought the war to Scipio, forcing the Republic to intervene.

episodes.title: The Rise of Clovis
episodes.overview: Back on Coruscant, Clovis—known traitor of the Republic—makes a dubious deal which puts him at the head of the Banking Clan. Anakin's increasing distrust and hatred of Clovis strains his relationship with Padmé to breaking point.

episodes.title: An Old Friend
episodes.overview: While on Scipio to fund a mercy mission, Padmé Amidala is called upon by an old friend, Rush Clovis, to help uncover corruption in the Banking Clan. They must evade the bounty hunter Embo to escape the planet with the incriminating information.

episodes.title: Orders
episodes.overview: Fives continues to push for answers regarding the mystery of the clone contamination and secures an audience with Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. But the situation quickly collapses when Fives is accused of attacking the chancellor, and he must flee deep into the Coruscant cityscape while pursued by his fellow clone troopers.

episodes.title: Fugitive
episodes.overview: Clone trooper Tup is scheduled for transport to Coruscant, where the Supreme Chancellor's own doctors will closely examine him. Fives breaks protocol and defies orders to dig up answers, and discovers that there is an organic construct of unknown purpose hidden in the brains of all clone troopers.

episodes.title: Conspiracy
episodes.overview: In the sterile laboratories of Kamino, the ailing clone trooper Tup and his friend Fives are quarantined for examination following Tup's shocking murder of a Jedi Master. With the help of medical droid AZI-3, Fives is determined to get to the bottom of Tup's condition and uncovers a secret deep within the Republic cloning program.

episodes.title: The Unknown
episodes.overview: Clone trooper Tup succumbs to a mysterious mental illness that results in the shocking death of a Jedi Master. Unable to account for his murderous actions, Tup is sedated and sent back to Kamino for examination. Anakin and ARC trooper Fives accompany Tup, but their return trip is ambushed by Separatists.

episodes.title: The Wrong Jedi
episodes.overview: On trial for murder, Ahsoka faces her greatest challenge.

episodes.title: To Catch a Jedi
episodes.overview: While on the run in the underworld of Coruscant, pursued by Republic authorities, Ahsoka makes a deal with Asajj Ventress to find out who the actual murderer of Letta Turmond really is, leading the two to come to terms with each other in spite of their antagonistic pasts. However, will the real perpetrator's machinations cast such an alliance into doubt?

episodes.title: The Jedi Who Knew Too Much
episodes.overview: Ahsoka Tano is blamed for the murder of Letta Turmond, a key suspect in the bombing, and is detained by Admiral Tarkin. Despite Anakin's best efforts to exonerate her, she is forced to escape the military prison where she is interred and flee into the Coruscant underworld to find the actual perpetrator and prove her innocence.

episodes.title: Sabotage
episodes.overview: After Ahsoka rescues Anakin from certain peril on Cato Neimoidia, the two are called back to Coruscant from the front lines to investigate a terrorist bombing at the Jedi Temple, where they are told that a Jedi may be responsible.

episodes.title: The Lawless
episodes.overview: Using Duchess Satine as bait, Darth Maul lures Obi-Wan into a trap.

episodes.title: Shades of Reason
episodes.overview: Maul's alliance helps the Death Watch and their leader, Pre Vizsla, conquer Mandalore and imprison Duchess Satine, but, when Vizsla's ambitions surface, how long will the alliance last?

episodes.title: Eminence
episodes.overview: Darth Maul and Savage Opress form an alliance with the Mandalorian terrorist group Death Watch and several crime syndicates, including Black Sun, the Pyke Syndicate, and the Hutt Cartel, in order to destroy all of their common enemies.

episodes.title: Point of No Return
episodes.overview: After believing themselves safe, Colonel Gascon and D-Squad discover that they are prisoners of the Separatists in a captured Republic cruiser, finding themselves enmeshed in thwarting a plot to destroy a Republic space station holding a strategic conference.

episodes.title: Missing in Action
episodes.overview: Colonel Gascon and D-Squad discover that Abafar, the planet they are trapped on, is Separatist-controlled, but they also discover a Republic Clone Commando named Gregor, who has been stranded on the planet as well. They must work together to get off the planet safely.

episodes.title: A Sunny Day in the Void
episodes.overview: After their ship crashes on a desolate planet, D-Squad & Colonel Gascon must find a way off to get back to Coruscant, or be stranded forever.

episodes.title: Secret Weapons
episodes.overview: R2-D2 is part of a team of Republic droids chosen for an important mission led by the diminutive Colonel Meebur Gascon to obtain an encryption module from a Separatist dreadnought. The droids must overcome numerous challenging obstacles to succeed in this crucial assignment.

episodes.title: A Necessary Bond
episodes.overview: General Grievous attacks Hondo on Florrum, so Ahsoka and Hondo must make amends in order to survive this encounter.

episodes.title: Bound for Rescue
episodes.overview: With Ahsoka captured by Hondo, the younglings go to Florrum to rescue her, against the wishes of Obi-Wan Kenobi. However, before he can help the younglings, he is attacked by General Grievous and defeated, but nearly kills the droid general by setting the self-destruct on the Negotiator, after being defeated by Grievous in single-combat.

episodes.title: A Test of Strength
episodes.overview: While returning to Coruscant with their lightsaber crystals, the younglings are attacked by Hondo, who wants to steal their crystals and sell them. Ahsoka must defend the younglings from the pirates.

episodes.title: The Gathering
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and Yoda take a group of younglings to a cave on Ilum to perform a Jedi rite of passage called "The Gathering", where they will each have to face an internal fear or flaw in order to retrieve a Kyber crystal so they can begin building their own lightsabers.

episodes.title: Tipping Points
episodes.overview: As a full-scale revolt embroils Onderon, the rebels strike a decisive blow against the planet's Separatist-aligned king. Unfortunately for the rebels, such victory comes at a high price.

episodes.title: The Soft War
episodes.overview: After a rebel attempt to rescue Onderon's true king, Ramsis Dendup, an unexpected ally steps forward to halt Dendup's execution and aid the rebel cause.

episodes.title: Front Runners
episodes.overview: Ahsoka Tano, now leading the rebels on Onderon, but forbidden to fight, puts their training to use by having them hi-jack an AAT and blow up the main power station for the capital city of Onderon, so that the rebels can wreak havoc.

episodes.title: A War on Two Fronts
episodes.overview: On the Separatist world of Onderon, a group of rebels call for the assistance of the Jedi. Ahsoka, Anakin, Rex, and Obi-Wan go to train the rebels to fight, and see that former Separatist and Ahsoka Tano's love interest Lux Bonteri is among them, as Onderon is his homeworld.

episodes.title: Revival
episodes.overview: Fueled by vengeance and rage, the newly reunited brothers Savage Opress and Darth Maul spread terror and violence across the galaxy. As the Sith brothers forcibly recruit Hondo Ohnaka and his pirates, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Adi Gallia chase them down, leading to a deadly confrontation.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.overview: Savage and Maul, now reunited, pursue Obi-Wan Kenobi in search of revenge, and the Jedi Knight finds himself forced to unite with a surprising ally to defend against the deadly siblings.

episodes.title: Brothers
episodes.overview: The dark warrior Savage Opress is on a quest to find his long-lost brother. Could Darth Maul truly be alive, after more than a decade since his gruesome bisection at the blade of Obi-Wan Kenobi? Savage voyages into the depths of a twisted planet to find whatever became of the fallen Sith Lord.

episodes.title: Bounty
episodes.overview: An aimless Asajj Ventress joins a team of bounty hunters under the leadership of young Boba Fett. On an alien world, they undertake a dangerous but profitable mission that tests the limits of their skills, and the strength of Asajj's character.

episodes.title: Massacre
episodes.overview: Count Dooku is determined to have revenge against the Nightsisters of Dathomir after their betrayal. General Grievous launches an all-out droid attack against the magic-wielding witches, and Mother Talzin and Asajj Ventress lead the defense with all the dark powers at their command.

episodes.title: Crisis on Naboo
episodes.overview: The Chancellor travels to Naboo to preside over a public ceremony, guarded by Jedi Knights. Dooku and his bounty hunters -- including an undercover Obi-Wan Kenobi -- launch their kidnapping plot.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.overview: The disguised Obi-Wan accompanies Cad Bane and Moralo Eval to Serenno, where they enlist in a brutal competition with other bounty hunters from around the galaxy to determine who will participate in a plot to kidnap the Chancellor.

episodes.title: Friends and Enemies
episodes.overview: Fleeing across the galaxy with criminal fugitives, a disguised Obi-Wan, Cad Bane and Moralo Eval are tenaciously pursued by Anakin and Ahsoka, who have no idea they're chasing their friend.

episodes.title: Deception
episodes.overview: When the Jedi learn of a Separatist plot to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine, one of them must go deep undercover as a hardened criminal to extract information from the conspirators.

episodes.title: A Friend in Need
episodes.overview: A peace conference between Separatists and Republic delegates is interrupted by Lux Bonteri, the son of a late Separatist Senator, who involves Ahsoka in his dangerous search to find justice for his mother's death.

episodes.title: Escape from Kadavo
episodes.overview: Anakin tries to convince the Zygerrian Queen that she too is a slave and pawn in an evil Separatist plot. Meanwhile, Obi-Wan toils in the slave camps of Kadavo, a grim situation that grows increasingly bleak.

episodes.title: Slaves of the Republic
episodes.overview: To locate the missing colonists, Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka go undercover to infiltrate the slavers on Zygerria. Anakin struggles with his emotions as a wily Zygerrian queen forces him to take questionable actions in order to carry out his mission.

episodes.title: Kidnapped
episodes.overview: Zygerrian slavers are behind the sudden disappearance of an entire colony of people on the planet Kiros. As Anakin and Ahsoka rush to defuse a series of bombs planted by the slavers, Obi-Wan must fight with their imposing leader.

episodes.title: Carnage of Krell
episodes.overview: With two of his men facing execution for disobeying orders, Captain Rex must confront his overly aggressive commander, General Krell. Risking charges of mutiny, Rex must make a dark choice as the true face of the enemy emerges.

episodes.title: Plan of Dissent
episodes.overview: After the Republic conquers an Umbaran airbase, General Krell orders Rex and his men on towards the heavily fortified capital. Realizing there's a better plan, several clone troopers disobey orders to carry out a rogue, covert operation.

episodes.title: The General
episodes.overview: General Krell orders Captain Rex and the clone troopers of the 501st Legion to conquer a heavily fortified Umbaran airbase, and will not accept anything less than victory. It is an almost certain suicide mission, unless the clones can use their ingenuity to defeat their new enemy.

episodes.title: Darkness on Umbara
episodes.overview: When Anakin is forced to temporarily turn over command of his clone troopers to a new commander, the Jedi Pong Krell, tensions begin to run high as the clones are assigned with a very deadly mission to take the capital of Umbara.

episodes.title: Nomad Droids
episodes.overview: C-3PO and R2-D2's bizarre caper continues. Forced to escape a Separatist attack in a Y-wing fighter, the droids visit the world of the Patitites, the odd planet Balnab, and the inside of a pirate warship where they are forced to fight in a gladiatorial arena.

episodes.title: Mercy Mission
episodes.overview: After groundquakes have devastated the planet Aleen, a Republic relief effort arrives, including the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO. When the native Aleena's pleas go unheard, it becomes the duty of the droids to embark on a surreal journey through Aleen's subterranean world to save the planet.

episodes.title: Shadow Warrior
episodes.overview: When the leader of the Gungans, Boss Lyonie, is injured it's discovered there is an uncanny resemblance between the Boss and Jar Jar Binks. Binks must sway his people from rising against the Naboo and stopping a Separatist invasion led by General Grievous.

episodes.title: Prisoners
episodes.overview: The Republic and Gungan forces have been captured by Riff Tamson and his Karkarodon enforcers. Now, it is up to Ahsoka and the young Prince Lee-Char to unite the fractured people of Mon Cala and drive out the Separatist invaders.

episodes.title: Gungan Attack
episodes.overview: Anakin Skywalker and the rest of his Jedi team have been overrun by the Separatist surprise attacks led by Riff Tamson while Prince Lee-Char and Ahsoka must evade capture on their own. Unable to summon more Republic aid, Yoda calls upon the help of the powerful and amphibious Gungan Grand Army, but whether they will be enough to stop the Separatist siege is uncertain. An incensed Tamson doubles his efforts in tracking down Prince Lee-Char, unleashing the reinforcements given to him by Count Dooku in an assault that churns the oceans.

episodes.title: Water War
episodes.overview: When the king of Mon Cala is assassinated, talks break down between the Mon Calamari people and the Quarren, co-inhabitants of the aquatic world. To stop a civil war, the Republic sends Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker, but unbeknownst to them, the Quarren are already being backed by the Separatists. Now the Jedi must protect Mon Cala's new leader, the young Prince Lee-Char, from the attack.

episodes.title: Wookiee Hunt
episodes.overview: As Ahsoka and her allies struggle to evade the Trandoshan hunters, their efforts receive an unexpected boost when a new captive arrives.

episodes.title: Padawan Lost
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and a group of abducted younglings find themselves trapped on a Trandoshan moon, prey in an elaborate and cruel hunt. The forlorn younglings have lost all hope, despite the best efforts of their spirited leader, Kalifa. Ahsoka rallies them to defend themselves and strike back against the Trandoshan, an effort with deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Citadel Rescue
episodes.overview: After their ship and only way off the planet is destroyed, Anakin and Obi-Wan must lead the escaped prisoners across Lola Sayu's perilous landscape as Plo Koon commands a task force of four cruisers and their fighters through the Separatist defenses in a daring rescue.

episodes.title: Counter Attack
episodes.overview: With freed prisoners in their possession and brutal warden Osi Sobeck attempting desperately to thwart them, Obi-Wan and Anakin search for a way out of the Citadel and back to Coruscant. The prison, however, has more traps, perils and pitfalls in store for them than they had imagined and they must work past their differences if they are to escape.

episodes.title: The Citadel
episodes.overview: With help from R2-D2 and a squad of captured battle droids, an elite team of Jedi and clone troopers led by Obi-Wan and Anakin attempt to free a captive Jedi general, Even Piell, from an impenetrable prison.

episodes.title: Ghosts of Mortis
episodes.overview: The Jedi remain stranded on Mortis, and the Son aligned with the Dark Side of the Force renews his efforts to convert Anakin as the Jedi prepare for a decisive confrontation.

episodes.title: Altar of Mortis
episodes.overview: Before the Jedi can leave Mortis, the Son takes Ahsoka captive in an attempt to entice Anakin into joining him to use their combined strength to overpower his Father and Sister.

episodes.title: Overlords
episodes.overview: Obi-Wan, Anakin and Ahsoka become stranded on a mysterious planet where the Force is very strong. Three powerful entities called the Father, Son and Daughter live there. The Father tries to convince Anakin to stay and remain as Anakin will be the only one able to control the Son and Daughter since he is the Chosen One.

episodes.title: Witches of the Mist
episodes.overview: Anakin and Obi-Wan, sent to track down the mysterious figure behind the deaths of several Jedi, soon find themselves on the trail of the monstrous apprentice that Ventress has created: Savage Opress, who has been trained in the ways of the Sith by Dooku.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.overview: With the results of Ventress's attack on Dooku as a failure, Mother Talzin gives Dooku a new apprentice named Savage Opress, who is the clan brother of Darth Maul and secretly controlled by the Nightsisters.

episodes.title: Nightsisters
episodes.overview: Darth Sidious, troubled by Ventress's growing progress with the dark side of the Force, commands Count Dooku to eliminate her. When Ventress survives Dooku's assassination attempt, the jilted former apprentice vows to take revenge, enlisting her kinswomen – the Nightsisters of Dathomir – in her scheme.

episodes.title: Pursuit of Peace
episodes.overview: Senators Padmé Amidala, Bail Organa and Onaconda Farr push against a new bill in the Senate to buy new clones for the Republic. But someone does not like their opposition and tries to persuade them out of it.

episodes.title: Heroes on Both Sides
episodes.overview: When the Senate begins debate on a bill that would eliminate government oversight of the Banking Clan's activities, Padmé and Ahsoka travel in secret to the capital of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, in an attempt to forge a peace agreement with the Separatists.

episodes.title: Hunt for Ziro
episodes.overview: Due to his possession of incriminating information, Ziro the Hutt is placed under the custody under the Hutt Council. When Cad Bane is sent to hunt down Ziro, he learns that Jedi Masters Obi-Wan and Quinlan Vos are searching for Ziro too.

episodes.title: Evil Plans
episodes.overview: While on an important shopping trip on Coruscant, C-3PO and R2-D2 are kidnapped by the sinister bounty hunter Cad Bane in the dastardly plot to free Ziro the Hutt.

episodes.title: Assassin
episodes.overview: Having volunteered to protect Senator Padmé Amidala during a political mission to Alderaan, Padawan Ahsoka Tano is plagued by recurring visions of the presumed dead bounty hunter Aurra Sing assassinating the senator.

episodes.title: The Academy
episodes.overview: Ahsoka is assigned to teach a class at the cadet academy on Mandalore. Soon after she arrives, Duchess Satine's zealous nephew and his classmates uncover a nefarious plot.

episodes.title: Corruption
episodes.overview: Padmé, on a diplomatic mission to Mandalore, guarantees the pacifist planet the Republic's full protection, but she and Duchess Satine soon find something sinister lurking beneath the planet's serene facade.

episodes.title: Sphere of Influence
episodes.overview: Chairman Papanoida's family is kidnapped and held for ransom. Ahsoka must team up with the Senator from Pantora, Riyo Chuchi, to aid the new chairman in recovering his family before the Trade Federation can unduly influence the future of his planet.

episodes.title: Supply Lines
episodes.overview: With Ryloth under siege, a trapped Jedi Master Ima-Gun Di and his clone forces rally the local forces of Cham Syndulla. Elsewhere, the Jedi council sends Bail Organa and Jar Jar Binks to go to Toydaria, to ask King Katuunko for aid to Ryloth.Note: This episode is a prequel to the Season One premiere, "Ambush" and the Ryloth Trilogy.

episodes.title: ARC Troopers
episodes.overview: Taking place after the Season 1 episode "Rookies", General Grievous and Ventress's Separatists forces launch a major attack on the Republic cloning facilities on Kamino with Anakin, Obi-Wan, Jedi Master Shaak Ti, and the 501st defending it.

episodes.title: Clone Cadets
episodes.overview: On Kamino, before the events of "Rookies" (Season 1 Episode 5), 5 clone cadets of Domino Squad are at risk of washing out unless they pull their team together while trainers Bric, El-Les, and Jedi Master Shaak Ti debate their fate.

episodes.title: Lethal Trackdown
episodes.overview: While Anakin and Mace Windu recover from their injuries, Plo Koon and Ahsoka track down Boba Fett from the underworld of Coruscant to the desert planet of Florrum. Boba's revenge scheme finally leads to a climactic battle, and the life of a Republic admiral hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: R2 Come Home
episodes.overview: Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu are trapped in the crumbling ruins of a crashed ship while searching for survivors, and only R2-D2 can get out a message to save them—if he can elude vicious gundarks and, worse yet, a crew of determined bounty hunters led by Boba Fett and Aurra Sing.

episodes.title: Death Trap
episodes.overview: Boba Fett infiltrates a Jedi cruiser and joins a group of young clones with the intention of assassinating Mace Windu for killing his father Jango Fett.

episodes.title: The Zillo Beast Strikes Back
episodes.overview: When the Zillo Beast is brought back to Coruscant in hopes of learning the secret of its impenetrable armour, it instead breaks loose and rampages across the ecumenopolis. As the clones prepare to kill it with poison gas, the Jedi are again trapped in a moral conflict between the value of its life and that of the planet's civilian populace.

episodes.title: The Zillo Beast
episodes.overview: The Republic's newest droid-annihilating proton bomb awakens a monstrous, gargantuan and near-invincible beast from its underground hibernation. Mace Windu and Anakin Skywalker face a dilemma: save the beast as the last specimen of its kind, or help the Dugs kill it and secure a treaty for critical fuel supplies?Note: This episode and the creature's name pay homage to the legendary Japanese giant monster Godzilla.

episodes.title: Bounty Hunters
episodes.overview: When Anakin, Ahsoka and Obi-Wan crash on the lush rainforest planet of Felucia, they decide to help four bounty hunters protect local farmers from pirates intent on stealing their valuable crops. Obi Wan and Anakin soon find out that the pirates are led by the duo's old foe, Hondo.Note: This episode pays homage to the memory of Akira Kurosawa and to his 1954 movie classic Seven Samurai.

episodes.title: Cat and Mouse
episodes.overview: A highly seasoned Separatist strategist stands between the Republic fleet and beleaguered Republic forces on Christophisis. Anakin finds himself in command of an advanced prototype stealth ship with orders to ferry supplies to the weary troops on the planet below. Will he obey orders, or use the stealth ship to launch a sneak attack on the Separatist blockade?Note: This episode is a prequel to the season 1 episode, The Hidden Enemy, which in turn is a prequel to the Clone Wars movie.

episodes.title: Senate Murders
episodes.overview: Senator Onaconda Farr is poisoned, and Padme teams up with Bail Organa to unmask the culprit, who turns out to be a fellow senator.

episodes.title: Duchess of Mandalore
episodes.overview: On Coruscant, Satine disguises herself as a civilian to avoid assassins as she pleads for the Senate to leave her planet in peace.

episodes.title: Voyage of Temptation
episodes.overview: As Satine heads to Coruscant protected by clones and two jedi, Anakin, R2 and the clones find assassin droids in the cargo while Obi-Wan tries to identify the traitor.

episodes.title: The Mandalore Plot
episodes.overview: Obi-Wan is assigned to protect Duchess Satine of Mandalore from a terrorist organization called Death Watch.

episodes.title: Lightsaber Lost
episodes.overview: When Ahsoka's lightsaber is stolen by a pickpocket, she gets help from the seemingly feeble elder Jedi Tera Sinube as she tracks down the thief.

episodes.title: The Deserter
episodes.overview: After escaping to the planet Saleucami, Grievous searches for a ship to get offworld. Obi-Wan, Commander Cody and Rex try to search for Grievous before he escapes the planet. Rex is wounded by a commando droid sniper while scouting ahead and meets a deserter at a farm where he takes shelter.

episodes.title: Grievous Intrigue
episodes.overview: Jedi Master Eeth Koth is captured by General Grievous. While Jedi Master Adi Gallia and Anakin try to rescue him, Obi-Wan plays bait to lure Grievous and capture him.

episodes.title: Brain Invaders
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and Barriss are to transport critical supplies to a medical station, but their clone troops are infected with mind-controlling Geonosian worms which try to kill the Jedi. Barriss is also infected by this mind-controlling worm.

episodes.title: Legacy of Terror
episodes.overview: Luminara is captured while looking for Separatist leader Poggle the Lesser, and it's up to Anakin, Obi-Wan and Commander Cody to enter a colony of Geonosian zombies to find her.

episodes.title: Weapons Factory
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and Luminara Unduli's Padawan Barriss Offee sneak into the droid factory to destroy it while their masters face the new indestructible "Super Tanks".

episodes.title: Landing at Point Rain
episodes.overview: Using the information stolen from Senator Clovis, Obi-Wan, Anakin, Ahsoka, and Ki-Adi-Mundi lead a combined clone trooper assault on a massive droid factory on Geonosis.

episodes.title: Senate Spy
episodes.overview: The Jedi suspect that Senator Rush Clovis is working for the Separatists, so they recruit Padme to spy on him. Anakin is upset to discover that Padme and Clovis have a romantic history.

episodes.title: Children of the Force
episodes.overview: Cad Bane uses the holocron to find and kidnap Force-sensitive younglings. Anakin and Ahsoka try to find them and take them home while Mace Windu and Obi-Wan track down the holocron.

episodes.title: Cargo of Doom
episodes.overview: Cad Bane moves to sell the stolen holocron to the Separatists while Anakin and Ahsoka try to retrieve it and return it to the holocron vault inside the Jedi Temple.

episodes.title: Holocron Heist
episodes.overview: Obi-Wan and Anakin try to stop bounty hunter Cad Bane from stealing a holocron from the Jedi temple. Meanwhile, Ahsoka discovers another shapeshifting bounty hunter disguised as a Jedi.

episodes.title: Hostage Crisis
episodes.overview: In an attempt to force the release of the crime lord Ziro the Hutt from prison, bounty hunters seize control of the Senate Building and hold members of the Senate hostage. Cad Bane, the leader of the operation, with the help of bounty hunter Aurra Sing, issues his demands to Chancellor Palpatine who has no choice but to meet his request. Unbeknownst to the hunters, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker is loose in the Senate Building.

episodes.title: Liberty of Ryloth
episodes.overview: The battle for the Twi'lek homeworld of Ryloth rages as the Republic attempts to drive off the occupying droid army led by Separatist Leader, Wat Tambor. With his forces stretched thin, Mace Windu must convince Twi'lek freedom fighter, Cham Syndulla, to help him save the capital city from the droids' destruction. Initially, the Twi'lek hero is hesitant to aid Mace, but ultimately realizes the Jedi can be trusted and joins with him to liberate the city – and ultimately the planet – in the climactic battle.

episodes.title: Innocents of Ryloth
episodes.overview: With the space blockade around Ryloth destroyed, Obi-Wan Kenobi must lead a small clone force into a droid occupied town to sabotage their anti-aircraft guns. Obi-Wan's mission is complicated when he learns the town's inhabitants are being used as living shields. A pair of clones in his platoon forges an unlikely friendship with a refugee Twi'lek girl, Numa, who's been orphaned by the war. Through their relationship with her, the clones begin to understand the real cost of the war...

episodes.title: Storm Over Ryloth
episodes.overview: Ryloth, home world of the Twi'lek people, has been subjected to military occupation by the droid army of the Separatists, and surrounded by a blockade of Trade Federation battleships. While launching a surprise attack against the blockade, Ahsoka disobeys Anakin's orders and ends up losing most of her squadron. Even though she's emotionally rocked by this failure, Anakin helps her learn to persevere, placing her in charge of another risky attack.

episodes.title: Mystery of a Thousand Moons
episodes.overview: Even though the lab has been shut down, Dr. Vindi manages to activate the dreaded Blue Shadow Virus, infecting Ahsoka, Padmé, and many clone troopers. The plague is fatal within 48 hours. Anakin and Obi-Wan must travel to the mysterious planet, Iego, to secure the only known antidote to the sickness. Anakin and Obi-Wan arrive on the mysterious planet to find its population living in fear of a mysterious force that has been killing anything that tries to leave their world. With the help of Jaybo Hood, a clever Iegoan boy, Anakin and Obi-Wan must solve the planet's mystery before they can leave, and before everyone infected with the Separatist virus dies!

episodes.title: Blue Shadow Virus
episodes.overview: The Republic discovers a Separatist bio-weapon lab hidden on the planet of Naboo. Rather than wait for help, Padmé explores the lab with Jar Jar. Anakin, Ahsoka, Rex, and Obi-Wan arrive and follow after her. They find that the Senator is being held captive by the sinister Dr. Nuvo Vindi. The mad scientist has been developing a lethal virus for the Separatists. Vindi threatens to set off a bomb and release the virus!

episodes.title: Hidden Enemy
episodes.overview: Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi lead Republic forces in an attempt to defeat the droid armies and free the planet of Christophsis from the Separatist siege. When the Republic is ambushed and forced to retreat, it becomes clear that someone in their midst has set them up. The Jedi believe this infiltration is a Sith-backed operation and go behind enemy lines to investigate. Meanwhile, Captain Rex and Commander Cody set out to uncover the traitor amongst them.Note: This episode takes place between episode 2x16 ("Cat and Mouse") and the feature film

episodes.title: Trespass
episodes.overview: Arriving on the desolate ice world of Orto Plutonia, Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi investigate the disappearance of a clone security force stationed on a remote outpost. The Jedi, accompanied by Senator Riyo Chuchi and Chairman Cho of the nearby moon of Pantora, soon discover their clone troopers were attacked by a tribe of furry natives known as the Talz.

episodes.title: Defenders of Peace
episodes.overview: The leader of the Lurmen, Tee Watt Kaa, refuses to shelter the Jedi from arriving Separatist forces, fearing that such an action would unnecessarily bring his neutral people into the war. Ahsoka, Aayla, the wounded Anakin, and the rest of the clones respect their wishes as they don't want to jeopardize the village with their presence, so they have to retreat into the wilds of the planet. Separatist Neimoidian General Lok Durd arrives to test a devastating weapon, which they plan to use on the Lurmen! Ultimately, the villagers have to decide whether they will lay down to the Separatists or fight with the Jedi to defend their village.

episodes.title: Jedi Crash
episodes.overview: Anakin and Ahsoka arrive at a pitched sky battle to help besieged Jedi General Aayla Secura. Anakin is gravely injured in the fight. Aayla and Ahsoka, along with the now-wounded Anakin, Rex, and the surviving clones, crash land on the uncharted grass-covered planet, Maridun. Forced to leave Anakin behind in order to save him, Aayla teaches Ahsoka why the Jedi have no personal attachments. They make their way to a Lurmen village. Their ruler, Tee Watt Kaa, explains that they're pacifists in this war and are not aligned with either side. Hesitant to have anything to do with the Jedi, Tee Watt Kaa agrees to help save Anakin's life.

episodes.title: The Gungan General
episodes.overview: Anakin and Obi-Wan have been duped and are being held for ransom along with Count Dooku by the pirate chief Hondo Ohnaka and his second-in-command, Turk Falso. While Anakin, Obi-Wan and Dooku unsuccessfully attempt to escape, the Republic sends the ransom via a special envoy, including Representative Jar Jar Binks. When Falso tries to steal the ransom from his boss by shooting down the shuttle, the only survivors are a squad of clones and Jar Jar, who as the most senior officer alive, has to take charge of the mission. It becomes a race against time as Jar Jar rushes to deliver the ransom to take custody of Dooku and save the Jedi.

episodes.title: Dooku Captured
episodes.overview: During their own attempt to kidnap Count Dooku, Anakin and Obi-Wan discover that the Sith Lord has already been captured by pirates. Hondo Ohnaka and his gang of pirates hold Dooku captive in their den on Florrum, and hold him for ransom. It's up to Anakin and Obi-Wan to see if the offer is too good to be true.

episodes.title: The Lair of General Grievous
episodes.overview: Jedi Master Kit Fisto and Jedi Nahdarr Vebb, chasing Nute Gunray, enter the sanctuary of General Grievous on the Vassek moon. Count Dooku leads them there as a test for General Grievous to prove himself worthy of the Separatists.

episodes.title: Cloak of Darkness
episodes.overview: After handing over a captured Viceroy Nute Gunray to Captain Argyus and his Senate Commandos for trial, Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and Ahsoka Tano must thwart a Separatist boarding, lead by Asajj Ventress sent by Count Dooku.

episodes.title: Bombad Jedi
episodes.overview: The Separatists think that Jar Jar Binks is a Jedi Knight, when the comical Gungan and C-3PO fight to save Padmé Amidala from doom at the hands of evil Viceroy Nute Gunray.

episodes.title: Duel of the Droids
episodes.overview: R2-D2 is being held at General Grievous' secret listening post. Ahsoka, Anakin and replacement droid R3-S6 go on a dual rescue and sabotage mission.

episodes.title: Downfall of a Droid
episodes.overview: During a battle with the Separatists R2-D2 is lost and they must find him before the Separatists do because of the military secrets locked inside the droid's memory banks.

episodes.title: Rookies
episodes.overview: Clone Officers Rex and Cody must inspire their rookie unit to believe in themselves as they fight off a Droid Commando invasion.

episodes.title: Destroy Malevolence
episodes.overview: Padme Amidala and C-3PO are taken hostage by Gen. Grievous, leaving Anakin and Obi-Wan to save the senator and finish off the Malevolence.

episodes.title: Shadow Malevolence
episodes.overview: Anakin utilizes new long-range Y-wing bombers to lead a bold strike on Gen. Grievous's warship and its destructive weapon.

episodes.title: Rising Malevolence
episodes.overview: An attack by a devastating new Separatist weapon leaves Jedi Master Plo Koon and his clone troopers struggling to survive.

episodes.title: Ambush
episodes.overview: Jedi Master Yoda and three clone troopers must face off against Count Dooku's dreaded assassin Ventress and her massive droid army.

title: Steins;Gate
overview: A group of friends have customized their microwave so that it can send text messages to the past. As they perform different experiments, an organization named SERN who has been doing their own research on time travel tracks them down and now the characters have to find a way to avoid being captured by them.

episodes.title: Achievement Point
episodes.overview: Okabe undergoes a personal sacrifice in an attempt to bring the world lines back into order and save the lives of his partners.

episodes.title: Open the Steins Gate
episodes.overview: Okabe travels back in time with Suzuha to just before Kurisu's death to witness the dawn of the time machine arms race and the spark of World War III.

episodes.title: Being Meltdown
episodes.overview: Kurisu persuades Okabe to let her die and Mayuri live. As Okabe destroys the phone microwave, he gets a critical message from Suzuha.

episodes.title: Paradox Meltdown
episodes.overview: Okabu hopes to keep Kurisu alive by not hacking with the IBN 5100, but he soon realizes that either she or Mayuri must die in the beta world line.

episodes.title: Finalize Apoptosis
episodes.overview: Okabe locates the missing IBN 5100 and uncovers the identity of the mysterious "FB" but realizes that getting the computer back means losing Kurisu.

episodes.title: Endless Apoptosis
episodes.overview: When Okabe discovers that Moeka has committed suicide, he attempts to undo the act through D-Mails, leaving Moeka feeling betrayed.

episodes.title: Fractal Androgynous
episodes.overview: Okabe tries to convince Ruka that she was originally a male and that only by undoing the D-Mails that made the switch can they save Mayuri's life.

episodes.title: Made in Complex
episodes.overview: When he discovers that Mayuri is still fated to die, Okabe works with Kurisu to reverse the effects of D-Mails that have irreversibly changed time.

episodes.title: Sacrificial Necrosis
episodes.overview: Okabe finds Suzuha's father, but his attempt to reunite them results in tragedy that he sets out to correct with the time leap machine.

episodes.title: Missing Link Necrosis
episodes.overview: Suzuha reveals how SERN's plan will lead to a totalitarian government by 2036; Okabe and the rest of the team set out to find Suzuha's father.

episodes.title: Physically Necrosis
episodes.overview: While Okabe is devastated by his failure to save Mayuri, Kurisu explains it may not be possible, and Suzuha makes a startling revelation.

episodes.title: Metaphysics Necrosis
episodes.overview: Okabe uses the time leap machine to attempt to prevent Mayuri from being killed, but he quickly learns that the mission isn't as simple as he thought.

episodes.title: Dogma in Ergosphere
episodes.overview: Kurisu completes her new time machine, which can transmit emotions back in time, and Suzuha fears that she's fated to become a spy for SERN.

episodes.title: Dogma in Event Horizon
episodes.overview: When Okabe learns that a TV in the repair shop is linked to the ability to send D-Mail, Kurisu believes it can be used to send emotions through time.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis III
episodes.overview: Okabe receives a threatening text message, and Suzuha, unable to find her father, returns home without saying good-bye.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis II
episodes.overview: One of the world shifts result in the disappearance of the critical IBN 5100 computer, while another changes the physical properties of the city.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis I
episodes.overview: Okabe continues to experiment with D-Mail, resulting in world shifts that only he can remember -- and an attempt to have Ruka reborn as a female.

episodes.title: Divergence Singularity
episodes.overview: When Okabe successfully alters time with a D-Mail, the effects lead Titor to believe that Okabe may save the world from its dystopian future.

episodes.title: Butterfly Effect's Divergence
episodes.overview: Okabe experiments with sending texts, now called "D-Mails," into the past and unsuccessfully prevents Moeka from learning the true nature of his work.

episodes.title: Starmine Rendezvous
episodes.overview: Okabe uncovers the gruesome details of SERN's time travel experiments and gets a warning from Suzuha about Kurisu.

episodes.title: Interpreter Rendezvous
episodes.overview: John Titor tells Okabe that he can't fully decode the SERN files without an IBN 5100 computer, a rare model that he finds difficult to track down.

episodes.title: Parallel World Paranoia
episodes.overview: Okabe learns that his microwave will send messages to the past, and discovers a shocking secret when he hacks into the SERN network.

episodes.title: Time Travel Paranoia
episodes.overview: Okabe is visited by a self-proclaimed time traveler and conducts the first successful test of his microwave-based time machine -- using a banana.

episodes.title: Turning Point
episodes.overview: At a time travel conference, scientist Rintarō Okabe encounters a mysterious woman who claims they met 15 minutes before and is then brutally stabbed.

title: Steins;Gate 0
overview: Eccentric Rintaro falls into a depression after failing to save Kurisu, but then a neuroscientist offers him the chance to interact with an AI copy.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
